ABHUKTA_MOOLA_DOSHA.name: Abhukta mūla doṣaḥ — jyeṣṭhā-caturtha-pāda/mūla-prathama-pāda-sandhi-janmaḥ. Tīvra-gaṇḍāntaḥ.
ABHUKTA_MOOLA_DOSHA.prose: Nārada-saṃhitāyām abhukta mūla doṣaḥ — jyeṣṭhā-nakṣatrasya antima-pāde mūla-nakṣatrasya prathama-pāde vā (vṛścika-dhanuḥ jala-agni-sandhau) jātasya atyanta-tīvra-gaṇḍānta-yogyatā. Bālya-jīvana-saṅkaṭa, svāsthya-ariṣṭa, kula-saṅkramaṇa-saṅkaṭa-yogyatāṃ dadāti. 27-Divasīya-mūla-śānti-karma āvaśyakam.

ADHI.name: Candra-adhiyogaḥ — candrāt 6-7-8 bhāveṣu śubhagrahāḥ — cakravartyupama-netṛtvam.
ADHI.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye phaladīpikāyāñca varṇitam — candrāt ṣaṣṭha-saptama-aṣṭama-bhāveṣu pāpagraha-rahiteṣu śubhagrahāḥ (budha-guru-śukrāḥ) sthitāścet adhiyogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ mantrī, senāpatiḥ, bhūpatiḥ vā bhavati. Ayaṃ śatrunāśaṃ parama-adhikāraṃ ca dadāti.

ADHI_RAJA.name: Ādhi-rājayogaḥ — candrāt 6-7-8 bhāveṣu śubhagrahāḥ, te ca kendreṣu sthitāḥ. Cakravartī-yaśaḥ.
ADHI_RAJA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye varṇitam — yadā candrāt 6, 7, 8 bhāveṣu śubhagrahāḥ (budha-guru-śukrāḥ) tiṣṭhanti, te ca lagnacandrayoḥ kendreṣu saṃsaṃsthitāḥ bhavanti, tadā ādhi-rājayogo jāyate. Ayamuccakoṭiko mahārājayogaḥ. Anena jātakaḥ cakravartī rājā, digvijayī, sārvabhaumapraśāsakaśca bhavati.

ADHI_YOGA.name: Candrādhiyogaḥ — candrāt 6-7-8 bhāvasthe śubhagraheṣu — sāmrājyapradaḥ.
ADHI_YOGA.prose: Candrāt ṣaṣṭha-saptama-aṣṭama-bhāveṣu saumyagrahāḥ (budha-guru-śukrāḥ) yadi sthitāḥ syuḥ, tadā adhiyogaḥ phalayati. Anena jātakaḥ senānīḥ, mantrī, bhūpatiḥ, śatrujetā, dīrghāyuśca samajāyate.

ADHI_YOGA_FULL.name: Pūrṇa ādhi yogaḥ — candrāt 6-7-8 śubha-grahāḥ. Cakravartī-samarthyam.
ADHI_YOGA_FULL.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye pūrṇa-ādhi-yogaḥ — candrāt 6-7-8-sthāneṣu sarvatra śubha-grahāḥ tiṣṭhantaḥ cakravartī-tulyāṃ sarva-dig-vijaya-yogyatāṃ, aṣṭa-dikpālaka-kīrtiṃ, ati-dīrghāyuṃ dadati. Ādhi-rāja-yogasya pūrṇa-rūpam.

ADITYA_YOGA.name: Āditya yoga — sūrya-budha-guruḥ kendre — ātma-medhā-darśana-saṃyogaḥ.
ADITYA_YOGA.prose: Āditya-yogaḥ sūryo budho guruśca kendra-bhāve yadi sammilitau syātām, tadā ātma-medhā-darśana-saṃyogena parama-rāja-kīrtiṃ phalayati.

AKHANDA_SAMRAJYA.name: Akhaṇḍa-sāmrājya yoga — guruḥ kendre, dvitīya-ekādaśeśau kendre — sarvocca-rāja-yogaḥ.
AKHANDA_SAMRAJYA.prose: Akhaṇḍa-sāmrājya-yogo guruḥ kendra-bhāve, dvitīya-ekādaśeśayoranyatamo lagne kendre vā yadi syāt, tadā avicchinna-rāja-adhikāra-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

ALPAYU_BALARISHTA_TRIPLE.name: Trividha-bālāriṣṭa yogaḥ — bālyakāle parama-saṅkaṭa-saṅketaḥ.
ALPAYU_BALARISHTA_TRIPLE.prose: Trividha-bālāriṣṭayoge pāpakaṣṭayukto candraḥ, lagnāt saptamākṣagatāḥ pāpāḥ, śubhagrahāṇāṃ kendratrikoṇeṣu darśanābhāvaścet syāt, tadā aṣṭavarṣaparyantaṃ bālyakāle mahad bhayaṃ bhavati.

ALPAYU_LAGNA_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Alpāyu yoga — duḥsthāne lagneśe aṣṭameśe ca kendra-trikoṇagate sati jātasya alpāyuryogaḥ samajāyate.
ALPAYU_LAGNA_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Lagneśaḥ ṣaṣṭhāṣṭamadvādaśabhāvānāmanyatame duḥsthāne durbalaḥ san sthito bhavet, aṣṭameśaśca kendratrikoṇeṣu balavān bhūtvā tiṣṭhet, tadā jātakasya dvātriṃśadvarṣābhyantare mṛtyusūcako'yamalpāyuryogo jāyate.

ALPAYU_MOON_SATURN_AFFLICTED.name: Alpāyu yoga — durbale candre balavati śanau ca satyalpāyutvaṃ jāyate.
ALPAYU_MOON_SATURN_AFFLICTED.prose: Alpāyu-yogaścandro duḥsthāna-bhāve nīca-rāśau vā sthito bhavet, śanirbalavān cet syāt, tadā mana-śarīra-daurbalyena dvātriṃśadvarṣābhyantare mṛtyusūcako yogo bhavati.

AMALA.name: Amala yogaḥ — lagnāt candrādvā daśamabhāve śubhagrahāḥ — niṣkalaṅka-kīrtiḥ.
AMALA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye varṇitam — yadi lagnāt candrādvā daśamabhāve kevalaṃ śubhagrahāḥ (budha-guru-śukrāḥ) tiṣṭhanti, tadā amala-yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ nirmala-kīrtimān, sadācārī, paropakārī, rājapūjitaśca bhavati. Ayamamala-tulya-śuddha-yaśaṃ dadāti.

AMALA_KIRTI_BENEFIC_10_FROM_MOON.name: Amala-kīrti yogaḥ — candrād daśame śubhagrahe — niṣkalaṅka-yaśaḥ-kīrtiḥ.
AMALA_KIRTI_BENEFIC_10_FROM_MOON.prose: Amala-kīrti-yogaḥ phaladīpikāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhādhyāye kathitaḥ. Śubhagrahāḥ candrāt daśama-sthāne yadi tiṣṭheyuḥ, tadā jātakaḥ paropakārī, niṣkalaṅka-kīrti-vibhūṣitaḥ, dānavīraśca bhavati.

AMAVASYA_DOSHA.name: Amāvāsyā doṣaḥ — amāvāsyā-divase janma. Candra-teja-nyūnatā.
AMAVASYA_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye amāvāsyā doṣaḥ — amāvāsyā-divase janmekaścandra-teja-nyūnatā-yogyatāṃ, mātṛ-svāsthya-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ, mānasika-tanāva-yogyatāṃ, pitṛ-karma-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Candra-śānti-karma-vratena nivāraṇīyam.
AMAVASYA_DOSHA.general: Candra-teja nyūnatā, mātṛ-svāsthya kaṣṭa, mānasika tanāva, pitṛ-karma kaṣṭa.

AMRIT_CHANDRA.name: Amṛta yoga — candraḥ kendre sva/ucce — parama-sthira-manaḥ-dīrghāyuḥ.
AMRIT_CHANDRA.prose: Amṛta-yogo candraḥ kendra-bhāve sva-rāśau (karke) ucca-rāśau (vṛṣe) vā yadi syāt, tadā amṛta-tulya-sthairya-mātṛ-dīrghāyu-saṃrakṣaṇa-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

ANAPHA.name: Anaphā yogaḥ — candrāt dvādaśe grahāṇāṃ sthitiḥ (sūryādi-varjam) — susaṃskārayogaḥ.
ANAPHA.prose: Sūryaṃ rāhuṃ ketuṃ ca varjayitvā ko'pi grahaḥ candrāt dvādaśa-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā anaphāyogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ susaṃskṛtaḥ, śiṣṭaḥ, paropakārī, mānasika-śāntiyuktaśca bhavati.

ANAPHA_JUPITER.name: Anaphā (guruḥ) — candrāt dvādaśe devagurau — ādhyātmika-gāmbhīryam.
ANAPHA_JUPITER.prose: Guruścandrāt dvādaśa-bhāve yadi virājate, tadā anaphā-guru-yogo phalayati. Anena jātakaḥ parama-udāraḥ, ekāntadhyānaśīlaḥ, paropakārī, mokṣamārgābhilāṣī ca jāyate.

ANAPHA_MARS.name: Anaphā (maṅgalaḥ) — candrāt dvādaśe kuje — saṃyamita-śauryam.
ANAPHA_MARS.prose: Maṅgalaścandrāt dvādaśa-bhāve cet, tadā anaphā-kuja-yogo bhavati. Anena jātakaḥ saṃyamitavīryaḥ, ātmarakṣaṇapaṭuḥ, gūḍhaśāstravid, śastra-śāstra-kriyāsu sūkṣmadṛṣṭiyuktaśca jāyate.

ANAPHA_MERCURY.name: Anaphā (budhaḥ) — candrāt dvādaśe budhe — gūḍhajñāna-lekhana-kauśalam.
ANAPHA_MERCURY.prose: Budhaścandrāt dvādaśa-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā anaphā-budha-yogo jāyate. Anena jātakaḥ gūḍhaviṣayānveṣakaḥ, ekāntapriyaḥ, gambhīralekhakaḥ, sampādakaḥ, susaṃskṛtavaktā ca bhavati.

ANAPHA_SATURN.name: Anaphā (śaniḥ) — candrāt dvādaśe śanau — vairāgya-saṃyama-dhairyam.
ANAPHA_SATURN.prose: Śaniścandrāt dvādaśa-bhāve cet, tadā anaphā-śani-yogo jāyate. Anena jātakaḥ ekāntasādhakaḥ, vītarāgaḥ, paramadhairyavān, ātmaviśleṣaṇapravīṇaśca bhavati.

ANAPHA_STRICT.name: Anaphā yoga (kaṭhora) — śubha-grahaścandrād dvādaśe, dvitīye śūnyam — śuddha-vaṃśajāta-guṇa-yogaḥ.
ANAPHA_STRICT.prose: Anaphā-yogaḥ (kaṭhora-tiryak) candrāt dvādaśe śubha-graho yadi syāt, dvitīye ca ko'pi graho na syāt, tadā śuddha-paitṛka-saṃskāraguṇaṃ phalayati.

ANAPHA_VENUS.name: Anaphā (śukraḥ) — candrāt dvādaśe śukre — susaṃskṛtasaundaryabodhaḥ.
ANAPHA_VENUS.prose: Śukraścandrāt dvādaśa-bhāve yadi tiṣṭhet, tadā anaphā-śukra-yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ lalitakalāsu susaṃskṛtapriyaḥ, dāmpatyamaryādāpālakaḥ, guptadānaśīlaśca bhavati.

ANGA_ARISHTA.name: Aṅgāriṣṭayogaḥ — nīcamaṅgalaḥ lagnabhāve — aṅgadaurbalyaṃ śastrāghātaśca.
ANGA_ARISHTA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 10 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā maṅgalaḥ svanīcarāśau (karke) lagnabhāve tiṣṭhati, tadā aṅgāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Maṅgalaḥ rakta-māṃsapeśīkārakaḥ; lagnasthanīcamaṅgalaḥ śarīre ghāvam, śastrāghātam, aṅgadaurbalyaṃ vā śalyakriyāpravṛttiṃ janayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — maṅgalaśāntiḥ, subrahmaṇyopāsanā, nīcabhaṅgayogānveṣaṇam ca śubhāḥ.

ANSHIK_MANGAL.name: Āṃśika māṅgalika — maṅgalaḥ sīmita-doṣa-sthāneṣu. Madhyama-dāmpatya-kaṣṭa.
ANSHIK_MANGAL.prose: Mānasāgaryāṃ pañcame adhyāye āṃśika māṅgalika uktam — pūrṇa-doṣa-sthāneṣu (lagna-2-4-7-8-12) kintu śubha-graha-dṛṣṭe vā nirbala-sthitau āṃśika māṅgalika. Pūrṇa-māṅgalika-tulya-guru-kaṣṭaṃ na jāyate kintu madhyama-dāmpatya-kalahaṃ dadāti. Dāmpatya-śānti-karmeṇa nivāraṇīyam.

ARDHA_CHANDRA.name: Ardhacandra yogaḥ — grahāḥ ṣaṭ-krama-bhāveṣu ardha-cakrākāraṃ. Rāja-yaśa-yogaḥ.
ARDHA_CHANDRA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye ardhacandra yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ ṣaṭ-bhāva-śṛṅkhalāyāṃ ardha-cakrākāraṃ tiṣṭhanti. Ardha-candra-samānāṃ saumya-rāja-yaśaṃ, manorañjaka-kīrtiṃ, dharmeṇa-sampattiṃ dadāti.

ASA.name: Āśā yogaḥ — candraḥ kendre śubha-grahaiḥ veṣṭitaḥ. Āśāpūrti-yogaḥ.
ASA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye āśā-yogaḥ — candro kendra-sthāne śubha-grahaiḥ parivṛto san sarva-āśā-pūrtiṃ, manorañjaka-kīrtiṃ, sama-vyāpta-śubha-phalaṃ dadāti. Mana-kāraka-saṃrakṣaṇam.

BADHAKA_DOSHA.name: Bādhaka doṣaḥ — lagna-svabhāva-anuguṇaṃ bādhaka-sthāna-duṣṭatā. Adṛśya-vighna-yogyatā.
BADHAKA_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre bādhaka-sthānam — cara-lagne ekādaśa-sthānam, sthira-lagne navama-sthānam, dvisvabhāva-lagne saptama-sthānam. Tatra pāpa-graha-sthitau bādhakeśe vā ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśa-sthite — adṛśya-vighna, siddhi-samaye acānaka-bādhā, lakṣya-samīpe viphala-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Bādhakeśe svocca-sva-gṛhī upacaya-sthite vā nivāraṇam.

BAHU_PUTRA_BENEFIC_5_AND_9.name: Bahu-putra yoga — śubha-pañcama-navame — bahu-santāna-dīrghāyuḥ.
BAHU_PUTRA_BENEFIC_5_AND_9.prose: Bahu-putra-yogaḥ śubha-grahāḥ yugapat pañcama-navamayoḥ yadi syāt, tadā bahu-santāna-dharma-dṛṣṭiṃ ca pradāti.

BALARISHTA_LAGNA_7TH_MALEFICS.name: Bālāriṣṭayogaḥ — lagna-saptamayoḥ pāpagrahāḥ — tanu-akṣapīḍā.
BALARISHTA_LAGNA_7TH_MALEFICS.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 45 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā lagne saptame ca pāpagrahāḥ sthitāḥ syuḥ śubhadṛṣṭihīnāśca, tadā bālāriṣṭayogo bhavati. Tanubhāvaḥ saptamabhāvaśca militvā śarīrākṣaṃ nirmataḥ; anayoḥ pāpena veṣṭanāt bālyakāle śārīrikabalaṃ hīnaṃ bhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — navagrahaśāntipūjā, mahālakṣmīkavacam, hanumadupāsanā ca śubhā.

BALARISHTA_MOON_DUSTHANA_NO_BENEFIC.name: Bālāriṣṭayogaḥ — candro duṣṭāne śubhadṛṣṭihīnaḥ — ciratanudaurbalyam.
BALARISHTA_MOON_DUSTHANA_NO_BENEFIC.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre varṇitam. Yadā candraḥ ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśabhāveṣu sthito bhavati, parantu kenāpi śubhagraheṇa (budha-guru-śukraiḥ) na dṛṣṭo bhavati, tadā bālāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Jātakasya bālyakāle svāsthyarakṣaṇaṃ kaṭhinaṃ bhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — candragāyatrījapaḥ, iṣṭadevapūjanaṃ ca rakṣāṃ karoti.

BALARISHTA_MOON_LAGNA_MALEFIC.name: Bālāriṣṭayogaḥ — candro lagne pāpagrahaiḥ yutaḥ dṛṣṭo vā — bālasaṅkaṭam.
BALARISHTA_MOON_LAGNA_MALEFIC.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 45 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā candro lagne tiṣṭhati, pāpagrahaḥ saha yuto dṛṣṭo vā bhavati, tadā bālāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Anena śiśoḥ bālyakāle (prathamacaturvarṣe) gambhīrarogaḥ, prāṇasaṅkaṭaṃ ca sambhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — candragāyatrījapaḥ, mātuḥ śuśrūṣā, śivārādhanā ca jīvanarakṣāṃ karoti.

BALARISHTA_MOON_SATURN_DUSTHANA.name: Bālāriṣṭayogaḥ — candro śaninā saha trikasthāneṣu — tīvrabālasaṅkaṭam.
BALARISHTA_MOON_SATURN_DUSTHANA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre varṇitam. Yadā candraḥ śaniśca yugapat ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśabhāveṣu tiṣṭhataḥ, tadā tīvraḥ bālāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Anena śiśoḥ śarīre manasi ca vakragatyā ciradaurbalyaṃ prāṇabhayaṃ ca sambhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — candraśanyoḥ śāntiḥ, mahāmṛtyuñjayahomaḥ ca śreyaskaraḥ.

BALARISHTA_SUN_MARS_LAGNA.name: Bālāriṣṭayogaḥ — sūryamaṅgalau lagne — jvaraghātaśārīrikapīḍā.
BALARISHTA_SUN_MARS_LAGNA.prose: Yadā sūryamaṅgalau lagnabhāve ekatra tiṣṭhataḥ, tadā agnitattvasya ādhikyena bālāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Śiśoḥ śarīre tīvrajvaraḥ, visphoṭakāḥ, śastrāghātaḥ, raktavikāro vā bālyakāle prāṇabhayaṃ janayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — sūryamaṅgalyoḥ śāntiḥ, bhagavān subrahmaṇyasya ārādhanā, śītalopacārāḥ ca śubhāḥ.

BANDHA_ARISHTA.name: Bandhāriṣṭayogaḥ — śanirāhūṇāṃ dvādaśabhāve yutiḥ — bandhanaṃ kārāvāsabhayaṃ ca.
BANDHA_ARISHTA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 10 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā śaniśca rāhuśca yugapat dvādaśabhāve (vyaya-bandhana-nirvāsanabhāve) tiṣṭhataḥ, tadā bandhāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Śaniḥ saṅkocakārakaḥ, rāhuḥ māyākārakaḥ; anayoḥ bandhanabhāve saṃyogaḥ jātakasya bandhanam, kārāvāsam, videśanirvāsanaṃ vā guptaśatrubādhāṃ phalayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — śanirāhoḥ śāntiḥ, hanumadupāsanā, nyāyasatarkatā ca.

BANDHU_DOSHA.name: Bandhu doṣaḥ — tṛtīyeśa/maṅgala-daurbalyam. Bhrātṛ-kaṣṭa-yogyatā.
BANDHU_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 adhyāye bandhu doṣaḥ — tṛtīyeśo vā maṅgalaḥ (bhrātṛ-kārakaḥ) duṣṭa-sthāna-sthitaḥ krūra-saṃyogo vā san bhrātṛ-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ, bhrātṛ-viyoga-yogyatāṃ, sahodara-kalaha-yogyatāṃ dadāti.

BENEFIC_ALL_KENDRAS.name: Sarva-kendreṣu śubha-grahāḥ — śubha-kendra-yogaḥ. Caturbhiḥ-stambhaiḥ-sudṛḍhaṃ bhāgyam.
BENEFIC_ALL_KENDRAS.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye śubha-kendra-yogaḥ uktaḥ — caturṣu kendreṣu (1/4/7/10) śubha-grahaiḥ upasthitaiḥ caturbhiḥ-stambhaiḥ jīvanaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ bhavati. Sarva-dig-maṅgalaṃ, sarva-dig-yaśaṃ, sthira-rāja-sammānaṃ ca dadāti.

BENEFIC_ALL_TRIKONAS.name: Sarva-trikoṇeṣu śubha-grahāḥ — śubha-trikoṇa-yogaḥ. Lakṣmī-bhāvaiḥ-triguṇaṃ-bhāgyam.
BENEFIC_ALL_TRIKONAS.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye śubha-trikoṇa-yogaḥ uktaḥ — triṣu trikoṇeṣu (1/5/9) śubha-grahaiḥ upasthitaiḥ lakṣmī-bhāvaiḥ triguṇaṃ bhāgyaṃ prāpayate. Pūrva-puṇyena-vartamāna-yaśena-bhaviṣya-saubhāgyena ca jīvanaṃ samṛddham.

BENEFIC_IN_5.name: Pañcame śubhāḥ — putra-prajñā-śubha-yogaḥ. Buddhimatī-santatiḥ, mantra-siddhiḥ.
BENEFIC_IN_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye śubhāḥ pañcame — pūrva-puṇya-sthāne śubha-graha-saṃyogena buddhimatī-santatiṃ, mantra-siddhiṃ, vidyā-kauśalaṃ, rāja-kīrtiṃ dadāti. Pañcama-bhāvasya sarva-śubha-saṃrakṣaṇam.

BENEFIC_IN_9.name: Navame śubhāḥ — bhāgya-dharma-śubha-yogaḥ. Ati-bhāgya, guru-kṛpā-pātraḥ.
BENEFIC_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye śubhāḥ navame — bhāgya-sthāne śubha-graha-saṃyogena atyanta-bhāgyaṃ, guru-kṛpā-pātratvaṃ, dharma-niṣṭhāṃ, pitṛ-sukhaṃ, guru-śāstra-prāptiṃ dadāti. Śreṣṭha-śubha-sthāneṣu anyatamaḥ.

BHADRA.name: Lagnaṃ candraṃ vā nimittīkṛtya kendre svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe budhe bhadrayogo jāyate. Anena jātakaḥ tīkṣṇabuddhiḥ, bahuśāstrajñaḥ, suvaktā, medhāvī ca bhavati.
BHADRA.prose: Atha pañcamahāpuruṣayogeṣu dvitīyo bhadrayogaḥ. Saumye svoccagṛhagate kendre bhadrayogo bhavati. Asya phalaṃ mānasādīnāṃ pariśuddhatāṃ janayati. Pārāśaramate — 'vidvadvandvastutaḥ pragalbhavacano medhāvī...' Iti. Budhasya naisargikavāgmitvaṃ tathā ca kendrabhāvasya prakāśakatvaṃ militvā jātakaṃ gaṇitaśāstre, vāṇijye, sampādakīyakāryeṣu tathā ca mantritve śīrṣasthānaṃ prāpayati.
BHADRA.career: Mahān lekhakaḥ, caturo vyāpārī, prakhyātaḥ śāstrajñaḥ sallāhakāraśca
BHADRA.mind: Sutīkṣṇā viśleṣaṇātmikā buddhiḥ, vilakṣaṇā medhā ca
BHADRA.wealth: Vāṇijyena bhāṣaṇena ca labdhaṃ vipulaṃ dhanam, bahusrota-āyaḥ

BHADRA_BHANGA.name: Kendrabhāvagate svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe'pi budhe astaṅgate vakriṇi vā sati bhadrabhaṅgayogo jāyate. Anena bhadrayogasya śubhaphaleṣu hrāso bhavati.
BHADRA_BHANGA.prose: Yadā budhaḥ kendrasthāneṣu svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇarāśistho'pi san sūryeṇa saha yutatvāt astaṅgato bhavati, athavā vakrī-gatyā yukto bhavati, tadā bhadrabhaṅgayogo jāyate. Budhaḥ sūryasya samīpe eva bhramati, ataḥ prāyaśaḥ vahuṣu kuṇḍalīṣu budhasyāstaṅgatvaṃ dṛśyate. Anena jātakasya prakharabuddhiḥ medhā ca vikasitā bhavati, kintu samaye vāk-cāturyasya abhāvaḥ, bhāṣaṇe saṃśayaḥ, vyāpārikanirṇayeṣu asthiratā ca utpadyate. Sarasvatī-upāsanā budhamantrajapādibhiḥ asya doṣasya śamanaṃ kartuṃ śakyate.

BHADRA_DOSHA.name: Bhadrā doṣaḥ — viṣṭi-karaṇa-janmaḥ. Śubha-karma-vighna-yogyatā.
BHADRA_DOSHA.prose: Muhūrta-cintāmaṇau bhadrā doṣaḥ — viṣṭi-karaṇa-samaye janmekaḥ śubha-karma-vighna-yogyatāṃ, māṅgalya-saṃskāra-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ, dainika-karma-nyūnatāṃ dadāti. Puccha-bhadrā (śubha-diś) madhya-bhadrā (madhyama) mukha-bhadrā (atyanta-duṣṭa) iti tri-taram.
BHADRA_DOSHA.general: Śubha-karma-vighna yogyatā, māṅgalya-saṃskāra kaṣṭa, dainika-karma nyūnatā.

BHADRA_EXALTED.name: Kendrabhāvagate kanyārāśisthe (paramoccasthe) budhe uccabhadrasañjño mahāyogo bhavati. Ayamuccatamakoṭeḥ paramamedhāyogaḥ.
BHADRA_EXALTED.prose: Atha bhadrayogasya paramaśreṣṭharūpamuccabhadrayogaḥ. Yadā budhaḥ svaparamoccarāśau kanyāyāṃ (15 aṃśe) sthitaḥ san kendre bhavati, tadā ekadaiva uccatva-svarkṣatva-mūlatrikoṇatvādi-trividhabalaṃ labhate. Anena jātakaḥ paramavidvān, bahubhāṣāvit, gaṇitaśāstrapāraṅgataḥ, sutīkṣṇabuddhiyuktaśca jāyate. Kūṭanītau, nyāyaśāstre, uccavyāpāre tathā ca granthalekhane eṣa yogaḥ jātakaṃ jagatprasiddhaṃ karoti.

BHADRA_FROM_MOON.name: Candralagnāt kendre svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe budhe candrabhadrayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya manasi tīkṣṇā buddhiḥ medhā ca vikasitā bhavati.
BHADRA_FROM_MOON.prose: Yadā jātakasya kuṇḍalyāṃ candralagnāt kendrabhāveṣu budhaḥ svocce svarkṣe vā sthito bhavati, tadā candrabhadrayogo jāyate. Candraḥ manasaḥ kārakaḥ, budhastu buddheḥ; tayoḥ saṃyogāt jātakasya manasi asādhāraṇaṃ tārkikakauśalaṃ, tīkṣṇamedhā, tathā ca madhuraṃ vāgmitvaṃ vikasati. Jātakaḥ lekhanakārye, sampādane, vyāpāre ca atīva nipuṇo bhavati. Yadi lagna-candra-dvayoḥ kendre budhaḥ sthitaḥ syāt, tadā jātakaḥ mahān vidvān kūṭanītijñaśca bhavati.

BHAGYA_9_LORD_KENDRA.name: Bhāgya yoga — navameśa kendre — dṛḍha-dharma-niṣṭha bhāgyodayaḥ.
BHAGYA_9_LORD_KENDRA.prose: Bhāgya-yogaḥ bṛhatpārāśara-horā-śāstrasya 34-adhyāye kathitaḥ. Navameśo lagna-caturtha-saptama-daśameṣu yadi syāt, tadā bhāgyodayaḥ sthiro bhavati.

BHAGYA_9_LORD_OWN_EXALT.name: Bhāgya yoga — navameśa sva/ucca — digbala-yukta-bhāgyam.
BHAGYA_9_LORD_OWN_EXALT.prose: Navameśo sva-ucca-mūlatrikoṇa-rāśiṣu yadi syāt, tadā bhāgya-yogo digbala-saṃyukto bhavati.

BHAGYA_9_LORD_TRIKONA.name: Bhāgya yoga — navameśa trikoṇe — dharmānukūla-bhāgyapravāhaḥ.
BHAGYA_9_LORD_TRIKONA.prose: Bhāgya-navameśa-trikoṇa-yogaḥ bṛhatpārāśara-horā-śāstrasya 34-adhyāye. Navameśo trikoṇe (lagna-pañcama-navama) yadi syāt, tadā dharmānukūla-bhāgyodayo bhavati.

BHAGYA_BENEFIC_9_AND_KENDRA.name: Bhāgya yoga — śubho navame kendre ca — saṃyukta śubha-samarthanam.
BHAGYA_BENEFIC_9_AND_KENDRA.prose: Śubho (guru-śukra-budha-candra) navame yadi syāt, anyaśca śubho kendre, tadā bhāgya-kendra-saṃyukta-śubhaṃ pradāti.

BHAGYA_LORDS_TRIKONA_EXCHANGE.name: Bhāgya yoga — lagneśa-navameśa parivartana — parama-dharma-sva-saṃyojanam.
BHAGYA_LORDS_TRIKONA_EXCHANGE.prose: Lagneśo navameśasya rāśau, navameśo lagneśasya rāśau yadi sthitau, tadā parivartanaṃ bhāgya-sva-saṃyojanaṃ ca bhavati.

BHAGYA_YOGA.name: Bhāgyayogaḥ — navameśasya svagṛhe avasthitiḥ — bhāgyabhāvasya ananyasurakṣā sudṛḍhatā ca.
BHAGYA_YOGA.prose:
Bhāgyayogaḥ — phaladīpikāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhamadhyāyānusāram. Yadā bhāgya-dharmabhāvayoḥ svāmī navameśaḥ svakīye eva navamabhāve virājamānaḥ bhūtvā bhāvabalaṃ vardhayati, tadā eṣaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ bhāgyayogaḥ utpadyate. Śāstrīyasiddhānte "svagṛhapatiḥ bhāvaṃ rakṣati" iti niyamena navameśaḥ svagṛhe sthitvā tasya bhāvasya kārakatattvāni (bhāgyaṃ, dharmaṃ, satkarma, gurubhaktiṃ ca) caramonnatiṃ prāpayati.

Jātakaḥ jīvane asādhāraṇasaubhāgyaṃ, dhārmikakīrtiṃ, pitṛprasādaṃ, paitṛkasampattiṃ ca prāpnoti. Yadyapi ayaṃ yogaḥ dhanavargapravāhe parigaṇyate, tathāpi asya mūlalakṣyaṃ dharmasaṃsthāpanaṃ bhāgyavṛddhiḥ ca vartate; dhanaṃ tu asya ānuṣaṅgikaṃ phalameva. Uccavidyā, sudīrghavideśayātrā, dhārmikanetṛtvaṃ ca jātakasya jīvanaṃ dhanyaṃ kurvanti.

BHAKOOT_DOSHA.name: Bhakūṭa doṣaḥ — candra-rāśyoḥ 6-8/2-12/5-9 sambandhaḥ. Dāmpatya-asāmañjasya-yogyatā.
BHAKOOT_DOSHA.prose: Muhūrta-cintāmaṇau ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye bhakūṭa kūṭaḥ — vara-vadhū-candra-rāśyoḥ 6-8 (ṣaḍaṣṭaka), 2-12 (dvi-dvādaśa), vā 5-9 (navama-pañcama) sambandhe bhakūṭa doṣaḥ. Dāmpatya-asāmañjasyaṃ, vaicārika-virodhaṃ, dhana-kalaha-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Nāḍī-kūṭa-samānaṃ ati-duṣṭa-yogyaḥ.

BHARATI_BENEFIC_KENDRA_FROM_MERCURY.name: Bhāratī yoga — śubho budhāt kendre — parama-vidvattāyāḥ yogaḥ.
BHARATI_BENEFIC_KENDRA_FROM_MERCURY.prose: Bhāratī-yogaḥ budhād kendra-bhāveṣu (1,4,7,10) śubha-graho (guruḥ-śukraḥ-candraḥ) yadi syāt, tadā parama-vidyā-vācā-kauśalaṃ ca pradāti.

BHATR_SUKHA_BENEFIC_3.name: Bhrātṛ-sukha yoga — śubho tṛtīye — anuja-sukham.
BHATR_SUKHA_BENEFIC_3.prose: Bhrātṛ-sukha-yogaḥ śubho (guru-śukra-budha-candra) tṛtīya-sthāne yadi syāt, tadā anuja-sukhaṃ pradāti.

BHERI.name: Bherīyogaḥ — lagneśa-guru-śukrāḥ parasparaṃ kendreṣu saṃsthitāḥ. Rājayogapradaḥ.
BHERI.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye varṇitam — lagneśaḥ, devaguruḥ, śukraśca ete trayaḥ parasparaṃ kendrasthāḥ bhavanti cet, bherīyogaḥ samajāyate. "Bherī" iti dundubhi-raṇana-nādaḥ. Anena jātakaḥ yaśasvī, rājyasañcālakaḥ, senāpatiḥ, dhārmikaśāsakaśca bhavati.

BRAHMA_DOSHA.name: Brahma doṣaḥ — guruḥ 9-sthāne pāpa-dṛṣṭo durbalaḥ. Brāhmaṇa-śāpa-karma.
BRAHMA_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 84 adhyāye brahma doṣaḥ — guruḥ navama-sthāne pāpa-graha-dṛṣṭo durbala-sthito vā brāhmaṇa-śāpa-pūrva-janma-karma, dharma-kula-kaṣṭa, guru-avamāna-doṣa, dharma-śikṣā-vighna-yogyatāṃ dadāti.
BRAHMA_DOSHA.general: Brāhmaṇa-śāpa karma, dharma-kula kaṣṭa, guru-avamāna doṣa, dharma-śikṣā vighna.

BRAHMA_RAJA.name: Brahma-rājayogaḥ — guru-śukra-budhāḥ kendreṣu saṃsaṃsthitāḥ. Brahmajñānaṃ śāstrapāṇḍityañca.
BRAHMA_RAJA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye varṇitam — yadā guruḥ, śukraḥ, budhaśca trayaḥ śubhagrahāḥ kendreṣu (1, 4, 7, 10) santiṣṭhanti, tadā brahma-rājayogo jāyate. Anena jātakaḥ sarvaśāstravidvān, brahmajñānakuśalaḥ, paramadhārmikaḥ, rājapūjitaśca bhavati. Ayamuccatamo bauddhika-rājayogaḥ.

BUDDHA.name: Buddha yogaḥ — budhaḥ kendre ucce śubha-dṛṣṭaḥ. Bodhi-tulya-prajñā.
BUDDHA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye buddha-yogaḥ — budhaḥ kendre ucca-sva-rāśi-sthaḥ śubha-graha-dṛṣṭaḥ san bodhi-tulyāṃ prajñāṃ, sarva-śāstra-kauśalaṃ, dharma-śikṣaṇa-samarthyaṃ, sādhanā-niratiṃ dadāti. Buddha-tejastulya-vyaktitvam.

BUDDHI_VIDYA_MERCURY_4.name: Buddhi-vidyā yoga — budhaḥ caturthe — viśleṣaṇa-śikṣā.
BUDDHI_VIDYA_MERCURY_4.prose: Buddhi-vidyā-yogaḥ budhaḥ caturthe yadi sva-ucca-mūlatrikoṇa-mitra-samasthāneṣu syāt, tadā prakhara-buddhiṃ tarka-śāstra-kauśalaṃ ca pradāti.

BUDHADITYA.name: Budhādityayogaḥ — sūrya-budhayoḥ ekarāśau yutiḥ. Buddhimattā, vākpaṭutā, rājamānyatā ca.
BUDHADITYA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekādaśe adhyāye varṇitam — sūrya-budhayoḥ ekasmin rāśau yutyā budhādityayogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ tīkṣṇabuddhiḥ, prakharavākpaṭuḥ, śāstrajñaḥ, rājapūjitaśca bhavati. Budhasya astaṅgatābhāve ayaṃ yogaḥ pūrṇaphalaṃ dadāti. Phaladīpikāyāṃ caturdaśe adhyāye ayameva śreṣṭhatamo rājayogaḥ prathamaṃ parigaṇitaḥ.
BUDHADITYA.general: Asādhāraṇa-buddhimattā, prakhara-vākpaṭutā, gaṇita-vijñāna-kauśalam, rājakīyā kīrtiḥ, uccaśikṣāprāptiḥ.

CHAKRA.name: Cakra yogaḥ — grahāḥ viṣama-bhāveṣu (1-3-5-7-9-11). Cakravartī-samarthyam.
CHAKRA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye cakra yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ viṣama-bhāveṣu (1-3-5-7-9-11) tiṣṭhanti. Cakravartī-samāna-samarthyaṃ, sarva-dig-vijayaṃ, rāja-rāja-yaśaṃ, aṣṭa-dikpālaka-kīrtiṃ dadāti.

CHAMARA.name: Cāmara yogaḥ — lagneśe sva-ucce kendre guru-dṛṣṭe ca — rāja-vaibhavam.
CHAMARA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye varṇitam — lagneśo sva-ucca-rāśau kendre saṃsthitaḥ, guruṇā dṛṣṭaścet cāmara-yogaḥ samajāyate. "Cāmaraṃ" rājacihnaṃ bhavati. Anena jātakaḥ dīrghāyuḥ, veda-śāstra-paṇḍitaḥ, rājā vā bhūpatitulyaḥ kīrtimān bhavati.

CHANDRA_LAGNA_KENDRA_BENEFIC.name: Candralagne kendre śubhagrahāḥ — candre lagne kendre śubhaiḥ yute — ākarṣaṇa-yaśaḥ.
CHANDRA_LAGNA_KENDRA_BENEFIC.prose: Candraḥ lagna-bhāve sthitaḥ syāt, candrāt kendre ca śubha-grahāḥ sthitāḥ bhaveyuḥ, tadā candra-lagna-kendra-śubha-yogaḥ phalayati. Anena jātakaḥ sudarśanaḥ, parama-ākarṣakaḥ, lokamānyaḥ, suhṛjjanasamarthitaśca bhavati.

CHANDRA_MANGAL.name: Candra-maṅgala yoga — candra-maṅgalayoḥ yutiḥ — mana-śakti-saṃyogaḥ.
CHANDRA_MANGAL.prose: Candra-maṅgala-yogo candraśca maṅgalaśca kasmiṃścid bhāve yadi sammilitau syātām, tadā mana-śaktiyoḥ yugapat-saṃyogāt vyāpārika-kauśala-sva-nirmita-sampadāṃ phalayati.

CHANDRA_MANGAL_DHANA.name: Candra-maṅgala dhana-yogaḥ — sampūrṇa-dhana-kāraka-saṃyogaḥ. Bahu-dhana-vardhanam.
CHANDRA_MANGAL_DHANA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye candra-maṅgala-dhana-yogaḥ — candra-maṅgala-yutyā vā paraspara-dṛṣṭyā sampūrṇa-dhana-kāraka-saṃyogena bahu-dhana-vardhanaṃ, sva-karmārjita-sampattiṃ, sāhasika-vyāpāra-kīrtiṃ dadāti. Śreṣṭha-dhana-yogānāṃ agragaṇyaḥ.

CHANDRA_TRIKONA_BENEFIC_ASPECT.name: Candra-trikoṇe śubhadṛṣṭiḥ — trikoṇasthe candre śubhaiḥ dṛṣṭe — mātṛkalyāṇam.
CHANDRA_TRIKONA_BENEFIC_ASPECT.prose: Candraḥ trikoṇa-bhāve (pañcame navame vā lagne) sthitaḥ san yadi śubha-grahaiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ syāt, tadā ayaṃ yogaḥ phalayati. Anena jātakaḥ paramadhārmikaḥ, mātṛbhaktaḥ, śāntamanāḥ, uttarottarasamṛddhiyuktaśca bhavati.

CHANDRA_VIDYA_MOON_4_OWN_EXALT.name: Candra-vidyā yoga — candraḥ caturthe sva/ucce — bhāva-saṃyukta-śikṣā.
CHANDRA_VIDYA_MOON_4_OWN_EXALT.prose: Candra-vidyā-yogaḥ candraḥ caturthe yadi sva-ucca-mūlatrikoṇeṣu syāt, tadā bhāva-gahana-vidyāṃ mātṛ-kalyāṇaṃ ca pradāti.

CHAPA.name: Cāpa yogaḥ — grahāḥ 10-1-2-3-4 krama bhāveṣu. Dhanuḥ-samāna-tīkṣṇa-karma.
CHAPA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye cāpa yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ 10-11-12-1-2-3-4 bhāveṣu krameṇa. Dhanuḥ-samānāṃ tīkṣṇa-karma, senā-śikāra-vṛttiṃ, bahu-śatrujayaṃ, dhana-vardhanaṃ ca dadāti.

CHAPA_PHALADEEPIKA.name: Cāpa yogaḥ (nāma) — maṅgala-guru-śukrāḥ kendratrikoṇe. Dhanuṣa-samāna-saṃhārakaḥ.
CHAPA_PHALADEEPIKA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye cāpa-yogaḥ — maṅgala-guru-śukrāḥ kendra-trikoṇayoḥ śubha-sthāne tiṣṭhantaḥ dhanuṣa-samāna-saṃhāra-śaktiṃ, bahu-śatrujayaṃ, sāhasa-vyāpāraṃ, senā-nāyakatvaṃ dadati. Na tu nābhasa-cāpa-yogaḥ.

CHATRA.name: Chatra yogaḥ — grahāḥ 7-8-9-10-11-12-1 bhāveṣu. Rāja-chatra-samānaṃ rakṣā.
CHATRA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye chatra yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ 7-8-9-10-11-12-1 bhāveṣu krameṇa. Rāja-chatra-samānāṃ rakṣā, rāja-kula-sambandhaṃ, sarva-dig-śubha-chāyā, ucca-rāja-sthānaṃ dadāti.

CHATUSSAGARA.name: Catussāgara yogaḥ — sarvaiḥ-kendreṣu grahāḥ. Catur-samudra-samānam.
CHATUSSAGARA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye catussāgara-yogaḥ — sarve grahāḥ caturṣu kendreṣu tiṣṭhanti (kutrāpi na-kendra-sthāne). Catur-samudra-samānāṃ sarva-dig-sampattiṃ, aṣṭa-dikpālaka-samarthyaṃ, cakravartī-tulyāṃ śaktiṃ dadāti. Śreṣṭhatama-rājayogaḥ.

CHIRANJIVI_KENDRA_BENEFICS.name: Kendre śubhagrahāḥ balī guruśukrau ca — amaratvatulyā dīrghāyuḥ.
CHIRANJIVI_KENDRA_BENEFICS.prose: Cirañjīvī-yogo śubhagrahāḥ kendreṣu sthitāḥ, guruśukrau ca svoccamitrarāśau balavān bhūtvā tiṣṭhetām, tadā asādhāraṇa-dīrghāyuḥ samajāyate.

DAGDHA_RASHI_DOSHA.name: Dagdha rāśi doṣaḥ — tithi-dagdha-rāśau graha-sthitiḥ. Graha-phala-nyūnatā.
DAGDHA_RASHI_DOSHA.prose: Jyotirvidyābharaṇe (muhūrta-cintāmaṇau ca) dagdha rāśi doṣaḥ — janma-tithi-anuguṇaṃ dvau rāśī dagdhau (yathā pratipadi tulā-makarau, ṣaṣṭhyāṃ meṣa-siṃhau). Tatra sthitasya sapta-grahāṇāṃ phala-nyūnatāṃ, karma-vighna-yogyatāṃ ca dadāti. Rāśi-svāmi-prasādanena śamanam.

DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_6_12.name: Dainyaparivartanayogaḥ (6-12) — ṣaṣṭheśadvādaśeśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — vyayakleśasambandhaḥ.
DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_6_12.prose: Ṣaṣṭhādhipatiḥ dvādaśabhāve tathā dvādaśādhipatiḥ ṣaṣṭhabhāve yadā parasparaṃ rāśiparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā dainyaparivartanayogaḥ (6-12) phalayati. Anena śatrujanitavyayaḥ, dīrghakālīnaṛṇa, guptaśatrutaḥ pīḍā, videśe ca kleśādikaṃ labhyate. (Phaladīpikā adhyāya 13)

DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_6_8.name: Dainyaparivartanayogaḥ (6-8) — ṣaṣṭheśāṣṭameśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — kleśasambandhaḥ.
DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_6_8.prose: Yadā ṣaṣṭhādhipatiḥ aṣṭamabhāve tathā aṣṭamādhipatiḥ ṣaṣṭhabhāve parasparaṃ rāśiparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā dainyaparivartanayogaḥ (6-8) samajāyate. Ayaṃ yogaḥ viparītarājayogavat śubhaprado na bhavati, apitu dusthānasvāminoḥ parasparavinimayena jātakasya śatrurogaṛṇādīnāṃ kleśātmakatāṃ cirasthāyinīṃ karoti. (Phaladīpikā adhyāya 13)

DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_8_12.name: Dainyaparivartanayogaḥ (8-12) — aṣṭameśadvādaśeśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — vilopasambandhaḥ.
DAINYA_PARIVARTANA_8_12.prose: Yadā aṣṭamādhipatiḥ dvādaśabhāve tathā dvādaśādhipatiḥ aṣṭamabhāve parasparaṃ rāśiparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā dainyaparivartanayogaḥ (8-12) sampadyate. Ayaṃ yogaḥ jātakasya ekākitvaṃ, guptakāryāṇi, sādhanābalaṃ ca phalayati, kintu bhautikasampadāṃ vināśaṃ samāje viyogaṃ ca janayati. (Phaladīpikā adhyāya 13)

DAMA.name: Dāma yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ ṣaṭ-rāśiṣu. Dambha-vṛttiḥ, bahu-karmaṇyaḥ.
DAMA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye dāma yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ ṣaṭ-rāśiṣu sthitāḥ jātakaṃ dambha-vṛttiṃ, bahu-karmaṇyaṃ, śreṇī-baddha-vyavahāraṃ, sama-dhana-saṅgrahiṇaṃ ca kurvanti. Dāman-samānāṃ sambaddha-karma-śṛṅkhalā.

DAMINI.name: Dāminī yogaḥ — grahāḥ antarikṣa-bhāveṣu (10-11-12-1). Vidyut-samāna-tejaḥ.
DAMINI.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye dāminī yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ antarikṣa-samāna-śīrṣa-bhāveṣu (10-11-12-1). Vidyut-samāna-tejaḥ, akalpita-karma-yaśaṃ, sahasā-sammānaṃ, camaka-samānaṃ adbhuta-vyaktitvaṃ dadāti.

DANDA.name: Daṇḍa yogaḥ (nāma) — śaniḥ kendra-trikoṇe ucca-dṛṣṭa-śubha. Daṇḍadhara-tulyam.
DANDA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye daṇḍa-nāma-yogaḥ — śaniḥ kendra-trikoṇayoḥ ucca-sva-rāśiṣu śubha-dṛṣṭaḥ san daṇḍadhara-rāja-tulyāṃ śāsana-śaktiṃ, nyāya-vyavahāraṃ, cira-kālika-adhikāra-sthānaṃ, ucca-pada-sthairyaṃ dadāti. Na tu nābhasa-daṇḍākṛti-yogaḥ.

DANDA_AKRITI.name: Daṇḍa yogaḥ — grahāḥ 10-11-12-1 bhāveṣu krameṇa. Daṇḍa-samāna-śāstā.
DANDA_AKRITI.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye daṇḍa yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ karma-lābha-vyaya-tanu-bhāveṣu krameṇa. Daṇḍa-samānāṃ śāsana-karma, nyāya-vyavahāraṃ, adhikāra-sthānaṃ dadāti. Rājā-daṇḍadhara-vat vyaktitvam.

DARIDRA_11_12.name: Daridrayogaḥ — ekādaśeśo dvādaśabhāve — lābhavyayasaṃyogaḥ.
DARIDRA_11_12.prose: Yadā lābheśo dvādaśabhāve (vyayabhāve) tiṣṭhati, tadā arjitaṃ dhanaṃ śīghrameva vyayamupaiti, sañcayaśca duṣkaro bhavati. Videśayātrā, dānam, vilāsitā ca vyayasya kāraṇāni bhavanti. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — ekādaśeśasya japapūjā, nityaṃ vyayasantulanam, dānapravṛttiḥ ca śubhā.

DARIDRA_11_6.name: Daridrayogaḥ — ekādaśeśo ṣaṣṭhabhāve — lābhaśatrusambandhaḥ.
DARIDRA_11_6.prose: Yadā lābheśaḥ ṣaṣṭhabhāve (ripubhāve) tiṣṭhati, tadā daridrayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya āyapravāhaḥ sevākāryaiḥ, cikitsākṣetraiḥ, nyāyavivādādibhiḥ vā śatrusaṅgharṣaiḥ sambaddho bhavati. Vāraṃvāraṃ ṛṇagrastatā, alpā ca āyaḥ sadyovyayamupaiti. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — ekādaśeśasya japapūjā, ni:svārthabhāvayuktaṃ sevādānaṃ ca kalyāṇapradaṃ bhavati.

DARIDRA_11_8.name: Daridrayogaḥ — ekādaśeśo'ṣṭamabhāve — lābhavināśasambandhaḥ.
DARIDRA_11_8.prose: Yadā lābheśo'ṣṭamabhāve (randhrabhāve) tiṣṭhati, tadā āyapravāhe ākasmikavighnāḥ utpadyante. Gūḍhavijñānam, uttarādhikāraḥ, bīmākṣetrādibhiḥ vā āyaḥ sambhavati, parantu sadyaḥ vināśasyāpi bhayaṃ vartate. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — ekādaśeśasya śāntiḥ, vighnahartuḥ gaṇeśasya nirantarārādhanā ca śubhā.

DARIDRA_11_LORD_DEBIL_DUSTHANA.name: Daridrayogaḥ — ekādaśeśo nīce duḥsthāne ca — gambhīranirdhanatā vyāpāravighātaśca.
DARIDRA_11_LORD_DEBIL_DUSTHANA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 13 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā lābheśaḥ ekādaśeśaḥ svanīcarāśau tiṣṭhati, yugapat trikabhāve (6, 8, 12) ca sthito bhavati, tadā gambhīro daridrayogo jāyate. Lābhakārakasya ayaṃ dvi-doṣa-saṃyogaḥ jātakasya āyamārgaṃ samyak nāśayati, vyāpāraṃ ca vināśayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — ekādaśeśaśāntiḥ, bṛhalakṣmīhomaḥ, śrīsūktanityapāṭhaḥ ca.

DARIDRA_11_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Daridrayogaḥ — ekādaśeśo duḥsthāne — lābhapratibandhaḥ iṣṭasiddhibādhā ca.
DARIDRA_11_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 34 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā lābheśaḥ ekādaśeśaḥ ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśabhāveṣu tiṣṭhati, tadā daridrayogo jāyate. Lābhakārakasya duḥsthāne sthityā jātakasya apekṣitalābhaḥ samaye na prāpyate, mitrāṇāṃ sahayogaśca hīyate. Pariyojanāsu vāraṃvāraṃ vighnāḥ bhavanti. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — ekādaśeśaśāntiḥ, sūryopāsanā ca śubhā.

DARIDRA_2_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Daridrayogaḥ — dvitīyeśo duḥsthāne — dhanakośapīḍā sañcayabādhā ca.
DARIDRA_2_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 34 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā dhanabhāvasya svāmī dvitīyeśaḥ ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśabhāveṣu tiṣṭhati, tadā daridrayogo jāyate. Dhanakārakasya duḥsthāne sthityā jātakasya dhanasañcaye gambhīrabādhā bhavati, āyasattve'pi kośaḥ sadyaḥ śūnyībhavati. Kauṭumbikakalahaḥ, vāṇīdoṣaśca sambhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — dvitīyeśaśāntiḥ, mahālakṣmīpūjanam, guruvāravratam ca śubhapradam.

DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_6_LORD.name: Daridrayogaḥ — dvitīyeśaḥ ṣaṣṭheśena yutaḥ — dhanaśatrusaṃyogaḥ.
DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_6_LORD.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 13 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā dvitīyeśaḥ ṣaṣṭheśena saha kasmiṃścid bhāve yuto bhavati, tadā daridrayogo jāyate. Dhanakārakasya rogaśatrukārakeṇa saha yutiḥ jātakasya dhanaṃ sīdhā roga-ṛṇa-nyāyavivādādiṣu vyayīkaroti. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — dvitīyeśa-ṣaṣṭheśayoḥ śāntiḥ, hanumadupāsanā ca śubhā.

DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_8_LORD.name: Daridrayogaḥ — dvitīyeśaḥ aṣṭameśena yutaḥ — dhanavināśasaṃyogaḥ.
DARIDRA_2_LORD_WITH_8_LORD.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 13 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā dvitīyeśaḥ aṣṭameśena saha kasmiṃścid bhāve yuto bhavati, tadā daridrayogo jāyate. Dhanakārakasya mṛtyuparivartanakārakeṇa saha saṃyogaḥ dhanasañcaye ākasmikavighātaṃ janayati. Coryāt, durghaṭanāvaśāt vā dhanahāniḥ sambhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — dvitīyeśa-aṣṭameśayoḥ śāntiḥ, gaṇeśopāsanā ca śubhā.

DARIDRA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Daridrayogaḥ — navameśo duḥsthāne — purvapuṇyabhāgyabādhā paitṛkaviyogaśca.
DARIDRA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 13 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā bhāgyeśaḥ navameśaḥ ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśabhāveṣu tiṣṭhati, tadā daridrayogo jāyate. Bhāgyakārakasya duḥsthāne sthityā jātakasya pūrvajanmakṛtapuṇyaṃ dhanarūpe pariṇataṃ na bhavati. Kaṭhināvasthāyāṃ bhāgyodayo na jāyate, pitṛsukhamapi hīyate. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — navameśaśāntiḥ, guru-sūryopāsanā, pitṛtarpaṇaṃ ca.

DARIDRA_CHANDRA.name: Daridra yoga (candra) — candro duṣṭāne — mana-daurbalya-daridratā.
DARIDRA_CHANDRA.prose: Daridra-candra-yogo candro duṣṭāna-bhāve (ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-vyaye) yadi syāt, tadā bhāvanātmaka-vittīya-daurbalya-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati. Yadi candraḥ ucce (vṛṣe) svarāśau (karke) vā syāt, tadā raddaḥ.

DARIDRA_DOSHA.name: Daridra doṣaḥ — dvitīyeśa/lābheśa-daurbalyaṃ vā duṣṭa-saṃyogaḥ. Dhana-nyūnatā.
DARIDRA_DOSHA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye daridra doṣaḥ — dvitīyeśa-vā-lābheśa-daurbalyaṃ (duṣṭa-sthāna-sthitiḥ, astaṅgatatvaṃ vā krūra-saṃyogaḥ) dhana-nyūnatāṃ, nirantara-ārthika-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ, ṛṇa-vardhanaṃ dadāti. Daridra-yogasya doṣa-rūpam — daridrā-yu-yu-pīḍā-kārakatvam.
DARIDRA_DOSHA.general: Dhana-nyūnatā, nirantara ārthika kaṣṭa, ṛṇa-vardhana yogyatā.

DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_12_DEBIL.name: Daridrayogaḥ — lagneśo dvādaśe nīcarāśau — mūlagatanirdhanatā ātmaśaktihrāsaśca.
DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_12_DEBIL.prose: Sārāvalyām 40 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā tanupatiḥ lagneśaḥ dvādaśabhāve svanīcarāśau tiṣṭhati, tadā daridrāniṣṭayogo jāyate. Ātmakārakasya lagneśasya vyayabhāve nīcatvaṃ jātakasya mūlajīvanaśaktiṃ dhanasañcayayogyatāṃ ca vināśayati. Svayannirṇayavaśāt vināśo bhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — lagneśamantrajapaḥ, iṣṭadevopāsanā, dānaṃ ca śubhāḥ.

DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_WITH_12_LORD.name: Daridrayogaḥ — lagneśaḥ dvādaśeśena yutaḥ — ātmavyayasaṃyogaḥ vilāsitāpravṛttiśca.
DARIDRA_LAGNA_LORD_WITH_12_LORD.prose: Sārāvalyām 40 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā lagneśaḥ dvādaśeśena saha kasmiṃścid bhāve yuto bhavati, tadā daridrayogo jāyate. Ātmakārakasya vyayakārakeṇa saha saṃyogaḥ jātakasya vyaktigatapravṛttiṃ vyayonmukhīṃ karoti. Vilāsitāyām, dānakāryādiṣu jātakaḥ dhanaṃ sadyaḥ vyayīkaroti. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — lagneśa-dvādaśeśayoḥ śāntiḥ, dhyānasādhanā ca.

DARIDRA_LAKSHMI_BHANGA.name: Daridrayogaḥ — lakṣmībhaṅgaḥ — lābhabhāvasya śukrasya ca pāpaveṣṭanam.
DARIDRA_LAKSHMI_BHANGA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 13 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā lābhabhāvaḥ ekādaśabhāvaḥ lakṣmīkārakaḥ śukraśca yugapat pāpagrahaiḥ dūṣitau bhavataḥ, tadā lakṣmībhaṅgayogo jāyate. Lakṣmīpravāhaḥ mūlataḥ avaruddhaḥ bhavati, jātakasya udyamaśīlatā saphalā na jāyate, anugrahita-avasarāśca naṣṭāḥ bhavanti. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — lakṣmīpūjanam, śrīsūktapāṭhaḥ, śukraśāntiḥ ca.

DARIDRA_MOON_SATURN_12.name: Daridrayogaḥ — candraśanī dvādaśabhāve — mānasikatanāvaḥ nidrānāśaḥ vyayavardhanaṃ ca.
DARIDRA_MOON_SATURN_12.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 13 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā manaḥkārakaścandraḥ duḥkhakārakeṇa śaninā saha dvādaśabhāve (vyayabhāve) yuto bhavati, tadā daridrayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya nidrā gambhīrabādhitā bhavati, manasi satatavittīyacintā, videśe vā guptasthāne dhanavyayo jāyate. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — candraśanyoḥ śāntiḥ, somavāraśanivāravratam ca.

DARIDRA_SARVA_MALEFIC_KENDRA.name: Daridrayogaḥ — sarve pāpagrahāḥ kendrasthāneṣu — sarvatoveṣṭanam ādhāradaurbalyaṃ ca.
DARIDRA_SARVA_MALEFIC_KENDRA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 13 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā krūrāḥ pāpagrahāḥ (śani-bhauma-rāhu-ketavaḥ) sarve kendrabhāveṣu (1, 4, 7, 10) tiṣṭhanti, tadā daridrayogo jāyate. Kendrāṇi jīvanasya ādhārastambhāḥ; anayoḥ pāpena veṣṭanāt jātakasya vyaktitvaṃ, gṛhasukham, vyāpāraḥ, karma ca sarvatoveṣṭitaṃ bhavati, yena vittavṛddhiḥ bādhitā jāyate. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — navagrahaśāntiḥ, hanumadupāsanā ca śubhā.

DARIDRA_TRIKA_LUMINARY.name: Daridrayogaḥ — sūryacandrau trikasthāneṣu — ātmabaladaurbalyaṃ mānasikakaṣṭaṃ ca.
DARIDRA_TRIKA_LUMINARY.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 13 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā sūryaḥ (ātmākārakaḥ) candraśca (manaḥkārakaḥ) dvau yugapat trikabhāveṣu (6, 8, 12) tiṣṭhataḥ, tadā daridrayogo jāyate. Prakāśakayoḥ durbalatvāt jātakasya ātmabalam, manobalam, śārīrikaśaktiśca hīyate. Vāraṃvāraṃ svāsthyavyayo bhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — sūryacandrayoḥ śāntiḥ, gāyatrījapaḥ caṃ kalyāṇakārī.

DHANA_2_11_KENDRA.name: Dhanayogaḥ — dvitīya-ekādaśeśayoḥ kendrasthāne sthitiḥ — sañcaya-lābhayoḥ paramaḥ saṃyogaḥ.
DHANA_2_11_KENDRA.prose: Asya dhanayogasya nirmāṇaṃ tadā bhavati yadā dvitīyeśaḥ (sañcayādhipatiḥ) ekādaśeśaḥ (lābhādhipatiḥ) ca ubhau janmakuṇḍalyāṃ śubhakendrabhāveṣu (1, 4, 7, 10) virājitau bhavetām. Dhanasañcayakārakasya lābhakārakasya ca grahasya kendrasthāne sahasā avasthityā jātakasya jīvane āya-vyayayoḥ santulanaṃ, sañcayakṣamatāyāḥ sudṛḍhatvaṃ, dīrghakālikī ca samṛddhiḥ samajāyate. Jātakaḥ vyāpārikakṣetre saphalo bhūtvā anekavidhamārgebhyaḥ dhanārjanaṃ karoti. Sambaddhagrahayoḥ daśā-antardaśākāle ayaṃ yogaḥ pūrṇarūpeṇa phalayati.

DHANA_5_9_KENDRA.name: Lakṣmīyogaḥ — pañcama-navameśayoḥ kendrasthāne avasthitiḥ — paramabhāgyasāmrājyayogaḥ.
DHANA_5_9_KENDRA.prose:
Lakṣmīyogaḥ — phaladīpikāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhamadhyāyānusāram. Yadā pūrvapuṇyabhāveśaḥ pañcameśaḥ paramabhāgyabhāveśaḥ navameśaśca ubhau janmakuṇḍalyāṃ balavati kendrabhāve (1, 4, 7, 10) pratiṣṭhitau syātām, tadā eṣaḥ mahāyogaḥ samajāyate. Trikoṇadvayasya adhipatibhyāṃ śubhakendreṣu kṛtaḥ ayaṃ sambandhaḥ sākṣāt bhagavatyāḥ mahālakṣmyāḥ anugrahaṃ śāstrīyadṛṣṭyā sūcayati.

Anena yogena jātakaḥ pūrvajanmakṛtasukṛtānāṃ phalarūpeṇa akasmāt aiśvaryaṃ, dharmasammataṃ dhanaṃ, nirantarābhyudayaṃ, samāje asādhāraṇaṃ yaśaśca prāpnoti. Kevalaṃ bhautikasampattireva na, apitu jīvanasya uccaguṇavattā, dharmaparāyaṇatā, dīrghāyuṣyaṃ ca asya phalāni santi. Sambaddhagrahayoḥ śubhadaśāsu ayaṃ yogaḥ jātakaṃ bhūpatitulyaṃ samṛddhaṃ karoti.

DHANA_JUPITER_2_5.name: Dhanayogaḥ — devaguruḥ dvitīyabhāve pañcamabhāve vā — devaguruprasādalabdhadhanayogaḥ.
DHANA_JUPITER_2_5.prose:
Guru-dhanayogaḥ — jātakapārijātasya pañcamādhyāyānusāram. Yadā devaguruḥ bṛhaspatiḥ — yaḥ samṛddheḥ sukhasya ca naisargikakārakaḥ vartate — janmakuṇḍalyāḥ dvitīyabhāve (dhanasañcayasthāne) athavā pañcamabhāve (pūrvapuṇyajñānādisthāne) virājamānaḥ bhavati, tadā eṣaḥ śubhayogaḥ utpadyate. Naisargikaśubhatvayuktaḥ guruḥ dhanabhāve svaprabhāveṇa kauṭumbikasampadaṃ paitṛkavirāsataṃ ca vardhayati, pañcamabhāve ca jātakasya prajñābalena pūrvapuṇyaprasādena ca dhanasiddhiṃ karoti.

Jātakaḥ jīvane mandagatyā paraṃ sthirarūpeṇa dhanārjanaṃ karoti. Atra dhanalābhaḥ ākrāmakapravṛttyā na, apitu dharmasammatamārgeṇa, jñānavistāreṇa, śikṣaṇa-parāmarśa-mantraṇādinā ca bhavati. Sambaddhadaśāsu jātakaḥ mahatīṃ kīrtiṃ śriyaṃ ca labhate.

DHANA_PARIVARTANA_1_2.name: Dhanaparivartanayogaḥ (1-2) — lagneśa-dvitīyeśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — ātmanaḥ dhanasya ca sudṛḍhaḥ saṃyogaḥ.
DHANA_PARIVARTANA_1_2.prose:
Lagna-dvitīyeśa-parivartanayogaḥ — bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstrasya catvāriṃśadadhyāyānusāram. Yadā tanubhāveśaḥ lagneśaḥ dvitīyabhāve (dhanasthāne) tathā dvitīyeśaḥ lagnabhāve parasparaṃ gṛhavinimayaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā eṣaḥ viśiṣṭayogaḥ jāyate. Ātmanaḥ (lagneśasya) dhanasya (dvitīyeśasya) ca ayam anyonyasambandhaḥ jātakasya vyaktitvaṃ tasya ārthikasthitiṃ ca ekātmakarūpeṇa badhnāti.

Asya yogasya prabhāveṇa jātakasya vyaktitvameva dhanārjanaṃ mukhyasādhanaṃ bhavati. Jātakaḥ svīyakauśalena, ātmaprabhāveṇa, svakīyena pariśrameṇa ca vipulaṃ dhanaṃ sampādayati. Tasya kṛte dhanaṃ na kevalaṃ bāhyasādhanaṃ, apitu tasya ātmasvarūpasya vistāra iva bhāsate. Vaiyaktika-kīrtiḥ, svataḥ-dhanasampadā-ākarṣaṇaṃ, kauṭumbikasampadaḥ saṃrakṣaṇakṣamatā ca asya pramukhāṇi phalāni santi. Sambaddhadaśāsu ayaṃ yogaḥ jātakasya pratiṣṭhāṃ śriyaṃ ca yugapat vardhayati.

DHANA_PARIVARTANA_2_11.name: Dhanaparivartanayogaḥ — dvitīya-ekādaśeśayoḥ parasparakṣetravinimayaḥ — paramamahādhanayogaḥ.
DHANA_PARIVARTANA_2_11.prose:
Dhanaparivartanayogaḥ — bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstrasya catvāriṃśadadhyāyānusāram. Yadā dvitīyeśaḥ (sañcayādhipatiḥ) ekādaśabhāve tathā ekādaśeśaḥ (lābhādhipatiḥ) dvitīyabhāve parasparaṃ gṛhavinimayaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā eṣaḥ atyantaśaktiśālī parivartanayogaḥ udbhavati. Rāśiparivartanena ubhayoḥ bhāvayoḥ kārakatatvāni (sañcayaḥ lābhaśca) pūrṇarūpeṇa ekīkṛtya parasparaṃ śaktiṃ saṃvardhayataḥ.

Asya yogasya prabhāveṇa jātakasya jīvane dhanasañcayasya āyapravāhasya ca abhūtapūrvaḥ cakravyūhaḥ nirmīyate. Yatkimapi jātakaḥ arjayati, tat tatkṣaṇameva sañcitaṃ bhavati; sañcitaṃ dhanaṃ ca punaḥ nūtanam āyasrotaṃ janayati. Vyāpārikasāmrājyanirmāṇāya, vyāvasāyikasaphalatāyai, kulaparamparāprāptasampadaśca kṛte ayaṃ sarvotkṛṣṭaḥ yogaḥ vartate. Sambaddhadaśāsu ayaṃ yogaḥ jātakaṃ kuberatulaṃ dhaninaṃ karoti.

DHANA_VENUS_2.name: Dhanayogaḥ — śukro dvitīyabhāve — kalā-vilāsitā-saundaryalabdhaiśvaryayogaḥ.
DHANA_VENUS_2.prose:
Śaukra-dhanayogaḥ — sārāvalyāḥ ekaviṃśatyadhyāyānusāram. Yadā kalā-vilāsitā-saundaryāṇāṃ naisargikakārakaḥ śukraḥ janmakuṇḍalyāḥ dvitīyabhāve (dhanasañcayasthāne) avasthito bhavati, tadā ayaṃ yogaḥ phalayati. Śukrasya saumya-bhogapravṛttiḥ yadā dhanabhāvena sambaddhā bhavati, tadā jātakaḥ lalitakalā, vilāsitā-sāmagrī, vastra-ābhūṣaṇa-saundaryaprasādhanavyāpāreṇa pracuraṃ dhanaṃ labhate.

Jātakasya jīvane ārthikasamṛddhiḥ kevalaṃ puruṣārthena na, apitu kalātmakakauśalena, saundaryabodhena, vaivāhikajīvanasya śubhasaṃyogena ca pravartate. Asya yogasya prabhāveṇa vaivāhikajīvanottaraṃ mahatī bhāgyavṛddhiḥ sambhavati. Sambaddhadaśāsu jātakaḥ sukhasādhanayuktaṃ vilāsitāpūrṇaṃ jīvanaṃ yāpayati.

DHENU.name: Dhenu yogaḥ — candraḥ dvitīye śubha-graha-dṛṣṭaḥ. Bahu-dhana-godhanam.
DHENU.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye dhenu-yogaḥ — candro dvitīya-sthāne śubha-graha-dṛṣṭaḥ san kāmadhenu-tulyāṃ sampattiṃ, bahu-dhanaṃ, go-dhana-samarthyaṃ, sva-kuṭumba-poṣaṇaṃ dadāti. Dugdha-vyāpāra-vā-kṛṣi-karma-yogyatā.

DHWAJA.name: Dhvajayogaḥ — dvitīyeśa-lābheśau kendre śubhagrahasaṃyutau. Dhvajasamānamuccayaśaḥ.
DHWAJA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye varṇitam — yadā dvitīyeśaḥ lābheśaśca ekatra kendre śubhagrahaiḥ saha santiṣṭhataḥ, tadā dhvajayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya yaśaḥ gagane dhvaja (ketu) iva sarvaiḥ dṛśyate. Jātakaḥ sthiralakṣmīvān, prakhyātakīrtiḥ, jananāyakaśca bhavati.

DURUDHARA.name: Durudharā yogaḥ — candrasya ubhayataḥ grahāṇāṃ sthitiḥ — mahābalapradaḥ.
DURUDHARA.prose: Sūryaṃ rāhuṃ ketuṃ ca varjayitvā yadi candrāt dvitīya-dvādaśa-bhāvayoḥ grahāḥ sthitāḥ bhaveyuḥ, tadā durudharā-yogaḥ phalayati. Anena jātakaḥ ubhayataḥ samarthitaḥ, sukhī, kulīnaḥ, sarvaguṇasampannaśca jāyate.

DURUDHURA_STRICT.name: Durudhurā yoga (kaṭhora) — śubha-grahau candrāt 2-12 — pūrṇa-saṃrakṣaṇa-yogaḥ.
DURUDHURA_STRICT.prose: Durudhurā-yogaḥ (kaṭhora-tiryak) candrāt dvitīya-dvādaśa-bhāvayoḥ śubha-grahau yadi sthitau syātām, tadā tri-tiryak-yogānāṃ pūrṇa-saṃrakṣaṇa-tiryak-samṛddhiṃ phalayati.

DUR_BHAGYA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA_DEBIL.name: Durbhāgyayogaḥ — navameśo duḥsthāne nīce vā — bhāgyapratibandhaḥ pitṛpīḍā ca.
DUR_BHAGYA_9_LORD_DUSTHANA_DEBIL.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā bhāgyabhāvasya svāmī navameśaḥ ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśabhāveṣu nīcarāśau vā tiṣṭhati, tadā durbhāgyayogo jāyate. Bhāgyakārakasya durbalatvāt jātakasya jīvane mahatsu avasareṣu akasmāt vighnāḥ āgacchanti, pitṛkalyāṇaṃ bādhyate, dharmamārge ca saṃśayo jāyate. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — guru-sūryopāsanā, gāyatrījapaḥ, pitṛtarpaṇaṃ ca kalyāṇapradam.

DUR_BHAGYA_JUPITER_DEBIL_LAGNA_OR_9.name: Durbhāgyayogaḥ — gururnīco lagne navame vā — dharmadarśanabādhā vivekanāśaśca.
DUR_BHAGYA_JUPITER_DEBIL_LAGNA_OR_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā naisargikaśubhaḥ devaguruḥ bṛhaspatiḥ svanīcarāśau (makare) lagne navame vā tiṣṭhati, tadā durbhāgyayogo jāyate. Dharma-bhāgyakārako guruḥ nīco bhūtvā jātakasya vicāraśaktiṃ, nirṇayakṣamatāṃ, gurubhaktiṃ ca dūṣayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — gurugāyatrījapaḥ, gurusevā, satsaṅgaḥ ca kalyāṇāya.

DUR_BHAGYA_RAHU_9.name: Durbhāgyayogaḥ — rāhurnavamabhāve — dharmabhramaḥ bhāgyadiśānāśaśca.
DUR_BHAGYA_RAHU_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā rāhuḥ navamabhāve (dharmabhāve) tiṣṭhati, tadā durbhāgyayogo jāyate. Chāyāgrahaḥ rāhuḥ bhāgyabhāvaṃ grastaṃ kṛtvā pāramparikadharmamārgāt vicyutiṃ janayati, anaitikamārgaiḥ bhāgyodayaṃ kartuṃ prerayati. Videśayātrāsu vighnāḥ bhavanti. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — rāhuśāntiḥ, sarasvatīpūjanam, gurudīkṣā ca śubhā.

DUR_BHAGYA_SUN_KETU_9.name: Durbhāgyayogaḥ — sūryaketū navamabhāve — pitṛdoṣaḥ dharmanāśaśca.
DUR_BHAGYA_SUN_KETU_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā sūryaḥ ketuśca yugapat navamabhāve (pitṛbhāve) tiṣṭhataḥ, tadā durbhāgyayogo (pitṛdoṣaḥ) jāyate. Sūryaḥ pitṛkārakaḥ, ketuḥ mokṣakārakaḥ vicchedanakārakaśca; anayoḥ dharmabhāve sthitiḥ pitṛsukhaṃ nāśayati, paitṛkasampattau vivādaṃ janayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — gayāśrāddham, pitṛtarpaṇam, sūryaketuśāntiḥ ca śubhā.

DUR_KARMA_10_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Durkarmayogaḥ —  daśameśo duḥsthāne — karmayaśavighnaḥ pratiṣṭhānāśaśca.
DUR_KARMA_10_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā karmabhāvasya svāmī daśameśaḥ ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśabhāveṣu tiṣṭhati, tadā durkarmayogo jāyate. Karmakārakasya duḥsthāne sthityā jātakasya ājīvikāyāṃ nirantaraṃ vighnāḥ āgacchanti, adhikāribhiḥ saha saṅgharṣaḥ, yaśohāniśca jāyate. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — sūrya-śaniśāntiḥ,  karmānuṣṭhānaṃ ca śubhadam.

DUR_KARMA_10_LORD_NEECHA_RETRO.name: Durkarmayogaḥ —  daśameśo nīco vakrī — karmavyutkramaḥ yojanāviparītapariṇāmaśca.
DUR_KARMA_10_LORD_NEECHA_RETRO.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā daśameśaḥ svanīcarāśau tiṣṭhati  yugapat vakrī ca bhavati, tadā durkarmayogo jāyate. Nīcatvāt karmakauśalaṃ hīnam̐ bhavati, vakragatyā ca karmaphalāni ulṭo-diśāyāṃ gacchanti. Sarvayojanāḥ viparītāḥ bhavanti. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — karmeśaśāntiḥ, sūrya-śani-gurūpāsanā ca.

DUR_KARMA_SATURN_RAHU_10.name: Durkarmayogaḥ —  śanirāhū daśamabhāve — cirakarmavighnaḥ kāryālayarājanītiśca.
DUR_KARMA_SATURN_RAHU_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā śaniśca rāhuśca yugapat  daśamabhāve (karmabhāve) tiṣṭhataḥ, tadā gambhīraḥ durkarmayogo jāyate. Śaniḥ vilambakārakaḥ, rāhuḥ bhrama-Disruption kārakaḥ; anayoḥ karmasthāne yutiḥ jātakasya kariyarakṣetre varṣau saṅgharṣaṃ, kāryālayarājanītiṃ, pratiṣṭhānāśaṃ ca phalayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — śanirāhuśāntiḥ, hanumadupāsanā ca.

DUR_KARMA_SUN_DEBIL_10.name: Durkarmayogaḥ —  sūryo nīco daśamabhāve — adhikāradaurbalyaṃ pitṛpīḍā ca.
DUR_KARMA_SUN_DEBIL_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā karmakārako sūryaḥ svanīcarāśau (tulāyām) daśamabhāve tiṣṭhati, tadā gambhīraḥ durkarmayogo jāyate. Sūryaḥ adhikārasya yaśasaḥ ca kārakaḥ; tasya karmabhāve nīcatvaṃ jātakasya śāsakīyakāryāṇi bādhayati, bubāsam̐ga matabhedaṃ, ātma-viśvāsakamīṃ ca phalayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — sūryanamaskāraḥ, gāyatrījapaḥ,  tāmradānaṃ ca.

DUR_PUTRA_5_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Durputrayogaḥ — pañcameśo duḥsthāne — santānabādhā pūrvapuṇyahrāsaśca.
DUR_PUTRA_5_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā pañcameśaḥ (putrapatiḥ) ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśabhāveṣu tiṣṭhati, tadā durputrayogo jāyate. Santāna-buddhi-pūrvapuṇyakārako pañcameśaḥ duḥsthāne durbalo bhūtvā garbhadhāraṇakaṭhināīṃ, santānavilambaṃ, buddhidaurbalyaṃ ca phalayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — santānagopālastotram, guruśāntiḥ ca.

DUR_PUTRA_JUPITER_KETU_5.name: Durputrayogaḥ —  guruketū pañcamabhāve — santānagrahaṇadoṣaḥ vairāgyapravṛttiśca.
DUR_PUTRA_JUPITER_KETU_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā naisargikaputrakārako guruḥ ketunā saha pañcamabhāve yuto bhavati, tadā durputrayogo (grahaṇadoṣaḥ) jāyate. Ketuḥ mokṣakārako vicchedakaśca; saḥ guruṃ grastaṃ kṛtvā santānaprāptau gambhīrabādhāṃ, santānaprati vairāgyabhāvaṃ vā bālyakāle tasya svāsthyasaṅkaṭaṃ janayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — gurugāyatrījapaḥ, ketuśāntiḥ ca.

DUR_SAHAJA_3_HEMMED_MALEFICS.name: Dursahajayogaḥ —  tṛtīyabhāve pāpakartarīyogaḥ — parākramaveṣṭanaṃ sañcārabādhā ca.
DUR_SAHAJA_3_HEMMED_MALEFICS.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā tṛtīyabhāvasya ubhayatoḥ dvitīya-caturthabhāveṣu  pāpagrahāḥ tiṣṭhanti, tadā tṛtīyabhāvaḥ pāpakartarīveṣṭito bhavati. Anena parākramagṛhaṃ pīḍitaṃ bhūtvā jātakasya pahalaśaktiṃ gṛhavātāvaraṇena damanaṃ karoti, bhrātṛkleśaṃ ca phalayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — tṛtīyeśabalavardhanam,  pāpagrahaśāntiḥ ca.

DUR_SAHAJA_3_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Dursahajayogaḥ —  tṛtīyeśo duḥsthāne — parākramadaurbalyaṃ bhrātṛkleśaśca.
DUR_SAHAJA_3_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā parākramabhāvasya svāmī tṛtīyeśaḥ  ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśabhāveṣu tiṣṭhati, tadā dursahajayogo jāyate. Parākramakārakasya duḥsthāne sthityā jātakasya āntarikasāhasaḥ, pahalaśaktiśca hīyate. Anujabhrātṛbhiḥ saha vaicārikamatabhedaḥ, laghuyātrāsu vighnāśca jāyante. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — maṅgalaśāntiḥ, hanumadupāsanā ca śubhā.

DUR_SAHAJA_MARS_DEBIL_3.name: Dursahajayogaḥ —  maṅgalo nīcastṛtīye — parākramakārakadūṣaṇaṃ śauryahīnatvaṃ ca.
DUR_SAHAJA_MARS_DEBIL_3.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā naisargikaparākramakārako maṅgalaḥ svanīcarāśau (karke) tṛtīyabhāve tiṣṭhati, tadā dursahajayogo jāyate. Maṅgalaḥ śauryasya naisargikasvāmī; tasya tṛtīye nīcatvaṃ jātakasya śārīrikaśauryaṃ, kṣamāśīlatāṃ ca dūṣayati, anujaiḥ saha kalahaṃ ca janayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — maṅgalaśāntiḥ, subrahmaṇyopāsanā ca.

DUR_SAMBANDHA_7_HEMMED_MALEFICS.name: Dursambandhayogaḥ — saptamabhāve pāpakartarīyogaḥ — dāmpatyaveṣṭanam.
DUR_SAMBANDHA_7_HEMMED_MALEFICS.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā saptamabhāvasya ubhayatoḥ ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭamabhāveṣu pāpagrahāḥ tiṣṭhanti, tadā saptamabhāvaḥ pāpakartarīveṣṭito bhavati. Anena sambandhagṛhaṃ pīḍitaṃ bhūtvā dāmpatye nirantaraṃ gharṣaṇaṃ, sāthī-śatrutām, guptaśatrubādhāṃ ca janayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — saptameśabalavardhanam, navagrahaśāntiḥ ca.

DUR_SAMBANDHA_7_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Saptameśo duḥsthāne — vivāhabādhā dāmpatyakleśaśca.
DUR_SAMBANDHA_7_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā saptameśaḥ (jāyāpatiḥ) ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśabhāveṣu tiṣṭhati, tadā dursambandhayogo jāyate. Vivāhakārakasya duḥsthāne sthityā jātakasya vibhāhe gambhīravilambaḥ, sājhedārīvyāpāre hāniḥ, guptasambandhapravṛttiḥ vā jāyate. Dāmpatyasukhaṃ bādhyate. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — śukragāyatrījapaḥ, svayaṃvarapārvatīpūjā ca.

DUR_SAMBANDHA_MARS_VENUS_AXIS.name: Dursambandhayogaḥ — maṅgalaśukrau 1-7 akṣe — tīvrakujadoṣaḥ dāmpatyakalahaśca.
DUR_SAMBANDHA_MARS_VENUS_AXIS.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā bhaumaḥ lagne śukraśca saptame tiṣṭhati (vā viparītam), tadā tīvraḥ dursambandhayogo (kujadoṣaḥ) jāyate. Maṅgalasya ugratā śukrasya saumyatāṃ nāśayati, yena dāmpatyajīvane nirantaraṃ kalahaḥ, krodha-kāma-asantulanam, viyogo vā phalayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — maṅgalaśāntiḥ, kujadoṣavratam, hanumadupāsanā ca.

DUR_SAMBANDHA_VENUS_DEBIL_OR_DUSTHANA.name: Dursambandhayogaḥ — śukro nīco duḥsthāne vā — kāma-vivāhakārakadūṣaṇam.
DUR_SAMBANDHA_VENUS_DEBIL_OR_DUSTHANA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā naisargikavivāhakārakaḥ śukraḥ svanīcarāśau (kanyāyām) ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-vyayeṣu vā tiṣṭhati, tadā dursambandhayogo jāyate. Prema-kāma-saundaryakārako śukraḥ durbalo bhūtvā dāmpatyasukhaṃ nāśayati, kalākauśalaṃ ca dūṣayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — śukragāyatrījapaḥ, mahālakṣmīpūjanam, śukraśāntiḥ ca.

DUR_VIDYA_5_HEMMED_MALEFICS.name: Durvidyāyogaḥ — pañcamabhāve pāpakartarīyogaḥ — vidyābādhā matibhramaśca.
DUR_VIDYA_5_HEMMED_MALEFICS.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 12 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā pañcamabhāvasya ubhayatoḥ caturtha-ṣaṣṭhabhāveṣu  pāpagrahāḥ tiṣṭhanti, tadā pañcamabhāvaḥ pāpakartarīveṣṭito bhavati. Anena vidyāgṛhaṃ pīḍitaṃ bhūtvā aupacārikaśikṣāyām adhūrāpanaṃ, kriyeṭibhabādhāṃ, santānatanāvaṃ ca phalayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — pañcameśabalavardhanam, guruśāntiḥ ca.

DUSTHANA_LORD_LAGNA_6.name: Ariṣṭayogaḥ — ṣaṣṭheśo lagnabhāve — rogāriṣṭaḥ śatruvivādaśca.
DUSTHANA_LORD_LAGNA_6.prose: Yadā ṣaṣṭheśaḥ (rogapatiḥ) lagnabhāve (tanubhāve) tiṣṭhati, tadā jātakasya śarīre vāraṃvāraṃ rogāḥ, saṅkrāmakavyādhayaḥ ca utpadyante. Parantu sevābhāvaḥ, cikitsākauśalaṃ ca jātakasya utkṛṣṭaṃ bhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — ṣaṣṭheśasya śāntiḥ, asamarthebhyaḥ auṣadhadānaṃ ca śubhapradam.

DUSTHANA_LORD_LAGNA_8.name: Ariṣṭayogaḥ — aṣṭameśo lagnabhāve — āyurbalabādhā bālariṣṭaṃ ca.
DUSTHANA_LORD_LAGNA_8.prose: Yadā aṣṭameśaḥ (mṛtyupatiḥ) lagnabhāve tiṣṭhati, tadā jātakasya āyurbale bādhā bhavati, bālyakāle ca prāṇasaṅkaṭaṃ jāyate. Parantu saṅkaṭaprabandhanakauśalam, gūḍhavidyā ca tasya sahāyikā bhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — aṣṭameśasya śāntiḥ, nityaṃ mahāmṛtyuñjayajapaḥ ca paramahitakārī.

ECLIPSE_DOSHA.name: Grahaṇa doṣaḥ (pañcāṅga) — sūrya-candra-grahaṇa-kāle janma. Teja-nāśa-yogyatā.
ECLIPSE_DOSHA.prose: Pāramparika-śāstre grahaṇa doṣaḥ — sūrya-grahaṇa vā candra-grahaṇa-kāle janmekaḥ teja-nāśa-yogyatāṃ, gahana-kaṣṭa-karma-yogyatāṃ, pūrva-janma-karma-vyākhyā-āvaśyakatāṃ dadāti. Grahaṇa-samaya-dāna-snāna-japa-karmabhiḥ nivāraṇīyam. Bṛhatpārāśarahorā-śāstre grahaṇa-kālika-janmā viśeṣa-kaṣṭa-darśakaḥ.
ECLIPSE_DOSHA.general: Teja-nāśa yogyatā, gahana-kaṣṭa-karma, pūrva-janma karma vyākhyā āvaśyakatā.

GADA.name: Gadā yogaḥ — grahāḥ kendradvaye (1-4 vā 1-7). Bahu-dhanī, siddha-vāk.
GADA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye gadā yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ kendra-dvaye (lagna-caturthayoḥ vā lagna-saptamayoḥ) upasthitāḥ. Gadā-samānāṃ prahāra-siddhiṃ, bahu-dhana-saṅgrahaṃ, siddha-vāk-śaktiṃ ca dadāti.

GADA_4_7.name: Gadā yogaḥ (4-7) — grahāḥ caturtha-saptama-kendradvaye. Gṛha-dāmpatya-saṃyuktam.
GADA_4_7.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye gadā-(4-7) yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ caturtha-saptama-kendradvaye upasthitāḥ. Gṛha-dāmpatya-saṃyuktaṃ viśiṣṭa-gadā-yogaṃ — mātṛ-gṛha-kalatra-kendrita-dhana-yaśaṃ ca dadāti.

GAJA_KESARI.name: Gajakesarī yogaḥ — candramāt kendre devagurau sthite samajāyate — paramaśubhayogaḥ.
GAJA_KESARI.prose: Candrāt kendre devagurau sthite gajakesarīyogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ tīkṣṇabuddhiḥ, prakhyātakīrtiḥ, dīrghāyuḥ, gurutulyaprabhāvayuktaśca bhavati.

GAJA_KESARI_BHANGA.name: Gajakesarī-bhaṅgaḥ — candrāt kendre gurau nīcasthe vakriṇi vā — phalahrāsaḥ.
GAJA_KESARI_BHANGA.prose: Yadā gajakesarī-yoge devaguruḥ nīcarāśau (makare) sthito bhavati athavā vakragatiṃ gacchati, tadā gajakesarībhaṅgaḥ jāyate. Anena yogasya śubhaphaleṣu nyūnatā, nirṇayaśaktihrāsaḥ, kāryeṣu vilambaḥ, guruvimukhatā ca phalayati.

GAJA_KESARI_EXALTED.name: Sarvocca gajakesarī yogaḥ — kendre karkarāśau uccasthe devagurau — mahāpradaḥ.
GAJA_KESARI_EXALTED.prose: Gajakesarī-yoge yadi devaguruḥ candrāt kendre svakīya-uccarāśau (karkarāśau) virājamānaḥ syāt, tadā ayaṃ parama-gajakesarī-yogaḥ phalayati. Anena jātakaḥ bhumaṇḍalādhipatiḥ, paramakīrtimān, dharmadhurandharaḥ, sarvoccanyāyādhīśasadṛśaḥ pratāpī ca jāyate.

GAJA_KESARI_OWN_SIGN.name: Gajakesarī (svagṛhī guruḥ) — kendre dhanu-mīnarāśau gurau — sthiraśubhapradaḥ.
GAJA_KESARI_OWN_SIGN.prose: Gajakesarī-yoge devagurau candrāt kendre svakṣetre (dhanuṣi mīne vā) sthite sati sthiraśubhapradaḥ yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ sthirakīrtimān, paramparāgataśāstrapāraṅgataḥ, sadācārī, kulavardhanaśca bhavati.

GANA_DOSHA.name: Gaṇa doṣaḥ — gaṇayorasāmyam (deva-manuṣya-rākṣasa). Svabhāva-virodha-yogyatā.
GANA_DOSHA.prose: Muhūrta-cintāmaṇau ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye gaṇa kūṭa — vara-vadhū-nakṣatrayorgaṇau (deva-manuṣya-rākṣasa) samānau cet pūrṇa-kūṭaḥ, asamānau cet nyūna-kūṭaḥ. Rākṣasa-gaṇa-saṃyoge viśeṣa-doṣaḥ — svabhāva-virodhaṃ, śīlācāra-asāmañjasyaṃ, saṃskārika-virodhaṃ dadāti.

GANDANTA_DOSHA.name: Gaṇḍānta doṣaḥ — sandhi-nakṣatre graha-sthitiḥ. Maraṇa-tulya-saṅkramaṇa.
GANDANTA_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye gaṇḍānta doṣaḥ — candrādi-graha-jala-agni-rāśi-sandhau (karka-siṃha, vṛścika-dhanuḥ, mīna-meṣa) sthita-yogyaḥ. Maraṇa-tulyaṃ saṅkramaṇa-kaṣṭaṃ, svāsthya-saṅkaṭa-yogyatāṃ, mātṛ-pitṛ-saṅkaṭa-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Pādānuguṇa-śānti-karma-āvaśyakam.

GAURI.name: Gaurī yogaḥ — candrāt navāṃśeśaḥ kendre candra-dṛṣṭaḥ. Putra-kalatra-sukham.
GAURI.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye gaurī-yogaḥ — candra-navāṃśeśaḥ kendre candra-dṛṣṭaḥ san putra-kalatra-sukhaṃ, gaurī-samānāṃ saundarya-varṇinīṃ strīṃ, gṛha-śāntiṃ, dharmātmaka-gṛhastha-vṛttiṃ dadāti.

GOLA.name: Gola yogaḥ — sarve sapta-grahāḥ eka-rāśyāṃ sthitāḥ. Ekāgratayā-andhatvam ati-tīvra-svabhāvaḥ.
GOLA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye gola yogaḥ uktaḥ — sarve sapta-grahāḥ ekaiva rāśau yuktāḥ. Ati-durlabho yogaḥ — ekāgra-vṛttiṃ, ati-tīvra-svabhāvaṃ, ekaiva-diś-samarpaṇaṃ, sarvāndha-sama-vyavahāraṃ ca prāpayati. Śāstre "andha-gola" iti laghu-nindyam.

GRAHAN_DOSHA.name: Grahaṇa doṣaḥ — sūrya-candrau rāhu-ketunā yutau. Grahaṇa-samāna-kaṣṭaḥ.
GRAHAN_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 83 adhyāye grahaṇa doṣaḥ — sūryo vā candraḥ rāhuṇā vā ketunā yutaḥ san grahaṇa-samāna-teja-nāśaṃ, mātṛ-pitṛ-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ, mānasika-asthiratāṃ, santati-kaṣṭa-karmaṇaṃ dadāti. Pūrva-janma-karmaṇā-vyākhyā.

GRAHAN_MOON_KETU.name: Grahaṇa yoga — candra-ketū yutau — mana-vairāgya-chāyā.
GRAHAN_MOON_KETU.prose: Grahaṇa-yogaścandraḥ ketunā yukto yadi syāt, tadā mana-vairāgya-chāyā-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

GRAHAN_MOON_RAHU.name: Grahaṇa yoga — candra-rāhū yutau — mana-kāraka-chāyā.
GRAHAN_MOON_RAHU.prose: Grahaṇa-yogaścandro rāhunā yukto yadi syāt, tadā mana-mātṛ-kārakayoḥ chāyā-dūṣaṇa-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

GRAHAN_SUN_RAHU.name: Grahaṇa yoga — sūrya-rāhū yutau — sūrya-kāraka-chāyā.
GRAHAN_SUN_RAHU.prose: Grahaṇa-yogo sūryo rāhunā yukto yadi syāt, tadā ātma-pitṛ-kārakayoḥ chāyā-dūṣaṇa-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

GURU_BHAGYA_JUPITER_9.name: Guru-bhāgya yoga — guru navame — guru-kṛpā-dhārmika-bhāgyam.
GURU_BHAGYA_JUPITER_9.prose: Guru-bhāgya-yogaḥ gururnavama-sthāne yadi syāt, gurustu dharma-kārako'pi navamaṃ dharma-sthānamiti, tadā sarvocca-dhārmika-bhāgyodayo bhavati.

GURU_CHANDAL.name: Guru-caṇḍāla doṣaḥ — guru-rāhoryutiḥ. Dharma-saṃśaya-yogaḥ.
GURU_CHANDAL.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 82 adhyāye guru-caṇḍāla doṣaḥ — guruḥ rāhunā yuto dṛṣṭo vā dharma-saṃśayaṃ, guru-kula-virodhaṃ, apa-dhārmika-vṛttiṃ, pūrva-janma-guru-avamāna-karmaṇaṃ dadāti. Guru-mantra-bṛhaspati-vratena nivāraṇīyam.

GURU_MANGAL.name: Guru-maṅgala yoga — guru-maṅgalayoḥ yutiḥ — dharma-śakti-saṃyogaḥ.
GURU_MANGAL.prose: Guru-maṅgala-yogo guruśca maṅgalaśca kasmiṃścid bhāve yadi sammilitau syātām, tadā dharma-śakti-saṃyogena netṛtvaṃ pradāti.

GURU_SHUKRA.name: Guru-śukra yoga — guru-śukrayoḥ yutiḥ — dvi-guru-saṃyogaḥ.
GURU_SHUKRA.prose: Guru-śukra-yogo guruśca śukraśca kasmiṃścid bhāve yadi sammilitau syātām, tadā parama-śubha-saṃyogena dhana-vidyā-kalātmakatvaṃ phalayati.

GURU_VIDYA_JUPITER_4.name: Guru-vidyā yoga — guruḥ caturthe — dharma-śāstra-śikṣā.
GURU_VIDYA_JUPITER_4.prose: Guru-vidyā-yogaḥ guruḥ caturthe yadi sva-ucca-mūlatrikoṇa-mitra-samasthāneṣu syāt, tadā ucca-śāstra-jñānaṃ dhārmika-vidyā-kauśalaṃ ca pradāti.

HALA_AKRITI.name: Hala yogaḥ — grahāḥ trikoṇa-2-6-10 vā anyaiḥ. Kṛṣaka-nāyaka-yogaḥ.
HALA_AKRITI.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye hala yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ trikoṇa-trivargeṣu (2-6-10) tiṣṭhanto hala-samānāṃ kṛṣi-nāyakatvaṃ, bhū-sampatti-vardhanaṃ, pariśrama-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti.

HALA_AKRITI_3_7_11.name: Hala yogaḥ (3-7-11) — parākrama-kalatra-lābha-trikoṇe. Udyamī kṛṣaka-samānam.
HALA_AKRITI_3_7_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye hala yogaḥ (3-7-11) — sapta-grahāḥ parākrama-kalatra-lābha-trikoṇe. Udyamī kṛṣaka-samānāṃ sva-prayāsena-dhana-vardhanaṃ, sāthī-kāraṇena-yaśaṃ, mitra-kuṭumba-vṛddhiṃ dadāti.

HALA_AKRITI_4_8_12.name: Hala yogaḥ (4-8-12) — mokṣa-trikoṇe. Sannyāsa-vā-gupta-dhana-yogaḥ.
HALA_AKRITI_4_8_12.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye hala yogaḥ (4-8-12) — sapta-grahāḥ mokṣa-trikoṇe (4-8-12). Sannyāsa-vṛttiṃ, gupta-dhana-lābhaṃ, mokṣa-yogyatāṃ, antarmukhī-karma ca dadāti. Hala-vat kintu āntarika-kṣetra-samānam.

HAMSA.name: Lagnāt candramaso vā kendre svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe devagurau haṃsasañjño yogo bhavati. Anena jātakaḥ dhārmikaḥ, śāstrajñaḥ, sattvaguṇapradhānaḥ, gurutulyaśca jāyate.
HAMSA.prose: Atha pañcamahāpuruṣayogeṣu tṛtīyo haṃsayogaḥ. Suragurau svoccasvarkṣagate kendre haṃsayogaḥ sañjāyate. Asya phalaṃ pārāśarahorāśāstre suṣṭhūktam — 'gauro'ṅgasūnuḥ subhagaḥ suvācyaḥ... Sacchāstravettā satatābhilāṣī.' Guruṇā pradattaṃ sattvaguṇādhikyaṃ tathā ca kendrasya prabhāvaḥ jātakaṃ dharmaśāstreṣu, nyāyarakṣaṇe, uccaśikṣāyāṃ tathā ca lokakalyāṇakāri-nītinirdhāraṇe agragaṇyaṃ gurusvarūpaṃ ca vidadhāti.
HAMSA.mind: Udāttaṃ dārśanikaṃ cintanaṃ, śāstreṣu naipuṇyaṃ, vivekaśīlatā ca
HAMSA.wealth: Saddharmamārgeṇa upārjitaṃ sthiraṃ dhanam, īśvarīyakṛpā-prāptaḥ aiśvaryaḥ

HAMSA_BHANGA.name: Kendrabhāvagate svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe'pi devagurau astaṅgate vakriṇi vā sati haṃsabhaṅgayogo jāyate. Anena haṃsayogasya śubhaphaleṣu hrāso bhavati.
HAMSA_BHANGA.prose: Yadā devaguruḥ bṛhaspatiḥ kendrasthāneṣu svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇarāśistho'pi san sūryeṇa saha yutatvāt astaṅgato bhavati, athavā vakrī-gatyā yukto bhavati, tadā haṃsabhaṅgayogo jāyate. Guruḥ prativarṣaṃ prāyaśaḥ māsacatuṣṭayaṃ vakrī bhavati, ataḥ ayamapi sāmānyaḥ doṣaḥ. Anena jātakasya dārśanikajñāne dharmaniṣṭhāyāṃ ca gahanatā bhavati, kintu jīvane gurupade saṃśayaḥ, mandirādi-dhārmikakāryāṇāṃ nirṇaye vilambaḥ, tathā ca śikṣaṇakārye aḍcanāḥ jāyante. Bṛhaspatigāyatrīmantrajapena, gurucaritrapaṭhanena ca asya doṣasya nivāraṇaṃ bhavati.

HAMSA_EXALTED.name: Kendrabhāvagate karkarāśisthe (paramoccasthe) devagurau uccahaṃsasañjño mahāyogo bhavati. Ayaṃ sarvottamakoṭeḥ paramadharmayogaḥ.
HAMSA_EXALTED.prose: Atha haṃsayogasya paramaśreṣṭharūpamuccahaṃsayogaḥ. Yadā devaguruḥ bhavyaparamoccarāśau karke (5 aṃśe) sthitaḥ san lagnataścandrataśca kendre vartate, tadā ayaṃ yogaḥ sarvayogeṣu śiromaṇirbhavati. Guruḥ naisargikaśubhagrahāṇām agraṇīḥ, karkarāśistu candrasya sāttvikarāśiḥ, tayoḥ saṃyogāt paramavivekaḥ, dharmaniṣṭhā, ādhyātmikatejaḥ ca utpadyate. Jātakaḥ kulaguruḥ, mukhyanyāyādhīśaḥ, dharmādhikārī vā bhūtvā sarvaiḥ pūjyate gauravyate ca.

HAMSA_FROM_MOON.name: Candralagnāt kendre svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe devagurau candrahaṃsayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya manasi asādhāraṇaṃ sāttvikajñānaṃ dharmaśraddhā ca utpadyate.
HAMSA_FROM_MOON.prose: Yadā jātakasya kuṇḍalyāṃ candralagnāt kendrabhāveṣu devaguruḥ svocce svarkṣe vā sthito bhavati, tadā candrahaṃsayogo jāyate. Candraḥ manasaḥ kārakaḥ, gurustu jñānasya dharmasya ca; tayoḥ saṃyogāt jātakasya manasi paramapāvanatā, dharmaniṣṭhā, dārśanikagambhīratā, tathā ca sāttvikabhāvanā utpadyate. Jātakaḥ adhyātmamārge, paropakāre, nyāyaśāstre ca śraddhāvān bhavati. Yadi lagna-candra-dvayoḥ kendre guruḥ sthitaḥ syāt, tadā jātakaḥ mahān ādhyātmikaguruḥ lokapūjyaśca bhavati.
HAMSA_FROM_MOON.mind: Gambhīraṃ sāttvikaṃ dārśanikaṃ ca cintanaṃ, vivekaśīlatā, dayāśīlatā

HAMSA_TRIKONA.name: Haṃsa-trikoṇa yoga — gururlagne (kendra-trikoṇe) — haṃsasya parama-tiryak.
HAMSA_TRIKONA.prose: Haṃsa-trikoṇa-yogo gururlagne (kendratva-trikoṇatva-duvai-dhārakaḥ) yadi syāt, tadā haṃsa-yogasya parama-tiryak-samāna-dharma-kīrtiṃ phalayati.

HARSHA.name: Harṣa viparīta rāja yoga — ṣaṣṭheśa duṣṭāna — śatru-roga-ṛṇajayaṃ pradāti.
HARSHA.prose:
Harṣa-yogaḥ viparīta-rāja-yogānāṃ prathamo. Ṣaṣṭheśo ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśa-sthāneṣu sthitaḥ san yadi syāt, tasya aśubhatvaṃ viparyayeṇa śubhatvaṃ bhavati, yena śatru-roga-ṛṇa-jayaṃ pradāti. (Bṛhatpārāśara-horā-śāstram 34; phaladīpikā 6-36)

idaṃ yogo aniṣṭa-sthāna-svāminaḥ aniṣṭa-sthānaṃ prāpti-dvārā dviguṇa-nakārātmakaṃ sakārātmaka-pratipādayati. Etad "dvinegeṭiva-invarśana" iti śāstrasammatam.

ISHU.name: Iṣu yogaḥ — grahāḥ 4-5-6-7 bhāveṣu krameṇa. Bāṇa-samānaṃ tīkṣṇa-karma.
ISHU.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye iṣu yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ 4-5-6-7 bhāveṣu krameṇa. Bāṇa-samānāṃ tīkṣṇa-karma, senā-nāyakatva-vā-śikāra-vṛttiṃ, bahu-śatrujaya-samarthyaṃ ca dadāti. Yajña-karma-vat kintu tīkṣṇatara.

JAIMINI_AK_AmK_BOTH_OWN_EXALT.name: Jaimini ātma-amātya sva/ucca — parama-digniṭī-saṃyogaḥ.
JAIMINI_AK_AmK_BOTH_OWN_EXALT.prose: Jaimini-yoga ātmakārako amātyakārakaśca kendra-trikoṇe, śubha-grahaśca sva-ucca-rāśau yadi syāt, tadā parama-digniṭī-kāraka-saṃrekhaṇaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_AK_AmK_KENDRA_TOGETHER.name: Jaimini ātma-amātya kendre — parama-rāja-saṃrekhaṇam.
JAIMINI_AK_AmK_KENDRA_TOGETHER.prose: Jaimini-yoga ātmakārako amātyakārakaśca kendra-bhāveṣu yadi sthitau syātām, tadā ātma-sallāhakāra-rāja-saṃrekhaṇaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_AK_AmK_PARIVARTANA_PROXY.name: Jaimini ātma-amātya lagna-daśama yogaḥ — parama-karma-tiryak.
JAIMINI_AK_AmK_PARIVARTANA_PROXY.prose: Jaimini-yoga ātmakārako lagne amātyakārakaśca daśame yadi syāt, tadā ātma-sallāha-karmaṇoḥ avibheda-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

JAIMINI_AK_AmK_TRIKONA_TOGETHER.name: Jaimini ātma-amātya trikoṇe — ātma-sallāha-dharma-saṃyogaḥ.
JAIMINI_AK_AmK_TRIKONA_TOGETHER.prose: Jaimini-yoga ātmakārako amātyakārakaśca trikoṇa-bhāveṣu yadi sthitau syātām, tadā sallāhakāra-dharma-kīrtiṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_AK_DK_KENDRA_TOGETHER.name: Jaimini ātma-dārā kendre — ātmā-sāthī-saṃrekhaṇam.
JAIMINI_AK_DK_KENDRA_TOGETHER.prose: Jaimini-yoga ātmakārako dārakārakaśca kendra-bhāveṣu yadi sthitau syātām, tadā ātma-dāmpatyayoḥ avibheda-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

JAIMINI_AK_DUSTHANA_BHANGA.name: Jaimini ātmakāraka duṣṭāne — ātma-patha-bādhā.
JAIMINI_AK_DUSTHANA_BHANGA.prose: Jaimini ātmakāraka-bhaṅga-yoga ātmakārako ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-vyaya-bhāveṣu yadi syāt, tadā ātma-patha-asaṃrekhaṇa-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_AK_KENDRA.name: Jaimini ātmakāraka kendre — ātma-patha-sthiratām.
JAIMINI_AK_KENDRA.prose: Jaimini-yoga ātmakārako kendra-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā ātma-pathasya śarīra-gṛha-dāmpatya-karma-sthambheṣu sthairyaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_AK_LAGNA.name: Jaimini ātmakāraka lagne — parama-ātma-vyaktitva-yogaḥ.
JAIMINI_AK_LAGNA.prose: Jaimini-yoga ātmakārako lagne yadi syāt, tadā ātma-vyaktitvayoḥ avibhedāt ātma-sākṣātkāraṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_AK_PK_TRIKONA_TOGETHER.name: Jaimini ātma-putra trikoṇe — ātma-santāna-dharma-saṃyogaḥ.
JAIMINI_AK_PK_TRIKONA_TOGETHER.prose: Jaimini-yoga ātmakārako putrakārakaśca trikoṇa-bhāveṣu yadi sthitau syātām, tadā ātma-santāna-darśana-saṃyogaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_AK_TRIKONA.name: Jaimini ātmakāraka trikoṇe — dharma-saṃrekhaṇa-yogaḥ.
JAIMINI_AK_TRIKONA.prose: Jaimini-yoga ātmakārako trikoṇa-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā ātma-pathasya dharma-purvapuṇya-saṃrekhaṇaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_AK_WITH_BENEFIC_CONJUNCTION_KEND.name: Jaimini ātmakāraka-śubha kendre — ātma-anugraha-yogaḥ.
JAIMINI_AK_WITH_BENEFIC_CONJUNCTION_KEND.prose: Jaimini-yoga ātmakārakaḥ śubha-grahaśca kendra-bhāve yadi sthitau syātām, tadā ātma-pathe śubha-anugrahaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_AmK_10.name: Jaimini amātyakāraka daśame — sallāhakāra-karma-yogaḥ.
JAIMINI_AmK_10.prose: Jaimini-yoga amātyakārako daśama-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā sallāhakāra-rājya-nāyaka-karma-diśāṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_BK_3.name: Jaimini bhrātṛkāraka tṛtīye — bhrātṛ-kalyāṇa-yogaḥ.
JAIMINI_BK_3.prose: Jaimini-yoga bhrātṛkārako tṛtīya-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā bhrātṛ-kalyāṇa-parākrama-sañcāra-kauśalaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_DK_7.name: Jaimini dārakāraka saptame — parama-dāmpatya-saṅketaḥ.
JAIMINI_DK_7.prose: Jaimini-yoga dārakārako saptama-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā parama-dāmpatya-saṅketaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_DK_AK_SAME_HOUSE_PROXY.name: Jaimini ātma-dārā saha-saptame — parama-ātmasāthī-yogaḥ.
JAIMINI_DK_AK_SAME_HOUSE_PROXY.prose: Jaimini-yoga ātmakārako dārakārakaśca saptama-bhāve yadi sthitau syātām, tadā parama-ātmasāthī-dāmpatya-yogaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_DK_KENDRA.name: Jaimini dārakāraka kendre — dāmpatya-kalyāṇa-yogaḥ.
JAIMINI_DK_KENDRA.prose: Jaimini-yoga dārakārako kendra-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā dāmpatya-kalyāṇa-samarthanaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_GK_DUSTHANA_VIPAREETA.name: Jaimini jñātikāraka duṣṭāne — viparīta-śatru-nāśa-yogaḥ.
JAIMINI_GK_DUSTHANA_VIPAREETA.prose: Jaimini-viparīta-yoga jñātikārako duṣṭāna-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā śatru-kāraka-sva-vināśa-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_JUPITER_PROXY.name: Jaimini kārakāṃśa-guru pratinidhi — ātma-darśana-saṃyogaḥ.
JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_JUPITER_PROXY.prose: Jaimini-yoga gurustrikoṇe ātmakārakaśca kendra-trikoṇe yadi syāt, tadā kārakāṃśa-tiryak-darśana-śaktiṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_MOON_PROXY.name: Jaimini kārakāṃśa-candra pratinidhi — mātṛ-kṛpā-saṃyogaḥ.
JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_MOON_PROXY.prose: Jaimini-yogaścandrastrikoṇe ātmakārakaśca kendra-trikoṇe yadi syāt, tadā mātṛ-kṛpā-bhāva-gahanatāṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_SUN_PROXY.name: Jaimini kārakāṃśa-sūrya pratinidhi — pitṛ-kṛpā-saṃyogaḥ.
JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_SUN_PROXY.prose: Jaimini-yogaḥ sūryaḥ pañcama-navamayoḥ ātmakārakaśca kendra-trikoṇe yadi syāt, tadā pitṛ-rāja-kṛpāṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_VENUS_PROXY.name: Jaimini kārakāṃśa-śukra pratinidhi — kalātmaka-ātma-patha-yogaḥ.
JAIMINI_KARAKAMSA_VENUS_PROXY.prose: Jaimini-yogaḥ śukraḥ pañcama-navamayoḥ ātmakārakaśca kendra-trikoṇe yadi syāt, tadā kalātmaka-ātma-pathaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_MK_4.name: Jaimini mātṛkāraka caturthe — mātṛ-kalyāṇa-yogaḥ.
JAIMINI_MK_4.prose: Jaimini-yoga mātṛkārako caturtha-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā mātṛ-dīrghāyu-kalyāṇa-gṛha-sukhaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_PK_5.name: Jaimini putrakāraka pañcame — parama-santāna-saṅketaḥ.
JAIMINI_PK_5.prose: Jaimini-yoga putrakārako pañcama-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā parama-santāna-buddhi-purvapuṇya-saṅketaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_PK_TRIKONA.name: Jaimini putrakāraka trikoṇe — santāna-dharma-saṃyogaḥ.
JAIMINI_PK_TRIKONA.prose: Jaimini-yoga putrakārakastrikoṇe yadi syāt, tadā santāna-dharma-purvapuṇya-saṃyogaṃ phalayati.

JAIMINI_TRIPLE_KENDRA_KARAKAS.name: Jaimini tri-kāraka-kendra — parama-trikāraka-saṃrekhaṇam.
JAIMINI_TRIPLE_KENDRA_KARAKAS.prose: Jaimini-yogaḥ ātmakārako amātyakārako dārakārakaśca kendra-bhāveṣu sarve yadi sthitāḥ syuḥ, tadā parama-kāraka-saṃrekhaṇaṃ phalayati.

JAYA.name: Jaya yogaḥ — daśameśo lagne uccaḥ budha-guru-dṛṣṭaḥ. Sarva-karma-vijayaḥ.
JAYA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye jaya-yogaḥ — daśameśo lagne ucca-sva-rāśiṣu budha-gurudvārā dṛṣṭaḥ san sarva-karma-vijayaṃ, aṣṭa-rāja-lakṣaṇa-saṃyogaṃ, adhikāra-sthāna-nirantara-vardhanaṃ, aiśvarya-samarthyaṃ dadāti.

JUPITER_5_PUTRA_KARAKA.name: Putra-kāraka yoga — guruḥ pañcame śubha-sthite — sarvocca-santāna-saṅketaḥ.
JUPITER_5_PUTRA_KARAKA.prose: Putra-kāraka-yogaḥ guruḥ pañcame yadi sva-ucca-mūlatrikoṇa-mitra-samasthāneṣu syāt, tadā bahu-putra-dīrghāyu-kalyāṇaṃ pradāti.

JUP_IN_1.name: Gururlagne rājayogakārakaḥ. Prajñāvān, dhārmikaḥ, dīrghāyuḥ, saumya-ākṛtiḥ.
JUP_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururlagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ prajñāvantaṃ, dhārmikaṃ, dīrghāyuṣaṃ, saumya-ākṛtiṃ, guru-śiṣya-vatsalaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 adhyāye etatsthānaṃ śreṣṭha-rājayogakārakaṃ uktam — guruḥ kāraka-sthāne ātma-śuddhiṃ, vidyā-vardhanaṃ, guru-kṛpāṃ ca prāpayati.
JUP_IN_1.general: Rājayogaḥ, prajñā, dharmaniṣṭhā, dīrghāyuḥ, saumya-vyaktitvam, guru-kṛpā, sat-śāstrajñānam.

JUP_IN_10.name: Gururdaśame karma-dharma-rājayogaḥ. Ucca-pada-yaśasvī, dharma-vyavasāyī.
JUP_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururdaśamasthaḥ karma-kāraka-kendra-rājayogakārakaḥ — ucca-pada-yaśaṃ, dharma-vyavasāyaṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, sat-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — kāraka-kendra-yogaḥ uccakarma-pradaḥ.

JUP_IN_11.name: Gururekādaśe lābha-dharmayogaḥ. Nirantara-dhana-vṛddhiḥ, dhārmika-mitra-kuṭumba-vardhanam.
JUP_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururekādaśasthaḥ lābha-dharma-yogakārakaḥ — nirantara-dhana-vṛddhiṃ, dhārmika-mitra-kuṭumba-vardhanaṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — gururlābhasthāne sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

JUP_IN_2.name: Gururdvitīye — madhura-vāk-dhana-yogaḥ. Bahu-dhana-saṅgrahaḥ, dharmātmaka-vāṇī.
JUP_IN_2.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururdvitīyasthaḥ madhura-vāk-dhana-yogakārakaḥ — bahu-dhana-saṅgrahaṃ, dharmātmaka-vāṇīṃ, kuṭumba-poṣaṇaṃ, ucca-śikṣā-samarthyaṃ dadāti. Jñāna-kārakeṇa kuṭumba-vāṇī-saṃrakṣaṇam.

JUP_IN_4.name: Guruścaturthe mātṛ-gṛha-vāhana-yogaḥ. Hṛdaya-sukhaṃ, dhārmika-gṛhasthaḥ.
JUP_IN_4.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye guruścaturthasthaḥ jātakaṃ mātṛ-sukha-samṛddhaṃ, gṛha-vāhana-sampannaṃ, dhārmika-gṛhastha-vṛttiṃ, hṛdaya-śāntiṃ ca prāpayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — guruḥ sukhasthāne kendra-kāraka-yogakārakaḥ.

JUP_IN_5.name: Guruḥ pañcame putra-prajñā-yogaḥ. Santati-sukhī, mantra-siddhaḥ, vidvān.
JUP_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye guruḥ pañcamasthaḥ jātakaṃ putra-prajñā-saṃyoga-rājayogakārakaṃ — santati-sukhaṃ, mantra-siddhiṃ, vidyā-kauśalaṃ, rāja-kīrti-vardhanaṃ ca prāpayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — guruḥ kāraka-kāraka-sthāne sarvottama rājayogaḥ.

JUP_IN_7.name: Guruḥ saptame dhārmika-kalatrayogaḥ. Dāmpatya-sukhī, sad-vyāpārī.
JUP_IN_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye guruḥ saptamasthaḥ jātakaṃ dhārmika-kalatra-yogayuktaṃ, dāmpatya-sukhinaṃ, sad-vyāpāriṇaṃ, videśa-yātra-lābhaṃ ca prāpayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — guruḥ kalatra-sthāne jāyāṃ śāstrajñāṃ, sāttvika-vyavahāraṃ dadāti. Tathāpi avivāhita-yogaḥ kvacit jāyate yadā gururbrahmacarya-pūjana-vṛttiṃ prerayati.
JUP_IN_7.general: Dhārmika-dāmpatyam, śāstrajña-jāyā, sad-vyāpāraḥ, videśa-yātrā-lābhaḥ, kalatra-kāraṇena khyātiḥ.

JUP_IN_9.name: Gururnavame dharma-rājayogaḥ. Atyanta-bhāgyavān, guru-kṛpā-pātraḥ, śāstrajñaḥ.
JUP_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururnavamasthaḥ sarvocca-dharma-rājayogakārakaḥ — kāraka-kāraka-trikoṇayogaḥ. Jātakaḥ atyanta-bhāgyavān, guru-kṛpā-pātraḥ, sarva-śāstra-jñaḥ, dharmātmā ca bhavati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — etatsthānaṃ jyotiṣa-śāstre ati-ślāghitam.

JUP_IN_9_EXALTED.name: Gururnavame ucce — mahā-bhāgya-dharma-yogaḥ. Śreṣṭhatama-rājayogaḥ.
JUP_IN_9_EXALTED.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururnavame ucca-sva-rāśi-sthaḥ mahā-bhāgya-dharma-yogakārakaḥ — karka-rāśi-guruḥ bhāgya-sthāne śreṣṭhatama-rājayogaṃ — sarvocca-bhāgya, guru-kṛpā, sarva-śāstra-jñānaṃ, dharma-rāja-yaśaṃ dadāti.

JUP_SAT_CONJ.name: Guru-śani yutiḥ — mahā-saṅkrānti-yogaḥ. Dīrghakālika-sthiratā, gahana-dharma.
JUP_SAT_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye guru-śani-yutiḥ mahā-saṅkrānti-yogaḥ — 20-varṣa-cakrīya-durlabha-yogena dīrghakālika-sthira-karma, gahana-dhārmika-vṛtti, saṅgaṭhana-vyavasāya-kuśalatā, samāja-saṃracaka-samarthyaṃ dadāti. Jñāna-karma-saṃyogasya anūṭha-saṃyogaḥ.

JUP_VEN_MER_CONJ.name: Guru-śukra-budha yutiḥ — sarasvatī-triveṇī. Parama-vidyā, kalā, dharma-rāja-yaśam.
JUP_VEN_MER_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye guru-śukra-budha-tri-yutiḥ sarasvatī-triveṇī-yogaḥ — sarva-śubha-trayoḥ sama-saṃyogena parama-vidyāṃ, kalā-kīrtiṃ, dharma-rāja-yaśaṃ, mantra-siddhiṃ, sarva-śāstra-kauśalaṃ dadāti. Śreṣṭhatama-tri-yuti-yogaḥ.

KAHALA.name: Kahala yogaḥ — caturtheśa-navameśau parasparaṃ kendre — senāpati-adhikāraḥ.
KAHALA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye varṇitam — caturtheśa-navameśau parasparaṃ kendra-bhāveṣu saṃsthitau cet, tadā kahala-yogaḥ samajāyate. "Kahalaḥ" raṇabherī-nagāḍātulyaḥ vijayasūcakaḥ śabdaḥ. Anena jātakaḥ sāhasī, senādhyakṣaḥ, mantrī, vipula-yāna-vāhana-sampannaśca jāyate.

KAHALA_CHANDRA.name: Kahala-candra yogaḥ — candra-maṅgalayoḥ parasparakendrasthatve — senāpati-yogaḥ.
KAHALA_CHANDRA.prose: Candraśca maṅgalaśca parasparaṃ kendra-bhāveṣu yadi tiṣṭhetām, tadā kahala-candra-yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ sāhasikaḥ, senāpatisadṛśapratāpī, yāna-bhūmi-samṛddhiyuktaśca bhavati.

KAHALA_MUKHYA.name: Kahala-mukhyayogaḥ — karmeśa-navameśayoḥ śubhasambandhaḥ. Senānāyakatvam, rājasammānaśca.
KAHALA_MUKHYA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye varṇitam — yadā karmabhāvasvāmī navameśena saha sambaddhaḥ (yuti-dṛṣṭi-parivartanādinā) bhavati, tadā kahala-mukhyayogo jāyate. Anena jātakaḥ kuśalapraśāsakaḥ, senāpatiḥ, prakhyātakīrtiḥ, rājakulapratiṣṭhitaśca bhavati. Ayamuccakoṭiko mahārājayogaḥ.

KALANIDHI.name: Kalānidhi yogaḥ — guruḥ 2-5 budha-śukra-dṛṣṭaḥ vā yutaḥ. Sarva-kalā-kauśalam.
KALANIDHI.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye kalānidhi-yogaḥ — guruḥ dvitīya-vā-pañcama-sthāne budha-śukra-dṛṣṭaḥ vā yutaḥ sarva-kalā-kauśalaṃ, aneka-śāstra-jñānaṃ, madhura-svara-gāyanaṃ, rāja-sammāna-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Kalā-nāyaka-tulya-kīrtiḥ.

KALPADRUMA.name: Kalpadrumayogaḥ — lagneśa-tadadhipati-nakṣatrapatīnāṃ śubhakendrasthitiḥ. Kalpavṛkṣasamānaḥ phalapradaḥ.
KALPADRUMA.prose: Jātakapārijāte pañcame adhyāye kalpadrumayogaḥ — lagneśaḥ, tasya rāśipatiḥ, tannakṣatrapatiśca ete sarve balinaḥ bhūtvā kendre trikoṇe vā sva-ucce santiṣṭhante, tadā kalpadrumayogaḥ. Kalpavṛkṣa (kalpadruma) iva ayaṃ jātakasya sarvakāmanāḥ pūrayati, dhārmikaṃ yaśaśca dadāti.

KALSARPA.name: Kālasarpa doṣaḥ — sarve grahāḥ rāhu-ketuyormadhye. Bahu-kaṣṭa-yogaḥ.
KALSARPA.prose: Mānasāgaryāṃ caturthe adhyāye kālasarpa doṣaḥ — sarve sapta-grahāḥ rāhu-ketuyorakṣe ekaika-pārśve (pūrṇa kālasarpa) vā eka-pārśve 6-7 grahāḥ (āṃśika kālasarpa). Bahu-kaṣṭa-karma-saṅgharṣa, mānasika-tanāva, akalpita-vighna-yogaḥ. Ārohī (rāhu-diś) vā avarohī (ketu-diś) iti dvi-prakārakaḥ. 12 Nāmika-prakārāḥ rāhu-sthānānusāram.
KALSARPA.general: Bahu-kaṣṭa karma-saṅgharṣa, mānasika tanāva, akalpita vighna, sarpa-doṣa-karma-yogyatā.

KARMA_10_LORD_KENDRA.name: Karma yogaḥ — kendre daśameśe — sudṛḍha-karma-sāmarthyam.
KARMA_10_LORD_KENDRA.prose: Karma-yogaḥ bṛhatpārāśara-horā-śāstrasya aṣṭādaśādhyāye kathitaḥ. Daśameśo lagna-caturtha-saptama-daśameṣu anyatame kendrabhāve balavān bhūtvā yadi tiṣṭhet, tadā jātasya karma-sthānaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ sthiraṃ ca bhavati.

KARMA_10_LORD_OWN_EXALT.name: Karma yogaḥ — sva/ucce daśameśe — digbala-sāmarthya-yuktā vṛttiḥ.
KARMA_10_LORD_OWN_EXALT.prose: Daśameśo sva-ucca-mūlatrikoṇa-rāśiṣu balavān bhūtvā yadi tiṣṭhet, tadā karma-yogo digbala-saṃyukto bhūtvā jātakāya svatantra-sāmarthyaṃ dadāti.

KARMA_10_LORD_TRIKONA.name: Karma yogaḥ — trikoṇe daśameśe — dharmānukūla-vṛtti-prāptiḥ.
KARMA_10_LORD_TRIKONA.prose: Daśameśo trikoṇe (1, 5, 9) sthite sati dharmānukūla-kariyara-yogo jāyate, anena pūrvapuṇyabalāt jātakaḥ dharmānukūla-karmaṇi nirataḥ kīrtimāṃśca bhavati.

KARMA_KARAKA_JUPITER_10.name: Karma-kāraka yogaḥ — daśame devagurau — dharma-nyāya-parāmarśa-sāmarthyam.
KARMA_KARAKA_JUPITER_10.prose: Gururdaśama-sthāne yadi tiṣṭhet, tadā dharma-kārakasya karmāvasthāna-prabhāvāt jātakaḥ nyāyādhīśaḥ, mantri-tulya-sallāhakāraḥ, dharmaguruśca bhavati.

KARMA_KARAKA_MERCURY_10.name: Karma-kāraka yogaḥ — daśame budhe — bahuvidha-vyāpāra-kauśalam.
KARMA_KARAKA_MERCURY_10.prose: Budho daśama-sthāne yadi tiṣṭhet, tadā jātakaḥ prakhara-buddhiḥ, bahuvidha-vyāpāra-kuśalaḥ, vāgmī, śāstrajñaśca bhavati.

KARMA_KARAKA_SATURN_10.name: Karma-kāraka yogaḥ — daśame śanau — śrama-sevā-dhīra-dīrgha-sāmarthyam.
KARMA_KARAKA_SATURN_10.prose: Śanirdaśama-sthāne svoccarāśau digbala-sahito yadi tiṣṭhet, tadā jātakaḥ prajā-sevakaḥ, dhīra-karma-kartā, udyoga-patiśca bhavati.

KARMA_KARAKA_SUN_10.name: Karma-kāraka yogaḥ — daśame sūrye — rājapratāpo rājyaśāsanaṃ ca.
KARMA_KARAKA_SUN_10.prose: Sūryo daśama-sthāne yadi syāt, rāja-netṛtvaṃ sva-dikbala-yuktaṃ bhavati. Sūryo digbalaṃ prāpnoti daśame.

KARMA_LORDS_EXCHANGE_1_10.name: Karma-lagna parivartana yogaḥ — lagneśa-daśameśayoḥ paraspara-rāśi-parivartanam — parama-rāja-yogaḥ.
KARMA_LORDS_EXCHANGE_1_10.prose: Karma-lagna-parivartana-yogaḥ bṛhatpārāśara-horā-śāstrasya 18-adhyāye. Lagneśo daśameśasya rāśau, daśameśo lagneśasya rāśau yadi sthitau, tadā parivartanaṃ sva-karma-saṃyojanaṃ ca bhavati.

KARNA_ARISHTA.name: Karṇāriṣṭayogaḥ — tṛtīye pāpagrahāḥ śubhadṛṣṭihīnāḥ — śravaṇabādhā karṇarogaśca.
KARNA_ARISHTA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 10 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā tṛtīyabhāve (karṇasthāne) pāpagrahāḥ sthitāḥ syuḥ śubhadṛṣṭihīnāśca, tadā karṇāriṣṭayogo jāyate.
