Tṛtīyabhāvaḥ śravaṇaśakteḥ kārakaḥ; pāpena dūṣitatvāt jātakasya śravaṇadaurbalyaṃ, karṇarogo vā kaṣṭaṃ phalayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — tṛtīyeśaśāntiḥ, budhaśāntiḥ, karṇarakṣāstotraṃ ca hitakaram.

KEDARA.name: Kedāra yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ caturṣu-rāśiṣu. Kṛṣaka-samānam, bahu-karma-nirataḥ.
KEDARA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye kedāra yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ caturṣu rāśiṣu sthitāḥ jātakaṃ kṛṣaka-samānaṃ, bahu-karma-nirataṃ, kuṭumba-poṣaka-madhyama-dhaniṃ ca karoti. Kedāra-kṣetra-samānāṃ vibhāga-karma-vṛttiḥ.

KEETA.name: Kīṭayogaḥ — maṅgalaśanyoḥ aṣṭamabhāve yutiḥ — kīṭadaṃśaviṣadurghaṭanābhayam.
KEETA.prose: Yadā bhaumaḥ śaniśca yugapad aṣṭamabhāve (mṛtyubhāve) sthitau bhavataḥ, tadā kīṭayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya kīṭadaṃśena, sarpabhayena, viṣāktatā vā tīvrābhiḥ durghaṭanābhiḥ śārīrikakaṣṭaṃ sambhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — maṅgalaśanyoḥ viśeṣaśāntipūjā, hanumadupāsanā, nityaṃ mahāmṛtyuñjayajapaḥ ca rakṣāṃ karoti.

KEMADRUMA.name: Kemadruma yoga — candrādanyairgrahai rahitaḥ — mana-ekākitva-doṣaḥ.
KEMADRUMA.prose: Kemadruma-yogo candrāt dvitīya-dvādaśa-bhāveṣu yadi ko'pi graho (sūrya-rāhu-ketu-varjayitvā) na syāt, tadā mana-ekākitva-daurbalya-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

KEMDRUM_DOSHA.name: Kemadruma doṣaḥ — candrāt 2-12 rikte. Manaḥ-ekākitva-yogaḥ.
KEMDRUM_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatjātake trayodaśe adhyāye kemadruma doṣaḥ — candrāt dvitīya-dvādaśa-sthānayoḥ kutrāpi graha-abhāve (kevala rāhu-ketu-anupasthitau) manaḥ-ekākitvaṃ, mānasika-kaṣṭaṃ, dhana-nyūnatā-yogyatāṃ, sambandha-viyoga-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Candra-samīpa-śubha-graha-sthāpanena nivāraṇīyam.

KENDRADHIPATI_DOSHA.name: Kendrādhipati doṣaḥ — śubha-grahāḥ kendra-svāminaḥ. Śubha-guṇa-nyūnatā-yogyatā.
KENDRADHIPATI_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye kendrādhipati doṣaḥ uktaḥ — śubha-grahāḥ (guru, śukra, budha, candra) kendra-svāminaḥ santaḥ kendratva-doṣeṇa śubha-guṇa-nyūnatāṃ prāpnuvanti. Pārāśara-śāstrokta-viśiṣṭa-yogaḥ — pāpatva-vardhanaṃ kiñcit kintu rājayoga-kāraka-tvaṃ avaśiṣṭam.
KENDRADHIPATI_DOSHA.general: Śubha-guṇa nyūnatā, pāpatva-vardhana yogyatā, rājayoga-kārakatva avaśeṣa.

KETU_IN_12.name: Keturdvādaśe mokṣa-yogaḥ. Mokṣa-yogyatā, sūkṣma-dṛṣṭiḥ, videśa-vāsaḥ, sāttvika-tyāgaḥ.
KETU_IN_12.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 29 adhyāye keturdvādaśasthaḥ sarvotkṛṣṭa-mokṣa-yogakārakaḥ — mokṣa-yogyatāṃ, sūkṣma-dṛṣṭiṃ, videśa-vāsaṃ, sāttvika-tyāgaṃ, gupta-dāna-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — ketoḥ vyaya-sthānaṃ mokṣa-kāraka-kāraka-saṃyogaḥ.
KETU_IN_12.general: Sarvotkṛṣṭa-mokṣa-yogaḥ, mokṣa-yogyatā, sūkṣma-dṛṣṭiḥ, videśa-vāsaḥ, sāttvika-tyāgaḥ, gupta-dāna-kīrtiḥ.

KETU_IN_9.name: Keturnavame mokṣa-dharma-yogaḥ. Ādhyātmikaḥ, guru-kṛpā-pātraḥ, antardṛṣṭimān.
KETU_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 29 adhyāye keturnavamasthaḥ mokṣa-dharma-yogakārakaḥ — ādhyātmika-vṛttiṃ, guru-kṛpā-yogaṃ, antardṛṣṭiṃ, sūkṣma-śāstra-jñānaṃ, pūrva-janma-smṛtiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — ketorbhāgya-sthānaṃ ati-śubham.

KHALA_10_12.name: Khala parivartana (10-12) — śubha-bhāveśo duṣṭa-sthāne patitaḥ. Miśra-phalam.
KHALA_10_12.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ trayodaśe adhyāye khala-yogaḥ uktaḥ — śubha-bhāveśaḥ (kendra-trikoṇa) duṣṭa-sthānaṃ (6/8/12) prati-tiṣṭhan miśra-phalaṃ dadāti. 10-Bhāvasya phalaṃ akṣiptaṃ kintu cira-kālika-nyūna-bādhābhiḥ parīkṣitam. Na pūrṇa-rājayogaḥ, na pūrṇa-dūṣaṇam.
