KHALA_9_12.name: Khala parivartana (9-12) — śubha-bhāveśo duṣṭa-sthāne patitaḥ. Miśra-phalam.
KHALA_9_12.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ trayodaśe adhyāye khala-yogaḥ uktaḥ — śubha-bhāveśaḥ (kendra-trikoṇa) duṣṭa-sthānaṃ (6/8/12) prati-tiṣṭhan miśra-phalaṃ dadāti. 9-Bhāvasya phalaṃ akṣiptaṃ kintu cira-kālika-nyūna-bādhābhiḥ parīkṣitam. Na pūrṇa-rājayogaḥ, na pūrṇa-dūṣaṇam.

KHALA_9_6.name: Khala parivartana (9-6) — śubha-bhāveśo duṣṭa-sthāne patitaḥ. Miśra-phalam.
KHALA_9_6.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ trayodaśe adhyāye khala-yogaḥ uktaḥ — śubha-bhāveśaḥ (kendra-trikoṇa) duṣṭa-sthānaṃ (6/8/12) prati-tiṣṭhan miśra-phalaṃ dadāti. 9-Bhāvasya phalaṃ akṣiptaṃ kintu cira-kālika-nyūna-bādhābhiḥ parīkṣitam. Na pūrṇa-rājayogaḥ, na pūrṇa-dūṣaṇam.

KHALA_9_8.name: Khala parivartana (9-8) — śubha-bhāveśo duṣṭa-sthāne patitaḥ. Miśra-phalam.
KHALA_9_8.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ trayodaśe adhyāye khala-yogaḥ uktaḥ — śubha-bhāveśaḥ (kendra-trikoṇa) duṣṭa-sthānaṃ (6/8/12) prati-tiṣṭhan miśra-phalaṃ dadāti. 9-Bhāvasya phalaṃ akṣiptaṃ kintu cira-kālika-nyūna-bādhābhiḥ parīkṣitam. Na pūrṇa-rājayogaḥ, na pūrṇa-dūṣaṇam.

KHYATI.name: Khyāti yogaḥ — guruḥ kendre ucca-sva-rāśi-sthaḥ. Khyāti-samāna-kīrtiḥ.
KHYATI.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye khyāti-yogaḥ — guruḥ kendra-sthāne ucca-sva-rāśiṣu tiṣṭhan sarva-dig-vyāpi-kīrtiṃ, dhārmika-rāja-yaśaṃ, sarva-śāstra-kauśalaṃ, guru-tejasāṃ sammānaṃ dadāti.

KRISHNA_PAKSHA_DOSHA.name: Kṛṣṇa-pakṣa doṣaḥ — kṛṣṇa-pakṣe janma. Candra-kṣīṇatva-yogyatā.
KRISHNA_PAKSHA_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre kṛṣṇa-pakṣa doṣaḥ — kṛṣṇa-pakṣa-kāle janmekaścandra-kṣīṇatva-yogyatāṃ, mānasika-daurbalya-yogyatāṃ, sambandha-saṃśaya-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Śukla-pakṣa-tulanāya nyūna-ātmaviśvāsa-yogyaḥ. Amāvāsyā-samīpa-divaseṣu tīvratara.
KRISHNA_PAKSHA_DOSHA.general: Candra-kṣīṇatva yogyatā, mānasika daurbalya, sambandha-saṃśaya, nyūna-ātmaviśvāsa.

KUJA_BHANGA_ABSENT.name: Kuja-bhaṅga-abhāvaḥ — māṅgalika-nivāraṇa-śāstrokta-sthiterabhāvaḥ. Doṣa-nivāraṇa-yogyatā-nyūnam.
KUJA_BHANGA_ABSENT.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ navame adhyāye kuja-bhaṅga — māṅgalika-nivāraṇasya daśa śāstrokta-yogāḥ uktāḥ (maṅgala-sva-svarāśi-ucca, guru-dṛṣṭi, ubhaya-pārśva-śubha, ityādi). Eteṣāmabhāve kuja-bhaṅga-abhāva-yogyaḥ — māṅgalika-doṣa-tīvratā na nyūnīkriyate. Pūrṇa-śānti-karma-āvaśyakam.

KURMA.name: Kūrma yogaḥ — śubhāḥ ucce kendratrikoṇayoḥ. Kacchapa-samānaṃ sthairyam.
KURMA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye kūrma-yogaḥ — śubha-grahāḥ kendra-trikoṇayoḥ ucca-sva-rāśiṣu tiṣṭhantaḥ kacchapa-samānaṃ sthairyaṃ, dīrghāyuṃ, manda-gati-samarthyaṃ, śraddhālu-svabhāvaṃ dadati. Sthira-rāja-tejaḥ.

KUSUMA.name: Kusuma yogaḥ — śukraḥ kendre ucce candra-dṛṣṭaḥ. Puṣpa-samāna-saundaryam.
KUSUMA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye kusuma-yogaḥ — śukraḥ kendra-sthāne ucce san candra-dṛṣṭaḥ puṣpa-samānāṃ saundaryaṃ, madhura-vyaktitvaṃ, sarva-priya-vyavahāraṃ, kalā-niratiṃ dadāti. Puṣpavat-komala-vyaktitvam.

KUTA.name: Kūṭa yogaḥ — grahāḥ 4-5-6-7-8-9-10 bhāveṣu. Parvata-kūṭa-samānam.
KUTA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye kūṭa yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ 4-5-6-7-8-9-10 bhāveṣu krameṇa. Parvata-śikhara-kūṭa-samānāṃ sthira-sthānaṃ, ati-dhairyaṃ, gupta-karma, ucca-śikhara-samāna-sthānaṃ dadāti.

L10_IN_1.name: Daśameśo lagne rājayogaḥ. Karmaṭhaḥ, yaśasvī, svakarmeṇa-uccapadaprāptaḥ.
L10_IN_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye daśameśo lagnasthaḥ kāraka-karma-rājayogakārakaḥ — karma tanusthānamāśritya vyaktitvameva karma-yaśaṃ dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — svaśarīreṇa karmaṇā yaśam.
L10_IN_1.general: Rājayogaḥ, karma-yaśam, ucca-pada-prāptiḥ, sva-prayāsena prasiddhiḥ, rāja-sammānam.

L10_IN_11.name: Daśameśa ekādaśe karma-lābha-yogaḥ. Nirantara-karma-vṛddhiḥ, mitradvārā-karma-lābhaḥ.
L10_IN_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye daśameśa ekādaśasthaḥ karma-lābha-yogakārakaḥ — karma lābhasthānamāśritya nirantaraṃ phalitam. Mitra-vyāpāra-saṃyogena uccapada-vardhanam, sarvārtha-lābhaśca. Phaladīpikā 13 — karmeṇa sarvārtha-siddhiḥ.

L10_IN_2.name: Daśameśo dvitīye karmārjita-kuṭumbadhanam. Vyavasāyena vāk-kauśalena ca-dhanam.
L10_IN_2.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye daśameśo dvitīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ karmārjita-kuṭumbadhanavantaṃ, vyāpāra-yaśasvinaṃ, madhura-vyāvahārika-vāṇīyuktaṃ ca karoti. Phaladīpikā 13 — karma-dhana-saṃyogena koṣa-vardhanam.

L10_IN_4.name: Daśameśaścaturthe karma-gṛha-yogaḥ. Rāja-yāna-gṛha-lābhaḥ, mātṛ-karma-saṃyogaḥ.
L10_IN_4.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye daśameśaścaturthasthaḥ karma-gṛha-yogakārakaḥ — karmadvārā gṛha-vāhana-sampatti-lābhaṃ, mātṛ-karma-saṃyogaṃ, sthira-vāsaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — karmeṇa sukha-vṛddhiḥ.

L10_IN_5.name: Daśameśaḥ pañcame rājayogaḥ — karma-trikoṇa-yogaḥ. Buddhi-kauśalena-yaśam.
L10_IN_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye daśameśaḥ pañcamasthaḥ karma-trikoṇa-rājayogakārakaḥ — karma pūrva-puṇye phalitaṃ buddhi-kauśalena yaśaṃ prāpayati. Phaladīpikā 13 — vidyā-vyāpāra-karmeṇa uccapadam.

L10_IN_7.name: Daśameśaḥ saptame jāyādvārā-karma-yaśam. Videśa-vyāpāra-rājayogaḥ.
L10_IN_7.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye daśameśaḥ saptamasthaḥ karma-kalatra-saṃyoga-rājayogakārakaḥ — sāthīdvārā karma-yaśaṃ, videśa-vyāpāra-lābhaṃ, sājhedārī-vyavasāyena unnatiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — kalatra-karma-saṃyoga.

L10_IN_9.name: Daśameśo navame mahārājayogaḥ — dharma-karmādhipati-yogaḥ. Śreṣṭhatama-rājayogaḥ.
L10_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye daśameśo navamasthaḥ dharma-karmādhipati-rājayogakārakaḥ — pārāśara-śāstrokta sarvottama rājayogaḥ. Karma bhāgye phalitaṃ pūrṇa-yaśaṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, dharma-rāja-yogaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — śreṣṭhatamaḥ rājayogaḥ.

L11_IN_1.name: Lābheśo lagne sva-prayāsena-lābhaḥ. Mitra-kuṭumba-vardhanam, iṣṭa-siddhiḥ.
L11_IN_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye ekādaśeśo lagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ sva-prayāsena lābhaṃ, mitrakuṭumba-vardhanaṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca prāpayantaṃ karoti. Phaladīpikā 13 — lābha-tanu-saṃyoga-yogaḥ sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

L11_IN_10.name: Lābheśo daśame karma-lābha-yogaḥ. Nirantara-karma-lābhaḥ, ucca-pada-vardhanam.
L11_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye ekādaśeśo daśamasthaḥ karma-lābha-saṃyoga-yogakārakaḥ — āya karmaṇi phalitaḥ nirantara-karma-yaśaṃ, mitra-vyāpāra-lābhaṃ, ucca-pada-vardhanaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — karma-lābha-saṃyogaḥ.

L11_IN_2.name: Lābheśo dvitīye dhana-lābha-saṃyogaḥ. Mitra-kuṭumba-saṃyogena dhana-vṛddhiḥ.
L11_IN_2.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye ekādaśeśo dvitīyasthaḥ dhana-lābha-saṃyoga-yogakārakaḥ — āya dhanabhāve phalitam. Mitra-kuṭumba-saṃyogena nirantara-dhanavṛddhiḥ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-sukham. Phaladīpikā 13 — lābha-dhana-saṃyogāt koṣa-vardhanam.

L11_IN_5.name: Lābheśaḥ pañcame prajñā-lābha-yogaḥ. Putra-śiṣya-dvārā-lābhaḥ, vidyā-dhanam.
L11_IN_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye ekādaśeśaḥ pañcamasthaḥ prajñā-lābha-yogakārakaḥ — āya pūrva-puṇye phalitaṃ buddhi-kauśalena nirantara-lābhaṃ dadāti. Putra-śiṣya-mitra-dvārā-lābhaḥ, saṭṭā-śeyara-lābhaśca. Phaladīpikā 13 — vidyā-lābha-saṃyogaḥ.

L11_IN_9.name: Lābheśo navame bhāgya-lābha-yogaḥ. Dharma-karma-dvārā-lābhaḥ, paitṛka-lābhaḥ.
L11_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye ekādaśeśo navamasthaḥ bhāgya-lābha-saṃyoga-yogakārakaḥ — āyo bhāgye phalitaḥ dharma-karma-guru-kṛpā-dvārā-nirantara-lābhaṃ dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — saubhāgya-lābha-saṃyogaḥ.

L12_IN_12.name: Dvādaśeśaḥ dvādaśe vimalayogaḥ (viparīta-rājayogaḥ). Vyaya-niyantraṇam, mokṣa-yogyatā.
L12_IN_12.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 34 adhyāyānusāraṃ dvādaśeśaḥ dvādaśasthaḥ vimala-viparīta-rājayogakārakaḥ — vyaya-sthāneśo vyaya-sthāne tiṣṭhan vyaya-niyantraṇaṃ, mokṣa-yogyatāṃ, gupta-dāna-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 6 — vimala-yogo dhana-saṃrakṣakaḥ.

L12_IN_6.name: Dvādaśeśaḥ ṣaṣṭhe vimala-viparīta-rājayogaḥ. Vyaya-śatru-saṃyogena śatru-jaya-vyaya-niyantraṇam.
L12_IN_6.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye vimala-yogaḥ uktaḥ — dvādaśeśaḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ vyaya-śatruyoḥ paraspara-nāśena vyaya-niyantraṇaṃ, śatru-jayaṃ, gupta-dāna-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti.

L1_IN_10.name: Lagneśo daśame rājayogakārakaḥ. Karmaṭhaḥ, yaśasvī, rājakīyasammāna-pātraḥ.
L1_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye lagneśo daśamasthaḥ sampūrṇakarma-rājayogaṃ dadāti — kāraka-karmasthāna-yogaḥ. Jātakaḥ karmaṭhaḥ, yaśasvī, rājasammānayuktaḥ, uccapadaprāptaśca bhavati. Phaladīpikā 13 — tanupatiḥ karmasthāne svayameva karmadvārā prasiddhiṃ prāpayati.
L1_IN_10.general: Karma-rājayogaḥ, yaśaḥ, uccapadaprāptiḥ, rājasammānam, svakarmeṇa khyātiḥ.

L1_IN_11.name: Lagneśa ekādaśe lābhayogakārakaḥ. Āyavṛddhiḥ, mitralābhaḥ, iṣṭasiddhiḥ.
L1_IN_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāyānusāraṃ lagneśa ekādaśasthaḥ nirantarāyaṃ lābhayogaṃ dadāti. Jātaka āyavṛddhimān, mitrasukhī, iṣṭasiddhiprāptaḥ, sarvakāmanāpūrakaśca bhavati. Phaladīpikā 13 — tanupatiḥ lābhasthāne sarvakāmanā-siddhiṃ dadāti.

L1_IN_2.name: Lagneśo dvitīye dhanakuṭumbasukhapradaḥ. Buddhivāksampannaḥ, annabhogasamṛddhaḥ.
L1_IN_2.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye bhāvādhipatiphalādhyāyānusāraṃ lagneśo dvitīyabhāve sthitaḥ jātakaṃ dhanadhānyasampannaṃ svakīyārjanena kuṭumbapoṣakaṃ vākpaṭuṃ ca karoti. Tanupatirdhanabhāve ātmānaṃ dravyārjane niyojayati iti phaladīpikā 13 adhyāyaḥ.

L1_IN_3.name: Lagneśastṛtīye parākramīṃ bhrātṛsukhapradaśca. Sāhasī, udyamī, yātrāpriyaḥ.
L1_IN_3.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāyānusāraṃ lagneśastṛtīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ parākramī, bhrātṛsukhayuktaṃ, svakīyodyamena vardhamānaṃ karoti. Phaladīpikāyāṃ 13 adhyāye uktaṃ tanupatiḥ sahajabhāve ātmānaṃ svabāhubalena niyojayati.
L1_IN_3.general: Sāhasam, bhrātṛsukham, udyamaśīlatā, yātrā, svabalena vardhanam.

L1_IN_4.name: Lagneśaścaturthe mātṛsukhaṃ, gṛhaṃ, vāhanaṃ, sampattiṃ dadāti. Hṛdayaprasannatā.
L1_IN_4.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāyānusāraṃ lagneśaścaturthasthaḥ jātakaṃ mātṛvātsalyam, gṛhasukham, vāhanasampattiṃ, hārdikasantoṣaṃ ca prāpayati. Phaladīpikā 13 — tanupatiḥ sukhabhāve sthito hṛdayaprasannatāṃ dadāti.

L1_IN_5.name: Lagneśaḥ pañcame rājayogakārakaḥ. Buddhimān, putravān, mantrasiddhaḥ.
L1_IN_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye lagneśaḥ pañcamasthaḥ sampūrṇarājayogaṃ dadāti — kāraka-trikoṇa-yogaḥ. Jātako buddhimān, putrasukhī, rājakīyasammāna-pātraḥ, mantrasiddhaśca bhavati. Phaladīpikā 13 — tanupatiḥ putrabhāve prajñā-santati-yaśaṃ prāpayati.
L1_IN_5.general: Rājayogaḥ, prajñā, putrasukham, mantrasiddhiḥ, rājakīyasammānam, pūrvapuṇya-phalam.

L1_IN_7.name: Lagneśaḥ saptame videśagamanaṃ, dāmpatyasukham, vyāpāralābhaśca. Jāyāmukhī.
L1_IN_7.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāyānusāraṃ lagneśaḥ saptamasthaḥ dāmpatyapravṛttiṃ, videśagamanaṃ, vyāpāralābhaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — tanupatiḥ kalatrabhāve jātakaṃ jāyāmukhaṃ videśavāsī ca karoti.
L1_IN_7.general: Dāmpatyasukham, videśagamanam, vyāpāralābhaḥ, jāyāprati āsaktiḥ, yātrā-vardhanam.

L1_IN_9.name: Lagneśo navame bhāgyavān, dhārmikaḥ, pitṛsukhī, pūrvapuṇyaphalabhoktā.
L1_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāyānusāraṃ lagneśaḥ bhāgyabhāve sthitaḥ jātakaṃ bhāgyavantaṃ, dhārmikaṃ, pitṛsukhayuktaṃ, pūrvajanmasukṛtaphalabhoktāraṃ ca karoti. Phaladīpikā 13 — tanupatiḥ dharmasthāne rājayogakārako'pi — kāraka-trikoṇa-yogaḥ.
L1_IN_9.general: Saubhāgyam, dharmaniṣṭhā, pitṛsukham, guru-kṛpā, pūrva-puṇya-phalam, rājayogaḥ.

L2_IN_1.name: Dhaneśo lagne svopārjitadhanavān, sthiratanuḥ, dhanārjanapravṛttaḥ.
L2_IN_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāyānusāraṃ dvitīyeśo lagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ svopārjitadhanasampannaṃ, sthiraśarīraṃ, dhanārjanonmukhaṃ ca karoti. Phaladīpikā 13 — dhanapatiḥ tanusthānamāśritya vyaktiṃ arthārjanaprati samarpayati.

L2_IN_10.name: Dhaneśo daśame karmārjitaṃ dhanam. Vyavasāya-yaśaṃ, rājakīya-vetanam.
L2_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye dvitīyeśo daśamasthaḥ karmadvārā dhanārjanaṃ, vyāpārayaśaṃ, rājakīyavetanaṃ dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — svakarmārjitena dhanena kuṭumbaṃ poṣayati.

L2_IN_11.name: Dhaneśo lābhasthāne dhana-lābha-yogaḥ. Nirantarārthalābhaḥ, mitra-kuṭumba-vṛddhiḥ.
L2_IN_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye dvitīyeśo lābhasthāne sampūrṇadhana-lābha-yogaṃ dadāti — dvitīyabhāvāttṛtīye bahu-dhanavṛddhiḥ. Phaladīpikā 13 — sarvakāmanāpūrtiḥ sahiṣṇudhanalābhena.

L2_IN_5.name: Dhaneśaḥ pañcame putra-dhana-saṃyogaḥ. Prajñā-dhanaṃ, rājakīya-saṃrakṣaṇam.
L2_IN_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye dvitīyeśo pañcamasthaḥ dhana-trikoṇa-yogaṃ dadāti — dhanapatiḥ pūrvapuṇyasthāne prajñādvārā arthalābhaṃ, santatidvārā kuṭumba-vṛddhiṃ ca karoti. Phaladīpikā 13 — vidyā-kauśalena dhanārjanam.

L2_IN_9.name: Dhaneśo navame bhāgyalābhaḥ. Paitṛkadhanam, dharmakarmaṇā vṛddhiḥ.
L2_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye dvitīyeśo navamasthaḥ dhana-trikoṇa-yogakārakaḥ — paitṛkadhanalābhaṃ, gurukṛpayārthavṛddhiṃ, dharmakarmadvārārjanaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — bhāgyadvārā kuṭumba-vardhanam.

L3_IN_10.name: Tṛtīyeśo daśame parākrama-karma-yogaḥ. Sāhasena-karma-yaśam, sva-prayāsena-ucca-padam.
L3_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre caturviṃśe adhyāye tṛtīyeśo daśamasthaḥ parākrama-karma-yogakārakaḥ — sāhasena-karma-yaśaṃ, sva-prayāsena-ucca-pada-prāptiṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-karma-saṃyogaṃ ca dadāti. Ubhayoḥ upacaya-sthānayoḥ sambandhaḥ.

L3_IN_11.name: Tṛtīyeśa ekādaśe parākrama-lābha-yogaḥ. Udyamena-nirantara-lābhaḥ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-vṛddhiḥ.
L3_IN_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye tṛtīyeśa ekādaśasthaḥ parākrama-lābha-yogakārakaḥ — sva-prayāsena nirantara-lābhaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-sambandha-vṛddhiṃ, mitra-kuṭumba-vardhanaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — parākrama-lābha-saṃyogaḥ sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

L3_IN_3.name: Tṛtīyeśaḥ tṛtīye parākrama-yogaḥ. Sāhasī, sva-bala-samṛddhaḥ, bhrātṛ-sukhī.
L3_IN_3.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye tṛtīyeśaḥ sva-sthāne sthitaḥ parākrama-yogakārakaḥ — sva-bala-samṛddhiṃ, sāhasam, bhrātṛ-sukhaṃ, udyamaśīlatāṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — parākrama-sthāneśena parākrama-vṛddhiḥ.
L3_IN_3.general: Parākrama-yogaḥ, sva-bala-samṛddhiḥ, sāhasam, bhrātṛ-sukham, udyamaśīlatā, yātrā-lābhaḥ.

L3_IN_6.name: Tṛtīyeśo ṣaṣṭhe śatru-nāśa-yogaḥ. Parākrameṇa śatru-jayaḥ, sevā-kīrtiḥ.
L3_IN_6.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre caturviṃśe adhyāye tṛtīyeśo ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ śatru-nāśa-yogakārakaḥ — parākrama-kārakaḥ śatru-sthāne tiṣṭhan parākrameṇa śatru-jayaṃ, sevā-kīrtiṃ, ṛṇa-kṣayaṃ ca dadāti. Upacaya-sthāne'pi.
L3_IN_6.general: Śatru-nāśa-yogaḥ, parākrameṇa śatru-jayaḥ, sevā-kīrtiḥ, ṛṇa-kṣayaḥ, sāhasa-pradaḥ.

L4_IN_1.name: Caturtheśo lagne sukha-tanu-yogaḥ (rājayogaḥ). Mātṛ-sukha-gṛha-sampatti-samṛddhaḥ.
L4_IN_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye caturtheśo lagnasthaḥ kāraka-karma-kandra-rājayogakārakaḥ — sukhaṃ tanusthānamāśritya vyaktitvameva sukha-samṛddhiṃ dadāti. Mātṛ-sukhaṃ, gṛha-sampattiṃ, hṛdaya-śāntiṃ ca. Phaladīpikā 13 — sukha-tanu-saṃyogāt sampatti-rājayogaḥ.

L4_IN_10.name: Caturtheśo daśame sukha-karma-rājayogaḥ. Gṛha-sampatti-karmeṇa-yaśam.
L4_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye caturtheśo daśamasthaḥ sukha-karma-saṃyoga-rājayogakārakaḥ — sukhaṃ karmaṇi phalitaṃ gṛha-sampatti-vyavasāyena yaśaṃ, mātṛ-karma-saṃyogaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — sukha-karma-saṃyogaḥ kendra-kendra-rājayogaḥ.

L4_IN_4.name: Caturtheśaḥ sukha-sthāne mātṛ-gṛha-yogaḥ. Paitṛka-gṛha-sampatti-vardhanam.
L4_IN_4.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye caturtheśaḥ sva-sthāne sthitaḥ mātṛ-gṛha-samṛddhi-yogakārakaḥ — paitṛka-gṛha-vardhanaṃ, mātṛ-dīrghāyuṃ, sthira-vāsaṃ, hṛdaya-śāntiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — sukha-sthāneśena sukha-vardhanam.

L4_IN_5.name: Caturtheśaḥ pañcame kendra-trikoṇa-yogaḥ. Mātṛ-sukhena-santati-samṛddhiḥ, vidyā-vardhanam.
L4_IN_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekacatvāriṃśe adhyāye caturtheśaḥ pañcamasthaḥ kendra-trikoṇa-yoga-rājayogakārakaḥ — sukha-kārakaḥ (4) pūrva-puṇye (5) phalitaḥ mātṛ-sukhena-santati-vardhanaṃ, vidyā-kauśalaṃ, gṛha-śāntiṃ ca dadāti.
L4_IN_5.general: Kendra-trikoṇa-rājayogaḥ, mātṛ-sukhena santati-vardhanam, vidyā-kauśalam, gṛha-śāntiḥ, paitṛka-gṛha-vardhanam.

L4_IN_9.name: Caturtheśo navame mahārājayogaḥ — sukha-trikoṇa-yogaḥ. Mātṛ-dharma-sampattiḥ.
L4_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye caturtheśo navamasthaḥ sukha-trikoṇa-rājayogakārakaḥ — sukhaṃ bhāgye phalitaṃ mātṛ-sukhaṃ, paitṛka-gṛham, dhārmika-gṛhastha-vṛttiṃ, guru-kṛpāṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — sukha-trikoṇa-saṃyogāt śreṣṭha-rājayogaḥ.

L5_IN_1.name: Pañcameśo lagne rājayogaḥ. Prajñāvān, putravān, dhārmikaḥ.
L5_IN_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye pañcameśo lagnasthaḥ kāraka-trikoṇa-rājayogakārakaḥ — pūrvapuṇyaṃ tanusthānamāśritya prajñāṃ, putrasukhaṃ, dhārmikavṛttiṃ prāpayati. Phaladīpikā 13 — sūtrātmā-lagna-sambandhāt sukṛta-phalabhoga.
L5_IN_1.general: Rājayogaḥ, prajñā, putrasukham, mantrasiddhiḥ, dharmaniṣṭhā, pūrvapuṇyaphalam.

L5_IN_10.name: Pañcameśo daśame rājayogaḥ — karma-trikoṇa-yogaḥ. Buddhyā yaśo labhate.
L5_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye pañcameśo daśamasthaḥ karma-trikoṇa-rājayogaṃ dadāti — pūrva-puṇyaṃ karmaṇi phalitam. Jātako buddhimattā-kauśalābhyāṃ yaśaḥ prāpnoti, rāja-sammāna-pātraśca bhavati. Phaladīpikā 13 — vidyā-vyāpāra-karmeṇa uccapadaprāptiḥ.

L5_IN_11.name: Pañcameśa ekādaśe prajñā-lābha-yogaḥ. Putradvārā-lābhaḥ, vidyā-lābhaḥ.
L5_IN_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye pañcameśa ekādaśasthaḥ prajñā-lābha-yogaṃ dadāti — pūrva-puṇyaṃ lābhasthāne phalitam. Jātakaḥ putra-śiṣya-mitradvārā lābhaṃ, vidyādvārā-dhanaṃ, saṭṭā-śeyara-lābhaṃ ca prāpnoti. Phaladīpikā 13 — sarvārtha-lābhaḥ.

L5_IN_2.name: Pañcameśo dvitīye dhana-trikoṇa-yogaḥ. Prajñādvārā-dhanam, putra-dhana-yogaḥ.
L5_IN_2.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye pañcameśo dvitīyasthaḥ dhana-trikoṇa-yogaḥ — pūrva-puṇyaṃ dhanabhāve lābhaṃ dadāti. Prajñāyāḥ vāṇīdvārā vā arthārjanam, santaterdvārā kuṭumba-vṛddhiḥ. Phaladīpikā 13 — vidyā-kauśalena koṣa-vardhanam.

L5_IN_4.name: Pañcameśaścaturthe mātṛ-santati-sukhayogaḥ. Hṛdayaprasannatā, gṛhadharmaḥ.
L5_IN_4.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye pañcameśaścaturthasthaḥ jātakaṃ mātṛ-santati-sukhaṃ, gṛha-dharma-vṛttiṃ, hārdika-śāntiṃ dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — pūrva-puṇyaṃ sukhabhāve phalitamiti.

L5_IN_7.name: Pañcameśaḥ saptame dāmpatye putra-yathā-puṇyayogaḥ. Jāyādvārā yaśam.
L5_IN_7.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye pañcameśaḥ saptamasthaḥ jātakaṃ putra-kalatra-yogayuktaṃ, jāyādvārā yaśaṃ prāpnuvantaṃ, vyāpāreṇa lābhaṃ prāpayantaṃ ca karoti. Phaladīpikā 13 — pūrva-puṇyaṃ kalatra-bhāve phalitamiti.
L5_IN_7.general: Dāmpatya-sukham, jāyādvārā yaśam, putra-yogaḥ, vyāpāra-lābhaḥ, yātrā-lābhaḥ.

L5_IN_9.name: Pañcameśo navame mahārājayogaḥ — dvi-trikoṇa-saṃyogaḥ. Atyantabhāgyavān.
L5_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye pañcameśo navamasthaḥ dvi-trikoṇayogaṃ dadāti — pūrva-puṇyaṃ bhāgye ekībhūtam. Jātako'tyantabhāgyavān, dhārmikaḥ, gurukṛpā-pātraḥ, sarvaśāstrajñaśca bhavati. Phaladīpikā 13 — sarvottama rājayogaḥ.
L5_IN_9.general: Mahārājayogaḥ, atyantasaubhāgyam, gurukṛpā, dharmaniṣṭhā, sarva-śāstra-jñānam, atīva-yaśaḥ.

L6_IN_10.name: Ṣaṣṭheśo daśame sevā-karma-yogaḥ. Śatru-karma-saṃyogena-yaśam.
L6_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre caturviṃśe adhyāye ṣaṣṭheśo daśamasthaḥ sevā-karma-yogakārakaḥ — śatru-kārakaḥ karma-sthāne tiṣṭhan sevā-varga-kīrtiṃ, adhikāra-saṅgharṣa-yaśaṃ, cikitsā-vā-nyāya-vyavasāyaṃ ca dadāti. Upacaya-sthāneṣu sambandhaḥ.

L6_IN_11.name: Ṣaṣṭheśo lābhasthāne śatru-lābha-yogaḥ. Śatru-karma-kāraṇena-dhana-vṛddhiḥ.
L6_IN_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre caturviṃśe adhyāye ṣaṣṭheśo lābhasthāne śatru-lābha-yogakārakaḥ — śatru-karmadvārā (cikitsā-nyāya-sevā-saṅgharṣa) nirantara-dhana-lābhaṃ, ṛṇa-niyantraṇaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-saṅgharṣa-yaśaṃ ca dadāti. Ubhayoḥ upacayoḥ sambandhaḥ.

L6_IN_3.name: Ṣaṣṭheśastṛtīye parākrama-śatru-yogaḥ. Parākrameṇa-śatru-nāśaḥ, sāhasaḥ.
L6_IN_3.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre caturviṃśe adhyāye ṣaṣṭheśastṛtīyasthaḥ parākrama-śatru-saṃyoga-yogakārakaḥ — parākrameṇa śatru-nāśaṃ, sāhasaṃ, ṛṇa-niyantraṇaṃ ca dadāti. Ubhayoḥ upacayoḥ sambandhāt madhyamaṃ śubha-phalam.

L6_IN_6.name: Ṣaṣṭheśaḥ ṣaṣṭhe harṣayogaḥ (viparīta-rājayogaḥ). Śatrujayaḥ, roganivṛttiḥ, ṛṇakṣayaḥ.
L6_IN_6.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 34 adhyāyānusāraṃ ṣaṣṭheśaḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ harṣa-viparīta-rājayogakārakaḥ — duṣṭeśo duṣṭabhāve sthitaḥ śubha-phalaṃ dadāti iti viparīta-nyāyaḥ. Jātakaḥ śatrujayī, roganivṛttaḥ, ṛṇa-muktaśca bhavati. Phaladīpikā 6 — duṣṭeśo duṣṭe śubhadaḥ.

L6_IN_8.name: Ṣaṣṭheśo'ṣṭame harṣa-viparīta-rājayogaḥ. Śatru-maraṇa-saṃyogena śubha-phalam.
L6_IN_8.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye (śloka 17-19) harṣa-yogaḥ uktaḥ — ṣaṣṭheśo'ṣṭamasthaḥ duṣṭeśo duṣṭa-sthāne sthitaḥ śubha-phalaṃ dadāti iti viparīta-nyāyaḥ. Śatru-maraṇayoḥ paraspara-nāśena śatru-jayaṃ, dīrghāyuṃ, ṛṇa-kṣayaṃ, gupta-dhana-lābhaṃ ca dadāti.

L7_IN_1.name: Saptameśo lagne jāyādvārā-vṛddhiḥ, paradeśe yaśam. Dāmpatyapravṛttaḥ.
L7_IN_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye saptameśo lagnasthaḥ jāyādvārā vardhamānaṃ, paradeśe yaśaṃ prāpnuvantaṃ, dāmpatyonmukhaṃ ca karoti. Phaladīpikā 13 — kalatrapatistanusthānamāśritya vyaktitvaṃ sāthiprati samarpayati.

L7_IN_10.name: Saptameśo daśame sāthīdvārā-karmayaśam. Videśa-vyāpāra-rājayogaḥ.
L7_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye saptameśo daśamasthaḥ karma-kalatra-saṃyoga-rājayogaḥ — sāthīdvārā karma-yaśaṃ, videśa-vyāpāra-lābhaṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — dāmpatya-vyāpāra-karmeṇa uccapadaprāptiḥ.

L7_IN_4.name: Saptameśaścaturthe jāyā-gṛha-yogaḥ. Dāmpatyadvārā-gṛhasaukhyam.
L7_IN_4.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye saptameśaścaturthasthaḥ jāyādvārā gṛhasaukhyaṃ, sthira-dāmpatyaṃ, paitṛka-sampattau sāthinaḥ sahayogaṃ dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — kalatrapatiḥ sukhasthāne hṛdaya-śāntiṃ prāpayati.

L7_IN_5.name: Saptameśaḥ pañcame kendra-trikoṇa-yogaḥ. Dāmpatyena-santati-vardhanam, sāthī-kāraṇena-yaśam.
L7_IN_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekacatvāriṃśe adhyāye saptameśaḥ pañcamasthaḥ kendra-trikoṇa-rājayogaḥ — kalatra-kārakaḥ (7) pūrva-puṇya-sthāne (5) phalitaḥ dāmpatyena santati-vardhanaṃ, sāthī-kāraṇena yaśaṃ, sahayogi-vyāpāreṇa lābhaṃ ca dadāti.

L7_IN_9.name: Saptameśo navame jāyā-bhāgyodayaḥ. Dhārmika-sāthinyā bhāgyavṛddhiḥ.
L7_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye saptameśo navamasthaḥ jāyādvārā bhāgyodayaṃ, dhārmika-sāthinyā-saṃyogaṃ, videśa-dharmayātrāṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 13 — kalatra-pati-dharma-sthāna-saṃyogāt sāthīdvārā guru-kṛpā.
L7_IN_9.general: Jāyā-bhāgyodayaḥ, dhārmika-sāthinī, videśa-dharmayātrā, guru-kṛpā sāthī-dvārā, dharma-karma-lābhaḥ.

L8_IN_12.name: Aṣṭameśo dvādaśe sarala-viparīta-rājayogaḥ. Maraṇa-vyaya-saṃyogena dīrghāyuḥ.
L8_IN_12.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye sarala-yogaḥ uktaḥ — aṣṭameśo dvādaśasthaḥ maraṇa-vyayoḥ paraspara-nāśena dīrghāyuṃ, gupta-dhana-lābhaṃ, mokṣa-yogyatāṃ, mṛtyu-bhaya-nāśaṃ ca dadāti.

L8_IN_8.name: Aṣṭameśaḥ aṣṭame saralayogaḥ (viparīta-rājayogaḥ). Dīrghāyuḥ, gupta-dhanalābhaḥ, mṛtyuñjayaḥ.
L8_IN_8.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 34 adhyāyānusāraṃ aṣṭameśaḥ aṣṭamasthaḥ sarala-viparīta-rājayogakārakaḥ — maraṇa-sthāneśo maraṇa-sthāne tiṣṭhan dīrghāyuṃ, gupta-dhana-lābhaṃ, adbhuta-śaktiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 6 — sarala-yogo dīrghāyuṣaḥ kārakaḥ.

L9_IN_1.name: Bhāgyeśo lagne rājayogaḥ. Bhāgyavān, dhārmikaḥ, gurukṛpā-pātraḥ.
L9_IN_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye bhāgyeśo lagnasthaḥ kāraka-trikoṇa-rājayogakārakaḥ — bhāgyaṃ tanusthānamāśritya vyaktitvameva bhāgyodayaṃ karoti. Jātakaḥ atyantabhāgyavān, dhārmikaḥ, gurukṛpā-pātraḥ. Phaladīpikā 13 — bhāgya-tanu-saṃyoga evaṃ śreṣṭha-rājayogaḥ.
L9_IN_1.general: Rājayogaḥ, atyantasaubhāgyam, dharmaniṣṭhā, gurukṛpā, pitṛ-sukham, svayaṃ-bhāgyodayaḥ.

L9_IN_10.name: Bhāgyeśo daśame śreṣṭhatamo dharma-karmādhipati-yogaḥ. Pūrṇa-yaśam, rāja-sammānam.
L9_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekacatvāriṃśe adhyāye bhāgyeśo daśamasthaḥ dharma-karmādhipati-yogaḥ — pārāśara-śāstrokta sarvottama-rājayogānāṃ madhye ekaḥ. Karma bhāgye phalitaṃ pūrṇa-yaśaṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, dharma-rāja-yogaṃ, sarva-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 6 — śreṣṭhatamo rājayogaḥ.

L9_IN_11.name: Bhāgyeśa ekādaśe bhāgya-lābha-yogaḥ. Nirantara-bhāgyodayaḥ, mitradvārā-dharmalābhaḥ.
L9_IN_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye bhāgyeśa ekādaśasthaḥ bhāgya-lābha-yogakārakaḥ — bhāgyaṃ lābhasthānamāśritya nirantaraṃ phalitam. Mitradvārā dharma-lābhaṃ, dhārmika-kuṭumbaṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca prāpayati. Phaladīpikā 13 — sarvārtha-lābhaḥ.

L9_IN_2.name: Bhāgyeśo dvitīye dhana-trikoṇa-yogaḥ. Bhāgyodayādvārā kuṭumba-dhanavṛddhiḥ.
L9_IN_2.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye bhāgyeśo dvitīyasthaḥ dhana-trikoṇa-yogakārakaḥ — bhāgyaṃ dhanasthānamāśritya kuṭumbaṃ samṛddhaṃ karoti. Paitṛkadhanalābhaḥ, dharmārjanam, madhura-dhārmika-vāṇī ca. Phaladīpikā 13 — saubhāgyena koṣa-vardhanam.

L9_IN_4.name: Bhāgyeśaścaturthe mātṛ-gṛha-bhāgyayogaḥ. Paitṛkagṛham, mātṛsukham, dharmagṛhītavṛttiḥ.
L9_IN_4.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye bhāgyeśaścaturthasthaḥ mātṛ-gṛha-bhāgyayogaṃ dadāti — mātṛ-sukhaṃ, paitṛka-gṛha-vardhanaṃ, dhārmika-gṛhastha-vṛttiṃ ca prāpayati. Phaladīpikā 13 — bhāgyaṃ sukhasthāne hṛdaya-śāntiṃ dadāti.

L9_IN_5.name: Bhāgyeśaḥ pañcame mahā-rājayogaḥ — dvi-trikoṇa-saṃyogaḥ. Putra-bhāgyodayaḥ.
L9_IN_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye bhāgyeśaḥ pañcamasthaḥ dvi-trikoṇa-mahā-rājayogakārakaḥ — bhāgya-pūrvapuṇya-saṃyogaḥ. Jātakaḥ atyanta-bhāgyavān, dhārmika-putra-sukhī, guru-kṛpā-pātraḥ, mantra-siddhaśca bhavati. Phaladīpikā 13 — sarvottama rājayogaḥ.
L9_IN_5.general: Mahā-rājayogaḥ, dvi-trikoṇa-yogaḥ, putra-bhāgyodayaḥ, guru-kṛpā, mantra-siddhiḥ, dharmaniṣṭhā.

L9_IN_7.name: Bhāgyeśaḥ saptame jāyādvārā-bhāgyodayaḥ. Dāmpatya-dharma-saṃyogaḥ.
L9_IN_7.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 adhyāye bhāgyeśaḥ saptamasthaḥ jāyādvārā bhāgyodayaṃ dadāti — sāthinaḥ dhārmika-śāstra-jñāna-guṇayuktā, videśa-dharma-yātrāḥ, guru-kṛpā-saṃyogaśca. Phaladīpikā 13 — bhāgya-kalatra-saṃyogaḥ.

LAGNADHI.name: Lagnādhi yogaḥ — lagnāt 6-7-8 śubhāḥ. Lagna-kāraka-saṃrakṣaṇam.
LAGNADHI.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye lagnādhi-yogaḥ — lagnāt 6-7-8 sthāneṣu śubha-grahāḥ tiṣṭhantaḥ lagna-kāraka-saṃrakṣaṇaṃ, sarva-dig-śubhaṃ, adhi-yoga-tulya-kīrtiṃ dadati. Ādhi-yogasya lagna-saṃskaraṇa-svarūpam.

LAGNA_LORD_12.name: Ariṣṭayogaḥ — lagneśo dvādaśabhāve — ātmavyayaḥ videśavāso vairāgyaṃ ca.
LAGNA_LORD_12.prose: Yadā lagneśaḥ dvādaśabhāve (vyayabhāve) tiṣṭhati, tadā jātakasya manasi vairāgyabhāvaḥ samutpadyate. Ayaṃ videśavāsaṃ karoti, ātmaśaktiśca vyayībhūtā bhavati. Ādhyātmikamārge dhyānayoge ca jātakasya viśiṣṭā gatirjāyate. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — lagneśasya mantrajapaḥ, niyamitadhyānasādhanā ca śubhā.

LAGNA_LORD_6.name: Ariṣṭayogaḥ — lagneśo ṣaṣṭhabhāve — ātmaśatrusaṃvādaḥ tanudaurbalyaṃ ca.
LAGNA_LORD_6.prose: Yadā tanubhāvasya svāmī lagneśaḥ ṣaṣṭhabhāve (ripubhāve) sthito bhavati, tadā ariṣṭayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya jīvanaṃ nirantarasaṅgharṣamayaṃ bhavati, śarīraṃ ca rogagrastaṃ bhavet. Parantu sainyasevā, krīḍā, nyāyavivādādiṣu jātakaḥ prabalaśatrunāśakaḥ prakhyāto bhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — lagneśasya balavardhanam, hanumadārādhanā ca śreyaskarī.

LAGNA_LORD_8.name: Ariṣṭayogaḥ — lagneśo'ṣṭamabhāve — āyurbalabādhā gūḍhavijñānapraveśaśca.
LAGNA_LORD_8.prose: Yadā lagneśaḥ aṣṭamabhāve (mṛtyubhāve) tiṣṭhati, tadā śarīrasya mūlaūrjā nyūnā bhavati, bālyakāle ca saṅkaṭaṃ jāyate. Parantu jātakasya gūḍhavidyāsu, anusandhāne, adhyātmakṣetre ca asādhāraṇā gatiḥ sambhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — lagneśasya japaḥ, mahāmṛtyuñjayamantrārādhanā, gurusevā ca rakṣāṃ karoti.

LAKSHMI_BHAGYA_VENUS_9.name: Lakṣmī-bhāgya yoga — śukra navame — artha-vaibhava-bhāgyam.
LAKSHMI_BHAGYA_VENUS_9.prose: Lakṣmī-bhāgya-yogaḥ śukro navame yadi syāt, tadā vaibhava-bhāgyam lakṣmyā prasannatā ca pradāti.

LAKSHMI_CHANDRA.name: Lakṣmī-candra yogaḥ — candra-śukrayoḥ parasparakendrasthatve — mahālakṣmīkṛpā.
LAKSHMI_CHANDRA.prose: Candraśca śukraśca parasparaṃ kendra-bhāveṣu yadi tiṣṭhetām, tadā lakṣmī-candra-yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ rūpavān, kalāvān, vipuladhanasampannaḥ, dāmpatyasukhayuktaśca bhavati.

LIPI_BUDDHI_MERCURY_3.name: Lipi-buddhi yoga — budha tṛtīye — lekhana-vākpaṭutvam.
LIPI_BUDDHI_MERCURY_3.prose: Lipi-buddhi-yogaḥ budho tṛtīya-sthāne sva/ucca/mitra-rāśiṣu yadi syāt, tadā lekhanī-vākpaṭutvaṃ pradāti.

MAALA.name: Mālā yogaḥ — caturtha-saptama-daśameṣu śubhāḥ. Puṣpa-mālā-samānam sarva-śubham.
MAALA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye mālā yogaḥ — caturtha-saptama-daśama-sthāneṣu eva śubha-grahāḥ tiṣṭhanti. Puṣpa-mālā-samānāṃ sarva-śubhaṃ — sarva-dig-prasannatāṃ, gṛha-sukhaṃ, dāmpatyānandaṃ, karma-yaśaṃ ca dadāti.

MADHYARISHTA_8_LORD_RETROGRADE_8.name: Madhyāriṣṭayogaḥ — aṣṭameśo vakrī aṣṭamabhāve — madhyajīvane gambhīrasaṅkaṭaḥ.
MADHYARISHTA_8_LORD_RETROGRADE_8.prose: Yadā aṣṭameśaḥ svagṛhe (aṣṭame) vakragatyā tiṣṭhati, tadā madhyāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Mṛtyupatiḥ vakrī bhūtvā jātakasya madhyajīvane (32 taḥ 64 varṣaparyantaṃ) vakragatyā daśākāle akasmāt gambhīrasaṅkaṭaṃ prāṇabhayaṃ ca dadāti. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — aṣṭameśaśāntiḥ, mahāmṛtyuñjayamantrāradhanā ca paramauṣadham.

MADHYARISHTA_LAGNA_8_LORDS_DUSTHANA.name: Madhyāriṣṭayogaḥ — lagna-aṣṭameśau duḥsthāne — madhyajīvane gambhīratanusaṅkaṭaḥ.
MADHYARISHTA_LAGNA_8_LORDS_DUSTHANA.prose: Yadā lagneśaḥ aṣṭameśaśca ubhau trikabhāveṣu (6, 8, 12) tiṣṭhataḥ, tadā madhyāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Śarīrapatiḥ mṛtyupatiśca dvau durbalau bhūtvā madhyajīvane tīvraṃ śārīrikakaṣṭaṃ rogabhayaṃ ca dadātaḥ. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — lagneśa-aṣṭameśayoḥ śāntiḥ, mahāmṛtyuñjayamantrārādhanā ca paramā.

MADHYARISHTA_MOON_HEMMED_4.name: Madhyāriṣṭayogaḥ — candro caturthe pāpakartarīveṣṭitaḥ —  mānasikaveṣṭanaṃ gṛhakleśaśca.
MADHYARISHTA_MOON_HEMMED_4.prose: Yadā candraḥ caturthabhāve tiṣṭhati, tṛtīya-pañcamabhāveṣu ca pāpagrahāḥ bhavanti, tadā pāpakartarīyogavaśāt madhyāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Manaḥkārakasya candrasya manaḥsthāne pāpaveṣṭanāt jātakasya madhyajīvane gambhīraḥ mānasikatanāvaḥ, nidrānāśaḥ, gṛhakleśaśca utpadyante. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — candraśāntiḥ, somavāravratam, śivārādhanā ca  śreyaskarī.

MADHYARISHTA_SUN_MARS_6.name: Madhyāriṣṭayogaḥ — sūryamaṅgalau ṣaṣṭhabhāve — tīvraśatrubādhā jvarapīḍā ca.
MADHYARISHTA_SUN_MARS_6.prose: Yadā sūryamaṅgalau ṣaṣṭhabhāve ekatra tiṣṭhataḥ, tadā madhyāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Ātmakārako'gnikārako ripubhāve sthitatvāt madhyajīvane tīvraśatrusaṅgharṣam, jvarabādhām, śastrāghātaṃ vā janayati. Parantu śatrunāśāya apūrvā śaktirapi prāpyate. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — sūryamaṅgalyoḥ śāntiḥ śubhā.

MADHYAYU_BALANCED_LORDS.name: Madhyāyu yogaḥ — lagneśāṣṭameśayoḥ samabalatvam — madhyama-vayaḥ.
MADHYAYU_BALANCED_LORDS.prose: Madhyāyu-yogo lagneśāṣṭameśayoḥ sama-bale sati jāyate, anena jātakaḥ dvātriṃśadvarṣāt dvisaptativarṣaparyantaṃ madhyama-āyuḥ prāpnoti.

MADHYAYU_JUPITER_TRIKONA.name: Madhyāyu yogaḥ — trikoṇe devagurau — dharmakṛpāyuktaṃ madhyāyutvam.
MADHYAYU_JUPITER_TRIKONA.prose: Madhyāyu-yogo gurustrikoṇe (1, 5, 9) sthite sati jāyate, devaguroḥ kṛpāyogāt jātakaḥ dharmaniṣṭhaḥ san madhyāyuṣaṃ labhate.

MADHYAYU_LAGNA_KENDRA_8_DUSTHANA.name: Madhyāyu yogaḥ — kendre lagneśe duḥsthāne'ṣṭameśe ca — madhyama-āyuḥ.
MADHYAYU_LAGNA_KENDRA_8_DUSTHANA.prose: Madhyāyu-yogo lagneśaḥ kendra-bhāve, aṣṭameśo duṣṭāna-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā madhyama-āyurbhavati.

MAHA_BHAGYA_DAY_OR_NIGHT_BIRTH.name: Mahābhāgya yoga — lagna-sūrya-candra samāna-rāśi — mahad bhāgyam.
MAHA_BHAGYA_DAY_OR_NIGHT_BIRTH.prose: Mahābhāgya-yogaḥ phaladīpikā-śāstrasya 6-34-adhyāye kathitaḥ. Puruṣa-dina-janma: lagna-sūrya-candrāḥ sarve viṣama-rāśiṣu. Strī-rātri-janma: sarve sama-rāśiṣu. Etad sarvocca-bhāgya-yogānāṃ prathamaḥ.

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_10.name: Mahāparivartanayogaḥ (1-10) — lagneśadaśameśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — ātmakarmaikyatvam.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_10.prose: Yadā lagnādhipatiḥ daśamabhāve tathā daśamādhipatiḥ lagnabhāve parasparaṃ rāśiparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā mahāparivartanayogaḥ (1-10) samajāyate. Ayaṃ yogaḥ jātakasya vyaktitvaṃ karmaṇā saha dṛḍhatayā badhnāti, yena jātakaḥ samāje paramarājayogatulyāṃ kīrtiṃ, rājyasammānaṃ, varcasvaṃ ca prāpnoti. (Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstra 34.13)

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_4.name: Mahāparivartanayogaḥ (1-4) — lagneśacaturtheśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — ātmagṛhaikyatvam.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_4.prose: Yadā lagnādhipatiḥ caturthabhāve tathā caturthādhipatiḥ lagnabhāve parasparaṃ rāśiparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā mahāparivartanayogaḥ (1-4) samajāyate. Anena yogena jātakasya ātmabalaṃ gṛhasukhaṃ ca parasparaṃ sambaddhaṃ bhavati, jātakaḥ mātṛsukhaṃ, vāhanaṃ, bhūmiṃ ca samprāpya niścayena sarvakleśamukto bhavati. (Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstra 34.13)

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_7.name: Mahāparivartanayogaḥ (1-7) — lagneśasaptameśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — ātmadāmpatyadarpaṇaḥ.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_1_7.prose: Lagnādhipatiḥ saptamabhāve tathā saptamādhipatiḥ lagnabhāve yadā parasparaṃ gṛhaparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā mahāparivartanayogaḥ (1-7) jāyate. Ayaṃ yogaḥ jātakasya tasya jīvanasahacarasya ca vyaktitvayoḥ parasparadarpaṇarūpaṃ sāmañjasyaṃ phalayati, dāmpatyajīvanaṃ ca sukhamayaṃ karoti. (Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstra 34.13)

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_4_10.name: Mahāparivartanayogaḥ (4-10) — caturtheśadaśameśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — sukhakarmakendrākṣam.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_4_10.prose: Yadā caturthādhipatiḥ daśamabhāve tathā daśamādhipatiḥ caturthabhāve parasparaṃ sthānaparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā mahāparivartanayogaḥ (4-10) sampadyate. Anena kuṇḍalyāḥ stambhadvayaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ bhūtvā jātakasya gṛhavātāvaraṇaṃ tasya vyāvasāyikamunnatiṃ ca parasparaṃ poṣayati. (Phaladīpikā adhyāya 6)

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_4_7.name: Mahāparivartanayogaḥ (4-7) — caturtheśasaptameśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — gṛhadāmpatyasaṃyogaḥ.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_4_7.prose: Caturthādhipatiḥ saptamabhāve tathā saptamādhipatiḥ caturthabhāve yadā parasparaṃ gṛhaparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā mahāparivartanayogaḥ (4-7) phalayati. Anena gṛhasaukhyaṃ dāmpatyasukhaṃ ca parasparaṃ pūrakaṃ bhavati, jīvanasahacarasya sāhāyyena gṛhalakṣmīsampadā prāpyate. (Phaladīpikā adhyāya 6)

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_5_10.name: Dharmakarmadhipatiyogaḥ (5-10) — pañcameśadaśameśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — paramarājayogaḥ.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_5_10.prose: Yadā pañcamādhipatiḥ daśamabhāve tathā daśamādhipatiḥ pañcamabhāve parasparaṃ rāśiparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā paramarājayogapraḥ dharmakarmādhipatiyogaḥ (5-10) jāyate. Trikoṇeśasya kendreśasya ca ayamuttamasambandhaḥ jātakasya pūrvapuṇyaṃ tasya karmaṇā saha yojayitvā asādhāraṇaṃ rājyādhikāraṃ, kīrtiṃ, śreṣṭhamatiṃ ca dadāti. (Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstra 34.13)

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_5_7.name: Mahāparivartanayogaḥ (5-7) — pañcameśasaptameśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — pūrvapuṇyadāmpatyasaṃyogaḥ.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_5_7.prose: Pañcamādhipatiḥ saptamabhāve tathā saptamādhipatiḥ pañcamabhāve yadā parasparaṃ rāśiparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā mahāparivartanayogaḥ (5-7) samajāyate. Pūrvapuṇyadhipateḥ dāmpatyādhipateśca ayaṃ vinimayaḥ jātakasya sukṛtakarmaṇā saha tasya vivāhaṃ yojayati, yena buddhimān sahacaraḥ suyogyasantatiśca prāpyante. (Phaladīpikā adhyāya 6)

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_7_10.name: Mahāparivartanayogaḥ (7-10) — saptameśadaśameśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — dāmpatyakarmasaṃyogaḥ.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_7_10.prose: Saptamādhipatiḥ daśamabhāve tathā daśamādhipatiḥ saptamabhāve yadā parasparaṃ gṛhaparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā mahāparivartanayogaḥ (7-10) bhavati. Anena vyāpārikasahayogaḥ, janasamparkaḥ, jīvanasahacarasya sāhāyyena karmakṣetre mahatī unnatiśca prāpyante. (Phaladīpikā adhyāya 6)

MAHA_PARIVARTANA_9_10.name: Dharmakarmadhipatiyogaḥ (9-10) — navameśadaśameśayoḥ paraspararāśiparivartanam — sarvotkṛṣṭaparamarājayogaḥ.
MAHA_PARIVARTANA_9_10.prose: Navamādhipatiḥ daśamabhāve tathā daśamādhipatiḥ navamabhāve yadā parasparaṃ rāśiparivartanaṃ kurutaḥ, tadā sarvotkṛṣṭaḥ paramarājayogapradaḥ dharmakarmādhipatiyogaḥ (9-10) samajāyate. Bhāgyeśakarmeśayoḥ ayaṃ paramapavitrasambandhaḥ jātakasya jīvanaṃ daivīyakṛpāyuktaṃ karoti, yena saḥ atulyavaibhavaṃ, kīrtiṃ, dharmaparāyaṇatāṃ ca prāpnoti. (Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstra 34.13)

MAHENDRA_ABSENCE.name: Mahendra-abhāvaḥ — viśeṣa-kūṭābhāva-yogyaḥ. Santati-vardhana-nyūnatā.
MAHENDRA_ABSENCE.prose: Muhūrta-cintāmaṇau aṣṭame adhyāye mahendra kūṭa — vara-nakṣatrāt vadhū-nakṣatraṃ 4-7-10-13-16-19-22-25 dūre cet pūrṇa-kūṭaḥ. Abhāve — santati-vardhana-nyūnatā, parivāra-vṛddhi-kaṣṭa-yogyatā dadāti.

MALAVYA.name: Lagnāt candramaso vā kendre svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe bhṛgusute mālavyayogo jāyate. Anena jātakaḥ sundarāṅgaḥ, vilāsī, kalānipuṇaḥ, dāmpatyasukhasampannaśca bhavati.
MALAVYA.prose: Atha pañcamahāpuruṣayogeṣu caturtho mālavyayogaḥ. Daityagurau svoccasvarkṣagate kendre mālavyayogaḥ sañjāyate. Asya phalaṃ pārāśarahorāśāstre suviśadamuktam — 'sthūlāṅgaḥ sudṛḍhaḥ sugandhivadanaḥ... Suvāhyaḥ subhago dhanī.' Śukrasya naisargikasaundaryaṃ kalātmakatvaṃ tathā ca kendrabhāvasya aiśvaryotpādakatvaṃ militvā jātakaṃ lalitakalāsu, citrakalāyāṃ, saṅgīte, kūṭanītau tathā ca vilāsīvastunāṃ vyāpāre jagatprasiddhaṃ karoti.
MALAVYA.body: Atīva sundaraṃ rūpaṃ, kāntimannayane, sugandhiyuktaḥ śvāsaḥ

MALAVYA_BHANGA.name: Kendrabhāvagate svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe'pi śukre astaṅgate vakriṇi vā sati mālavyabhaṅgayogo jāyate. Anena mālavyayogasya śubhaphaleṣu hrāso bhavati.
MALAVYA_BHANGA.prose: Yadā bhṛgusutaḥ śukraḥ kendrasthāneṣu svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇarāśistho'pi san sūryeṇa saha yutatvāt astaṅgato bhavati, athavā vakrī-gatyā yukto bhavati, tadā mālavyabhaṅgayogo jāyate. Śukraḥ saundarya-vilāsitā-dāmpatyasukhānāṃ kārakaḥ, ataḥ asya astaṅgatatvena vakrītvena vā dāmpatyajīvane samaya-samayamā kalahaḥ, dhanavyayapravṛttiḥ, tathā ca śārīrikasaundarye ātmasaṃśayaḥ utpadyate. Bhagavatī lakṣmī-upāsanā, śukragāyatrīmantrajapena ca asya doṣasya nivāraṇaṃ bhavati.

MALAVYA_EXALTED.name: Kendrabhāvagate mīnarāśisthe (paramoccasthe) śukre uccamālavyasañjño mahāyogo bhavati. Ayamuccatamakoṭeḥ paramavaibhavayogaḥ.
MALAVYA_EXALTED.prose: Atha mālavyayogasya paramaśreṣṭharūpamuccamālavyayogaḥ. Yadā śukraḥ svaparamoccarāśau mīne (27 aṃśe) sthitaḥ san kendre bhavati, tadā ayaṃ yogaḥ paramaṃ saubhāgyaṃ vaibhavaṃ ca pradāti. Śukraḥ kalā-saundarya-dāmpatyasukhānāṃ kārakaḥ, mīnarāśistu tasya paramapriyaṃ sthānam, tayoḥ saṃyogāt jātakaḥ rājasīvilāsena sukhasampanno bhavati. Laliteṣu kalāsu, citrakalāyāṃ, saṅgīte, kūṭanītau vā jātakaḥ kīrtiśikharaṃ gacchati.

MALAVYA_FROM_MOON.name: Candralagnāt kendre svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe śukre candramālavyayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya manasi kalā-saundarya-vilāsitāsu rasikatā utpadyate.
MALAVYA_FROM_MOON.prose: Yadā jātakasya kuṇḍalyāṃ candralagnāt kendrabhāveṣu śukraḥ svocce svarkṣe vā sthito bhavati, tadā candramālavyayogo jāyate. Candraḥ manasaḥ kārakaḥ, śukrastu kalāyāḥ saundaryasya ca; tayoḥ saṃyogāt jātakasya manasi adbhūtaḥ kalāpremā, saundaryabodhaḥ, susaṃskṛtā rasikatā ca vikasati. Jātakaḥ saṅgīte, kāvye, laliteṣu kalāsu ca atīva nipuṇo bhavati. Yadi lagna-candra-dvayoḥ kendre śukraḥ sthitaḥ syāt, tadā jātakaḥ mahān kalākāraḥ, rājasīvaibhavayuktaḥ prakhyātiprāptaśca bhavati.

MALEFIC_IN_3_6.name: Tṛtīya-ṣaṣṭhayoḥ pāpāḥ — upacaya-pāpa-yogaḥ. Parākrameṇa-śatrujayaḥ.
MALEFIC_IN_3_6.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye tṛtīya-ṣaṣṭhayoḥ pāpa-saṃyogaḥ upacaya-pāpa-yogakārakaḥ — parākrameṇa śatrujayaṃ, sāhasa-karma, senā-nāyakatva-vā-nyāya-vyavasāyaṃ, ṛṇa-niyantraṇaṃ dadāti. Pāpa-sthāna-pāpena śubha-phalam.

MALEFIC_IN_3_6_11.name: Tṛtīya-ṣaṣṭha-ekādaśeṣu pāpāḥ — sarva-upacaya-pāpa-yogaḥ. Sampūrṇa-parākrama-dhana.
MALEFIC_IN_3_6_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye tṛtīya-ṣaṣṭha-ekādaśeṣu sarvatra pāpa-saṃyogaḥ sarva-upacaya-pāpa-yogakārakaḥ — sampūrṇa-parākrama-śatrujaya-nirantara-dhana-lābha-yogaḥ. Pāpa-trayasya upacaya-sthāna-traye sarva-dig-vardhanaṃ dadāti. Śreṣṭhatama-upacaya-yogaḥ.

MALEFIC_IN_6_11.name: Ṣaṣṭha-ekādaśayoḥ pāpāḥ — śatru-lābha-yogaḥ. Saṅgharṣeṇa-nirantara-lābhaḥ.
MALEFIC_IN_6_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye ṣaṣṭha-ekādaśayoḥ pāpa-saṃyogaḥ — śatru-lābha-yogakārakaḥ. Saṅgharṣeṇa nirantara-dhana-lābhaṃ, cikitsā-nyāya-sevā-karmaṃ, ṛṇa-niyantraṇa-samarthaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-karma-yaśaṃ dadāti.

MANGAL_DOSHA.name: Māṅgalika doṣaḥ — maṅgalaḥ lagna-2-4-7-8-12 sthāneṣu. Dāmpatya-kalaha-yogyaḥ.
MANGAL_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 80 adhyāye māṅgalika doṣaḥ uktaḥ — maṅgalo lagna-dvitīya-caturtha-saptama-aṣṭama-dvādaśa-sthāneṣu tiṣṭhan dāmpatye kalaha-viyoga-saṅgharṣaṃ dadāti. Phaladīpikā 16 — mūla-trikoṇa-samāne tri-sthāna-sambandha-parīkṣaṇam (lagna-candra-śukrāt). Daśa śāstrokta-nivāraṇaṃ vidyante.

MARKESHA_2_7_DUSTHANA.name: Mārakeśa yogaḥ — duḥsthāneṣu dvitīyeśa-saptameśau — māraka-daśā-satarkatā.
MARKESHA_2_7_DUSTHANA.prose: Mārakeśa-yogo dvitīyeśo saptameśo vā ṣaṣṭhāṣṭamadvādaśabhāveṣu tiṣṭhet, tadā māraka-daśā-antardaśā-kāle jātasya maraṇatulyakaṣṭaṃ mṛtyuṃ vā phalayati.

MARS_IN_10.name: Maṅgalo daśame rucaka-samāna-rājayogaḥ. Ati-karmaṭhaḥ, senā-nāyakatvam, rāja-sammānam.
MARS_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalo daśamasthaḥ karma-viśeṣa-rājayogakārakaḥ — kujaḥ karma-sthānātmakena ucca-sthānena vā senā-nāyakatvaṃ, ati-karmaṭhatāṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, sāhasika-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — digbalī kujaḥ karma-yaśaṃ vardhayati.

MARS_IN_11.name: Maṅgala ekādaśe lābha-śaurya-yogaḥ. Sāhasena-nirantara-lābhaḥ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-vṛddhiḥ.
MARS_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgala ekādaśasthaḥ lābha-śaurya-yogakārakaḥ — sāhasena nirantara-lābhaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-vardhanaṃ, udyamaśīlatayā-iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — kuja ekādaśasthaḥ sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

MARS_IN_3.name: Maṅgalastṛtīye parākrama-yogaḥ. Mahā-śūraḥ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaḥ, sva-bala-samṛddhaḥ.
MARS_IN_3.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalastṛtīyasthaḥ parākrama-yogakārakaḥ — kāraka-kāraka-saṃyogaḥ. Mahā-śauryaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaḥ, sva-bala-samṛddhiṃ, udyamaśīlatāṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — maṅgalasya upacaya-sthāneṣu eva śreṣṭha-phalaṃ uktam.

MARS_IN_6.name: Maṅgalaḥ ṣaṣṭhe śatru-jaya-yogaḥ. Roga-nivṛttiḥ, ṛṇa-kṣayaḥ, balavān.
MARS_IN_6.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalaḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ śatru-jaya-viparīta-rājayogakārakaḥ — ṣaṣṭha-sthānātmakena kujena śatravo jitā bhavanti, rogā nivṛttāḥ, ṛṇāni ca kṣīyante. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — upacaya-kujaḥ ari-sthāne ati-balapradaḥ.

MARS_IN_9.name: Maṅgalo navame — pitṛ-śūrya-yogaḥ. Pitṛ-kula-tejaḥ, dhārmika-śauryam.
MARS_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalo navamasthaḥ pitṛ-śūrya-yogakārakaḥ — pitṛ-kula-tejasāṃ śauryaṃ, dhārmika-yātrā-śaurya-karma, senā-kṣātra-kula-kīrtiṃ, dharma-karma-samarthyaṃ dadāti.

MARS_KETU_CONJ.name: Maṅgala-ketu yutiḥ — duryogaḥ. Akasmāt-durghaṭanā, agni-saṅkaṭam.
MARS_KETU_CONJ.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye maṅgala-ketu-yutiḥ duryogaḥ — dvi-krūra-saṃyogena akasmāt-durghaṭanā-yogyatāṃ, agni-saṅkaṭaṃ, gupta-śatru-kaṣṭaṃ, sāhasika-kintu-niruddeśya-karma ca dadāti. Mantra-śānti-śuddhyarthaṃ.

MARS_MER_CONJ.name: Maṅgala-budha yutiḥ — kauśala-tīkṣṇa-saṃyogaḥ. Śilpa-kuśalaḥ, tīkṣṇa-vāṇī.
MARS_MER_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye maṅgala-budha-yutiḥ kauśala-tīkṣṇa-saṃyogaḥ — kṣātra-kārakena vāk-kārakena ca yutyā śilpa-kuśalaṃ, tīkṣṇa-vāṇīyuktaṃ, kūṭa-nīti-samarthaṃ, śastra-śāstra-kuśalaṃ ca karoti. Tīkṣṇa-buddhi-yogyatā.

MARS_RAHU_CONJ.name: Maṅgala-rāhu yutiḥ — aṅgāraka-yogaḥ. Ugra-krodhaḥ, sāhasika-duṣkarma-vṛttiḥ.
MARS_RAHU_CONJ.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye maṅgala-rāhu-yutiḥ aṅgāraka-yogaḥ uktaḥ — dvi-krūra-saṃyogena ugra-krodhaṃ, sāhasika-duṣkarma-vṛttiṃ, akalpita-ākramaṇa-svabhāvaṃ, agni-śastra-saṅkaṭaṃ dadāti. Duṣṭa-yogānāṃ agragaṇyaḥ.

MARS_SAT_RAHU_CONJ.name: Maṅgala-śani-rāhu tri-yutiḥ — mahā-duryogaḥ. Cira-kaṣṭa, bahu-śatru, akasmāt-saṅkaṭa.
MARS_SAT_RAHU_CONJ.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye maṅgala-śani-rāhu tri-yutiḥ mahā-duryogaḥ — tri-krūra-saṃyogena cira-kālika-kaṣṭaṃ, bahu-śatru-kalahaṃ, akasmāt-durghaṭanāṃ, parityakta-dharma-vṛttiṃ dadāti. Śreṣṭha-śānti-karma-āvaśyakam.

MARS_VEN_CONJ.name: Maṅgala-śukra yutiḥ — kāma-kṣātra-saṃyogaḥ. Ati-kāmukaḥ, bahu-strī-sambandhaḥ.
MARS_VEN_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye maṅgala-śukra-yutiḥ kāma-kṣātra-saṃyogaḥ — kṣātra-kārakena bhoga-kārakena ca yutyā ati-kāmuka-svabhāvaṃ, bahu-strī-sambandhaṃ, uttejaka-kalā-niratiṃ, sāhasika-kalā-karma ca dadāti. Dāmpatya-parīkṣaṇam kvacit.

MARUT.name: Marudyogaḥ — vāyutattvarāśiṣu śubhagrahāṇāṃ kendratrikoṇasthitiḥ. Kīrtiḥ vyāpārakauśalañca.
MARUT.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye varṇitam — yadā śubhagrahāḥ vāyutattvarāśiṣu (mithuna-tulā-kumbheṣu) kendra-trikoṇasthāḥ bhavanti, tadā marudyogo jāyate. Anena jātakaḥ prakharavākpaṭuḥ, saphalavyāpārī, dūtakarmakuśalaḥ, sarvatra labdhapratiṣṭhaśca bhavati. Atra marutaḥ (vāyoḥ) pravahaṇaśīlo guṇaḥ jātakasya kīrtiṃ prasārayati.

MATRI_DOSHA.name: Mātṛ doṣaḥ — caturtheśa/candra-daurbalyam. Mātṛ-svāsthya-kaṣṭa-yogyatā.
MATRI_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 adhyāye mātṛ doṣaḥ — caturtheśo vā candro duṣṭa-sthāna-sthitaḥ krūra-saṃyogo vā san mātṛ-svāsthya-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ, mātṛ-viyoga-yogyatāṃ, gṛha-śānti-nyūnatāṃ dadāti. Mātṛ-kāraka-dvaita-yogyaḥ.
MATRI_DOSHA.general: Mātṛ-svāsthya kaṣṭa, mātṛ-viyoga yogyatā, gṛha-śānti nyūnatā.

MATR_SUKHA_BENEFIC_4.name: Mātṛ-sukha yoga — śubha caturthe — mātṛ-gṛha-śikṣā-sukham.
MATR_SUKHA_BENEFIC_4.prose: Mātṛ-sukha-yogaḥ śubha-grahāḥ (budho-guruḥ-śukraḥ-candraḥ) caturthe yadi syāt, tadā mātṛ-kalyāṇaṃ gṛha-sukhaṃ vidyā-sukhaṃ ca pradāti.

MATSYA.name: Matsya yogaḥ — śubhāścalarāśiṣu, pāpāścandrāt. Matsya-samāna-yātrā.
MATSYA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye matsya-yogaḥ — śubhā grahāścala-rāśiṣu pāpāśca candra-sthāne tiṣṭhanti. Matsya-samānāṃ jīvana-dhārāṃ — videśa-yātrā, samudra-karma, cara-vāsaṃ, anukūlana-yogyatāṃ dadāti.

MER_IN_1.name: Budho lagne vākpaṭuḥ, buddhimān, hāsya-priyaḥ, yuvaka-tejaḥ.
MER_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budho lagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ vākpaṭuṃ, buddhimantaṃ, hāsya-priyaṃ, yuvaka-samāna-tejasaṃ, gaṇita-śāstra-kauśalinaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budhaḥ kāraka-tanu-saṃyogāt buddhimattāṃ, sañcāra-kauśalaṃ ca dadāti.

MER_IN_10.name: Budho daśame karma-vāk-yogaḥ. Buddhi-sañcāra-kauśalena-yaśam, ucca-pada-prāptiḥ.
MER_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budho daśamasthaḥ karma-vāk-rājayogakārakaḥ — kāraka-kendra-yogaḥ. Buddhi-sañcāra-kauśalena yaśaṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, ucca-pada-prāptiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — karma-kārakeṇa karma-sthānātmanā saṃyogaḥ.

MER_IN_11.name: Budha ekādaśe lābha-vāk-yogaḥ. Nirantara-vyāpāra-lābhaḥ, mitra-sañcāra-kuśalaḥ.
MER_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budha ekādaśasthaḥ lābha-vāk-yogakārakaḥ — nirantara-vyāpāra-lābhaṃ, mitra-sañcāra-kauśalaṃ, saṭṭā-śeyara-vardhanaṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budho lābhasthāne sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

MER_IN_2.name: Budho dvitīye vāk-dhana-yogaḥ. Madhura-vacanaḥ, sva-kuṭumba-poṣakaḥ, vyāpāra-kuśalaḥ.
MER_IN_2.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budho dvitīyasthaḥ vāk-dhana-yogakārakaḥ — madhura-vacanaṃ, kuṭumba-poṣaṇaṃ, vyāpāra-kauśalena-dhanārjanaṃ, manojña-vyavahāraṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — vāk-kārakaḥ dhanasthāne arthārjana-vāṇīṃ dadāti.

MER_IN_4.name: Budhaścaturthe vidyā-gṛha-yogaḥ. Mātṛ-sukhī, vidvān-gṛhasthaḥ.
MER_IN_4.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budhaścaturthasthaḥ vidyā-gṛha-yogakārakaḥ — mātṛ-sukhī, vidvān-gṛhasthaḥ, gṛha-vāhana-sampannaḥ, sad-vyavahārī ca bhavati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budhaḥ sukha-sthāne vidyā-vardhanaṃ dadāti.

MER_IN_5.name: Budhaḥ pañcame prajñā-yogaḥ. Buddhimān, mantra-siddhaḥ, saṭṭā-śeyara-kuśalaḥ.
MER_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budhaḥ pañcamasthaḥ prajñā-rājayogakārakaḥ — kāraka-trikoṇa-yogaḥ. Buddhimattā, mantra-siddhiḥ, saṭṭā-śeyara-kauśalaṃ, gaṇita-śāstra-kīrtiḥ, santati-sukhaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — vidyā-kārakaḥ pūrva-puṇye phalitaḥ.

MER_IN_7.name: Budhaḥ saptame vyāpāra-kalatrayogaḥ. Buddhimatī-jāyā, sad-vyavasāyī.
MER_IN_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budhaḥ saptamasthaḥ vyāpāra-kalatrayoga-kārakaḥ — buddhimatī-jāyāṃ, sad-vyavasāya-kauśalaṃ, sājhedārī-vyāpāreṇa-vardhanaṃ, yātrā-lābhaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budhaḥ kalatra-sthāne vyāpāra-vāṇīṃ vardhayati.

MER_JUP_CONJ.name: Budha-guru yutiḥ — mahā-prajñā-yogaḥ. Paṇḍitaḥ, guru-tejaḥ, sarva-śāstra-kauśalam.
MER_JUP_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye budha-guru-yutiḥ mahā-prajñā-yogaḥ — dvi-jñāna-kārakayoḥ sama-varṇa-yogena parama-paṇḍitaṃ, guru-tejasaṃ, sarva-śāstra-kauśalaṃ, tarka-śāstra-vā-gaṇita-kīrtiṃ dadāti. Śreṣṭha-śubha-yogānāṃ agragaṇyaḥ.

MER_SAT_CONJ.name: Budha-śani yutiḥ — gahana-buddhi-saṃyogaḥ. Tarka-śāstrī, gahana-śodhakaḥ.
MER_SAT_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye budha-śani-yutiḥ gahana-buddhi-saṃyogaḥ — buddhi-kārakena karma-kārakena ca yutyā tarka-śāstriṇaṃ, gahana-śodhakaṃ, śrama-sahana-kuśalaṃ, saṅgaṭhana-samarthaṃ dadāti. Dīrghakālika-karma-yogyatā.

MER_VEN_CONJ.name: Budha-śukra yutiḥ — kāvya-kalā-saṃyogaḥ. Kāvya-kuśalaḥ, madhura-svara-gāyakaḥ.
MER_VEN_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye budha-śukra-yutiḥ kāvya-kalā-saṃyogaḥ — buddhi-kārakena kalā-kārakena ca yutyā kāvya-kuśalaṃ, madhura-svara-gāyakaṃ, citra-kalā-nirataṃ, strī-priya-vyavahāraṃ dadāti. Madhura-vāg-yogaḥ.

MOOL_DOSHA.name: Mūla doṣaḥ — mūla/jyeṣṭhā/aśleṣā/maghā/revatī-nakṣatra-janmaḥ. Pitṛ-kula-kaṣṭa-yogyatā.
MOOL_DOSHA.prose: Nārada-saṃhitāyāṃ mūla doṣaḥ uktaḥ — janmeṣu mūla/jyeṣṭhā/aśleṣā/maghā/revatī-nakṣatreṣu jātasya pitṛ-kula-kaṣṭa-yogyatā, bālya-svāsthya-nyūnatā, pādānuguṇaṃ viśeṣa-doṣa-tīvratā ca. Mūla-śānti-karma-27-divasīya-vratena nivāraṇīyam.
MOOL_DOSHA.general: Pitṛ-kula kaṣṭa yogyatā, bālya-svāsthya nyūnatā, pādānuguṇa-doṣa-tīvratā.

MOON_5_PUTRA.name: Candra-putra yoga — candraḥ pañcame śubha-sthite — bhāva-saṃyukta-putra-sukham.
MOON_5_PUTRA.prose: Candra-putra-yogaḥ candraḥ pañcame yadi sva-ucca-mūlatrikoṇa-mitra-samasthāneṣu syāt, tadā bhāva-gahanaṃ putra-snehaṃ mātṛ-tulya-santāna-kalyāṇaṃ ca pradāti.

MOON_EXALTED_KENDRA.name: Ucca-candraḥ kendre mahā-rājayogaḥ. Mano-śaktiḥ, jana-priya-kīrtiḥ, ati-mātṛ-sukham.
MOON_EXALTED_KENDRA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ aṣṭatriṃśe adhyāye ucca-candraḥ kendrasthaḥ mahā-rājayogakārakaḥ — vṛṣa-rāśau ucca-sthānāt kendrāt ca dvaita-balaṃ prāpya ati-mano-śaktiṃ, jana-priya-kīrtiṃ, ati-mātṛ-sukhaṃ, hṛdaya-samrāṭ-vyaktitvaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — ucca-candra-kendra-yogaḥ gaja-kesarī-samānaḥ.

MOON_IN_1.name: Candro lagne manasvī, saumya-kāntiḥ, mātṛ-vatsalaḥ, bhoga-samṛddhaḥ.
MOON_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candro lagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ manasvinaṃ, saumya-kāntiṃ, mātṛ-vatsalaṃ, bhoga-samṛddhaṃ, samvedanaśīlaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candra-lagnāt bhāva-kāraka-yogāḥ bahavaḥ utpadyante.

MOON_IN_10.name: Candro daśame karma-kāraka-rājayogaḥ. Jana-priya-karma, manorañjaka-vyavasāyaḥ.
MOON_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candro daśamasthaḥ karma-kāraka-rājayogakārakaḥ — jana-priya-karma, manorañjaka-vyavasāyaṃ, mātṛ-karma-saṃyogaṃ, ati-karmaṭhatāṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candraḥ karma-sthāne jana-samūha-kīrtiṃ vardhayati.

MOON_IN_11.name: Candra ekādaśe lābha-mano-yogaḥ. Nirantara-dhana-lābhaḥ, mitra-mano-kīrtiḥ.
MOON_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candra ekādaśasthaḥ lābha-mano-yogakārakaḥ — nirantara-dhana-lābhaṃ, mitra-kuṭumbena-mano-vardhanaṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candro lābhasthāne sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

MOON_IN_2.name: Candro dvitīye — mano-dhana-yogaḥ. Madhura-vāṇī, bahu-dhana-saṃyogaḥ.
MOON_IN_2.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candro dvitīyasthaḥ mano-dhana-yogakārakaḥ — madhura-vāṇīṃ, bahu-dhana-saṃyogaṃ, mātṛ-vatsala-kuṭumba-vardhanaṃ, samvedanaśīla-vyavahāraṃ dadāti.

MOON_IN_4.name: Candraścaturthe digbalī mātṛ-gṛha-rājayogaḥ. Ati-mātṛ-sukhī, hṛdaya-śāntiḥ.
MOON_IN_4.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candraścaturthasthaḥ digbalī mātṛ-gṛha-rājayogakārakaḥ — mātṛ-sukhaṃ, gṛha-śāntiṃ, hṛdaya-prasannatāṃ, dhārmika-gṛhastha-vṛttiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candrasya caturthaṃ digbala-sthānaṃ sarvottamam.
MOON_IN_4.general: Digbalī mātṛ-gṛha-rājayogaḥ, ati-mātṛ-sukham, hṛdaya-śāntiḥ, gṛha-vaibhavam, dhārmika-gṛhasthaḥ.

MOON_IN_5.name: Candraḥ pañcame mano-prajñā-yogaḥ. Buddhimān, santati-sukhī, mantra-kuśalaḥ.
MOON_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candraḥ pañcamasthaḥ mano-prajñā-rājayogakārakaḥ — mano-kārakaḥ pūrva-puṇya-sthāne tiṣṭhan buddhimattāṃ, santati-sukhaṃ, mantra-kauśalaṃ, samvedanaśīla-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — kāraka-trikoṇa-yogaḥ.

MOON_IN_7.name: Candraḥ saptame samvedanaśīla-kalatrayogaḥ. Saumya-jāyā, yātrā-lābhaḥ, sahayogi-svabhāvaḥ.
MOON_IN_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candraḥ saptamasthaḥ samvedanaśīla-kalatrayoga-kārakaḥ — saumya-jāyāṃ, yātrā-lābhaṃ, sahayogi-vyāpāraṃ, mano-vaidyatā-guṇaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candraḥ kalatra-sthāne manorañjaka-vyavahāraṃ dadāti.

MOON_IN_9.name: Candro navame — mātṛ-bhāgya-yogaḥ. Mātṛ-kāraṇena-bhāgyodayaḥ, samvedanaśīla-dharma.
MOON_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candro navamasthaḥ mātṛ-bhāgya-yogakārakaḥ — mātṛ-kāraṇena bhāgyodayaṃ, dhārmika-yātrāṃ, samvedanaśīla-dharma-vṛttiṃ, guru-kṛpā-saṃyogaṃ dadāti.

MOON_JUP_CONJ.name: Candra-guru yutiḥ — gaja-kesarī samānam. Prajñā-yaśa-dharma-saṃyogaḥ.
MOON_JUP_CONJ.prose: Bṛhatjātake trayodaśe adhyāye candra-guru-yutiḥ gaja-kesarī-samānāṃ prajñā-yaśa-dharma-saṃyogaṃ dadāti — manaḥ-kārakena jñāna-kārakena ca yutyā parama-dhārmikaṃ, prajñāvantaṃ, yaśasvinaṃ, guru-kṛpā-pātraṃ karoti. Sarva-śubha-yogānāṃ agragaṇyaḥ.
MOON_JUP_CONJ.general: Gaja-kesarī-samānam, prajñā, yaśa, dharma, guru-kṛpā, sarva-śubha.

MOON_MARS_CONJ.name: Candra-maṅgala yutiḥ — candra-maṅgala-rājayogaḥ. Sva-karmārjita-dhanam, kṣātra-tejaḥ.
MOON_MARS_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye candra-maṅgala-yutiḥ candra-maṅgala-rājayogakārakaḥ — manaḥ-kārakena kṣātra-kārakena ca yutyā sva-karmārjita-dhanaṃ, kṣātra-tejasaṃ svabhāvaṃ, bahu-dhana-vardhanaṃ, sāhasika-vyavasāyaṃ dadāti. Phaladīpikā — śreṣṭha-dhana-yogaḥ.

MOON_MER_CONJ.name: Candra-budha yutiḥ — mano-buddhi-saṃyogaḥ. Madhura-vāṇī, bhāṣā-kauśalam.
MOON_MER_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye candra-budha-yutiḥ mano-buddhi-saṃyogaḥ — madhura-vāṇīṃ, bahu-bhāṣā-kauśalaṃ, sāhitya-kīrtiṃ, citrakalā-samarthyaṃ, priya-vyavahāraṃ ca dadāti. Jñāna-kārakayoḥ sama-varṇa-saṃyogaḥ ati-śubhaḥ.

MOON_VEN_CONJ.name: Candra-śukra yutiḥ — saundarya-bhoga-saṃyogaḥ. Kalākāraḥ, strī-priyaḥ.
MOON_VEN_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye candra-śukra-yutiḥ saundarya-bhoga-saṃyogaḥ — manaḥ-kārakena kalā-kārakena ca yutyā jātakaṃ kalākāraṃ, sundara-vyaktitvaṃ, strī-priyaṃ, saṅgīta-nirataṃ, bhoga-samṛddhaṃ ca karoti. Madhura-svabhāvasya agragaṇyaḥ.

MRIDANGA.name: Mṛdaṅga yogaḥ — karmeśo śubha-graha-dṛṣṭaḥ mūla-trikoṇe. Rāja-vādya-yaśam.
MRIDANGA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye mṛdaṅga-yogaḥ — daśameśo sva-mūla-trikoṇa-sthāne śubha-graha-dṛṣṭaḥ san mṛdaṅga-vādya-samānāṃ rāja-vādya-yaśaṃ, sammāna-vardhana-karma, saṅgīta-kalā-kīrtiṃ dadāti.

MRITYUBHAGA_8_LORD_DEBIL_IN_8.name: Mṛtyu-bhāga yogaḥ — aṣṭame nīcāṣṭameśaḥ — viṣakāla-mṛtyusaṅketaḥ.
MRITYUBHAGA_8_LORD_DEBIL_IN_8.prose: Mṛtyu-bhāga-yogo aṣṭameśo nīca-rāśau aṣṭama-bhāve tiṣṭhet, tadā svagṛha-rakṣaṇaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhavati, viṣa-kāla-daśā-kāle tīvrakaṣṭaṃ mṛtyuṃ vā phalayati.

MRITYU_BHAGA_DOSHA.name: Mṛtyu bhāga doṣaḥ — sva-rāśau grahasya mṛtyu-bhāga-aṃśe sthitiḥ. Ariṣṭa-yogyatā.
MRITYU_BHAGA_DOSHA.prose: Jātaka-pārijāte mṛtyu bhāga doṣaḥ — pratyeka-grahasya pratyeka-rāśyāṃ niścita-mṛtyu-bhāga-aṃśaḥ; tasmin aṃśe (±1°) sthitaḥ grahaḥ sva-phalaṃ maraṇa-tulya-kaṣṭaṃ prati pariṇamayati. Lagna-candra-sūryāṇāṃ mṛtyu-bhāga-sthitiḥ ariṣṭa-mūla-yogyatā. Mahāmṛtyuñjaya-japena graha-śāntyā ca śamanam.

MUSALA.name: Musala yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ sthira-rāśiṣu. Dṛḍha-svabhāvaḥ, sthira-karmaḥ.
MUSALA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye musala yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ sthira-rāśiṣu (vṛṣa-siṃha-vṛścika-kumbha) tiṣṭhanto jātakaṃ dṛḍha-svabhāvaṃ, sthira-karmaṇyaṃ, pariśramī, sampatti-rakṣakaṃ, musala-samāna-dṛḍha-vyaktitvaṃ ca kurvanti.

NADI_DOSHA.name: Nāḍī doṣaḥ — dampatyornāḍī-samānatā. Santati-svāsthya-kaṣṭa-yogyatā.
NADI_DOSHA.prose: Muhūrta-cintāmaṇau ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye nāḍī kūṭa uktaḥ — vara-vadhū-nakṣatrayoḥ nāḍī (ādi-madhya-antya) samānā cet nāḍī doṣaḥ. Śūnyāṅkaḥ 8/8 kūṭasya nirṇāyakaḥ — santati-svāsthya-kaṣṭa, garbhādhāna-vighna, dāmpatya-tṛpti-nyūnatā darśayati. Nivāraṇaṃ — svāmī-guru-anumata-śānti-karma.

NAGA_DOSHA.name: Nāga doṣaḥ — rāhuḥ 5-sthāne eva dūṣitaḥ. Santati-kaṣṭa-karma.
NAGA_DOSHA.prose: Mānasāgaryāṃ pañcame adhyāye nāga doṣaḥ — rāhuḥ pañcama-sthāne pāpa-graha-dṛṣṭo durbala-sthito vā santati-kaṣṭa-karmaṇaṃ, garbhapāta-yogyatāṃ, santāna-svāsthya-kaṣṭaṃ dadāti. Nāga-pūjā-nāga-pañcamī-vratena nivāraṇīyam.
NAGA_DOSHA.general: Santati-kaṣṭa karma, garbhapāta yogyatā, santāna-svāsthya-kaṣṭa, nāga-śāpa-vyākhyā.

NALA.name: Nala yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ dvisvabhāva-rāśiṣu. Anukūlanīyaḥ, madhyamārgī.
NALA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye nala yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ dvisvabhāva-rāśiṣu (mithuna-kanyā-dhanuḥ-mīna) tiṣṭhanto jātakaṃ anukūlanīyaṃ, madhyamārgiṇaṃ, dvi-karma-nirataṃ, ubhaya-diś-samarthaṃ ca kurvanti. Nala-samānāṃ lacīlatā.

NAUKHA.name: Nau yogaḥ — grahāḥ lagnādi-sapta-bhāveṣu krameṇa. Naukā-samānaṃ yātrā-vyāpāra.
NAUKHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye nau yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ lagnādi-sapta-bhāveṣu krameṇa upasthitāḥ. Naukā-samānāṃ yātrā-vyāpāraṃ, samudra-karma-vṛttiṃ, videśa-vāsa-vā-yātrā-karma ca dadāti.

NEECHA_BHANGA_BENEFIC_ASPECT.name: Nīcabhaṅgaḥ — nīcagrahasya śubhagraheṇa saha dṛṣṭidṛṣṭisambandhaḥ — dṛṣṭijaparihāraḥ.
NEECHA_BHANGA_BENEFIC_ASPECT.prose: Nīcarāśigataḥ graho yadi naisargikaśubhagraheṇa (budha-guru-śukra-pūrṇacandraiḥ) pūrṇadṛṣṭyā yuto dṛśyate, tadā nīcadoṣaḥ nirasto jāyate. Devaguroḥ pañcamanavamadṛṣṭyā athavā anyaśubhagrahāṇāṃ saptamadṛṣṭyā nīcadoṣasya pariśodhanaṃ bhavati. (Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstra 38.12, Niyama 4)

NEECHA_BHANGA_D9_EXALT.name: Nīcabhaṅgaḥ — nīcagrahasya navamāṃśakuṇḍalyāṃ uccatvam — āntarikabalavikāsaḥ.
NEECHA_BHANGA_D9_EXALT.prose: Yadi kaścana grahaḥ janmalagne nīcarāśigataḥ so'pi navamāṃśe (D9) svakīyoccarāśau tiṣṭhati, tadā vargavibhājanabalena nīcadoṣaḥ pūrṇataḥ vinaśyati. Navamāṃśo jātakasya dharmabalaṃ sūkṣmabalaṃ ca pradarśayati, ataḥ ayamābhyantarabalena bāhyadaurbalyasya śāstrīyaparihāro vartate. (Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstra 38.12, Niyama 3)

NEECHA_BHANGA_DEBIL_LORD_KENDRA.name: Nīcabhaṅgaḥ — nīcarāśīśasya lagnacandrāpekṣayā kendravartitvam — doṣanivāraṇam.
NEECHA_BHANGA_DEBIL_LORD_KENDRA.prose: Nīcagatagrahasya nīcarāśeḥ adhipatiḥ (nīcarāśīśaḥ) yadi lagnaṃ candrādvā kendrabhāveṣu (1, 4, 7, 10) tiṣṭhati, tadā nīcatvadoṣasya samyak parihāro jāyate. Anena nīcaprabhāvasya mūlakāraṇaṃ niyantritaṃ bhūtvā jātakaṃ śubhaphalābhimūkhaṃ karoti. (Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstra 38.12, Niyama 1)

NEECHA_BHANGA_EXALT_LORD_KENDRA.name: Nīcabhaṅgaḥ — nīcagrahasya uccarāśīśasya kendravartitvam — abhyudayabalam.
NEECHA_BHANGA_EXALT_LORD_KENDRA.prose: Nīcasthagrahasya yā uccarāśiḥ tasyāḥ rāśināthaḥ (uccarāśīśaḥ) yadi lagnaṃ candrādvā kendrabhāveṣu tiṣṭhati, tadā nīcatvadoṣasya bhaṅgaḥ sambhavati. Ayaṃ yogaḥ jātakasya abhyudayamārgaṃ prakāśayati. (Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstra 38.12, Niyama 6)

NEECHA_BHANGA_EXALT_PLANET_KENDRA.name: Nīcabhaṅgaḥ — nīcarāśau uccatāṃ prāptuḥ grahasya kendravartitvam — viparītabalasambandhaḥ.
NEECHA_BHANGA_EXALT_PLANET_KENDRA.prose: Nīcasthitagrahasya nīcarāśau yaḥ grahaḥ uccatāṃ gacchati, saḥ cet lagnaṃ candrādvā kendrasthāneṣu sthito bhavet, tadā nīcadoṣasya bhaṅgaḥ sañjāyate. Ayaṃ yogaḥ viparītabalasaṃyogena nīcagrahasya sāmarthyaṃ vardhayati. (Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstra 38.12, Niyama 2)

NEECHA_BHANGA_OWN_NAVAMSA.name: Nīcabhaṅgaḥ — nīcagrahasya svanavamāṃśakagatatvam — svagṛharakṣābalam.
NEECHA_BHANGA_OWN_NAVAMSA.prose: Nīcarāśigataḥ graho yadi navamāṃśakuṇḍalyāṃ svarāśigato (ātmīyagṛhe) bhavati, tadā tasya nīcatvasya pūrṇaḥ parihāraḥ sampadyate. Ayaṃ yogaḥ sūkṣmavargabalena jātakasya rakṣāmārgaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ karoti. (Phaladīpikā adhyāya 6, mantreśvaramatam)

NEECHA_BHANGA_RAJA.name: Nīcabhaṅgarājayogaḥ — nīcadoṣanivāraṇapūrvakaḥ vilakṣaṇasāmrājyapradayogaḥ.
NEECHA_BHANGA_RAJA.prose: Yadā kasyāpi nīcagatagrahasya śāstrīyanīcabhaṅgayogasya saptaniyamaprakāreṣu anyatamo niyamaḥ pūrṇo bhavati, tadā nīcadoṣo vinaśyati. Ayameva nīcabhaṅgarājayogaḥ kathyate, yena jātakaḥ krameṇa sāmrājyatulyavaibhavaṃ prakhyātakīrtiṃ ca labhate. (Phaladīpikā adhyāya 6)

NEECHA_BHANGA_RETROGRADE.name: Nīcabhaṅgaḥ — nīcarāśigatagrahasya vakragatitvam — ceṣṭābalaparihāraḥ.
NEECHA_BHANGA_RETROGRADE.prose: Nīcarāśigataḥ ko'pi graho yadi vakragatiṃ bhajate, tadā tasya vakribalarūpa-ceṣṭābalena nīcatvadoṣasya pūrṇaḥ parihāro bhavati. Ayaṃ yogaḥ ceṣṭābalaṃ dattvā grahaṃ samarthaṃ karoti. (Phaladīpikā adhyāya 6)

NETRA_ARISHTA.name: Netrāriṣṭayogaḥ — sūryād dvitīyadvādaśayoḥ pāpagrahāḥ — netrapīḍā dṛṣṭidaurbalyaṃ ca.
NETRA_ARISHTA.prose: Sārāvalyām 41 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā sūryam (netrakārakam) paritaḥ dvitīyadvādaśabhāveṣu pāpagrahāḥ tiṣṭhanti, tadā netrāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Sūryaḥ dakṣiṇanetrasya candraśca vāmanetrasya kārakaḥ; pāpena veṣṭanāt netravyādhiḥ, dṛṣṭidaurbalyaṃ vā netraśalyakriyā phalayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — sūryaśāntiḥ, sunetrastotrapāṭhaḥ, sūryanamaskāraḥ ca śubhāḥ.

NIPUNA.name: Nipuṇa yoga — sūrya-budhau kendre — prakhara-buddhi-vākpaṭutvam.
NIPUNA.prose: Nipuṇa-yogaḥ sūryaśca budhaśca kendra-bhāve ekatra-sthitau yadi syātām, tadā budhāditya-yogasya prabala-tiryak bhavati. Budha-nīca-rāśau (mīne) yadi syāt, tadā raddaḥ.

PADMA.name: Padma yogaḥ — grahāḥ kendreṣu puṣpa-samānaṃ vikasitāḥ. Kamala-samānaṃ sarva-śubham.
PADMA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye padma yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ kendreṣu puṣpa-samānaṃ vikasanti. Padma (kamala)-samānāṃ sarva-śubhaṃ, dharmātmakaṃ, gṛha-śānti-kendrita-rāja-yaśaṃ, parama-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti.

PAPA_KARTARI_10.name: Pāpa-kartarī (10) — daśama-bhāvaḥ pāpaiḥ kṛntataḥ. Karma-kaṣṭa-yogaḥ.
PAPA_KARTARI_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye pāpa-kartarī (10)-yogaḥ — daśama-bhāvasya ubhaya-pārśve (9-11 bhāveṣu) pāpa-grahāḥ. Pāpaiḥ-kartarī-kṛntitaṃ karma-sthānaṃ adhikāra-saṅgharṣaṃ, karma-kaṣṭaṃ, mitra-śatru-vardhanaṃ, ucca-pada-vivādaṃ dadāti.

PAPA_KARTARI_7.name: Pāpa-kartarī (7) — saptama-bhāvaḥ pāpaiḥ kṛntataḥ. Dāmpatya-kaṣṭa-yogaḥ.
PAPA_KARTARI_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye pāpa-kartarī (7)-yogaḥ — saptama-bhāvasya ubhaya-pārśve (6-8 bhāveṣu) pāpa-grahāḥ tiṣṭhanti. Pāpaiḥ-kartarī-kṛntitaṃ saptama-bhāvaṃ dāmpatya-kaṣṭaṃ, sāthinyā-kalahaṃ, vyāpāra-saṅgharṣaṃ dadāti.

PAPA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.name: Pāpa-kartarī (candraḥ) — candrasya ubhayataḥ pāpagrahāṇāṃ sthitiḥ — manaḥpīḍā.
PAPA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.prose: Candrāt dvitīya-dvādaśa-bhāvayoḥ krūragrahāḥ yadi sthitāḥ syuḥ, tadā candra-pāpakartarī-yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ cintākulaḥ, mānasikakleṣayuktaḥ, bandhanayuktaḥ, saṃśayī ca bhavati.

PAPA_KARTARI_LAGNA.name: Pāpa-kartarī lagna yoga — lagnaṃ pāpābhyāṃ veṣṭitam — ātma-veṣṭanam.
PAPA_KARTARI_LAGNA.prose: Pāpa-kartarī-lagna-yogo lagnāt dvitīya-dvādaśayoḥ pāpa-grahāḥ yadi sthitā bhaveyuḥ, tadā ātma-śarīra-veṣṭana-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

PAPA_KARTARI_SUN.name: Pāpa-kartarī yoga (sūrya) — sūryaḥ pāpa-kartaryāṃ — ātma-kāraka-veṣṭanam.
PAPA_KARTARI_SUN.prose: Pāpa-kartarī-yogo sūryo pāpa-grahābhyāṃ dvitīya-dvādaśayoḥ veṣṭito yadi syāt, tadā ātma-kāraka-veṣṭana-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

PARAKRAMA_MARS_3.name: Parākrama yoga — maṅgala tṛtīye — parama-sāhasam.
PARAKRAMA_MARS_3.prose: Parākrama-yogaḥ maṅgalo tṛtīya-sthāne yadi syāt, tadā sarvocca-sāhasaṃ pradāti. Maṅgala naisargika-tṛtīya-kārakaḥ, tṛtīya-sthānaṃ svasya-sthānam.

PARIJATA.name: Pārijātayogaḥ — lagneśatadadhipati-tadadhipatīnāṃ śubhakendrasaṃyogaḥ. Kalpavṛkṣasamānā sampattiḥ.
PARIJATA.prose: Jātakapārijāte pañcame adhyāye pārijātayogaḥ — lagneśaḥ yatra tiṣṭhati, tasya rāśisvāmī (diśapatiḥ) śubhasthāne tiṣṭhet, tasyāpi rāśisvāmī (dvi-diśapatiḥ) kendre vā sva-ucce syāt, tadā pārijātayogaḥ. Ayaṃ devalokasya pārijāta (kalpavṛkṣa) iva sarvakāmanāpūrtikarīṃ sampattiṃ dadāti. Ayamasādhāraṇo mahārājayogaḥ.

PARVATA.name: Parvata yogaḥ — guru-śukrau kendre pāpa-kendra-varjite ca — sthira-kīrtiḥ.
PARVATA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye varṇitam — guru-śukrau parasparaṃ kendre tiṣṭhataḥ, kendre ca ko'pi pāpagrahaḥ (śani-maṅgala-sūryāḥ) na syāt, tadā parvata-yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ parvata-tulya-sthira-sampattiṃ, parama-vidvattāṃ, suguṇayuktāṃ bhāryā/patiṃ ca prāpnoti.

PARVATA_CHANDRA.name: Parvata-candra yogaḥ — candrasya kendre śubhagrahāṇāṃ sthairyam — niścalakīrtiḥ.
PARVATA_CHANDRA.prose: Kendra-bhāveṣu śubha-grahāḥ virājamānaḥ syuḥ, candro'pi kendra-bhāve yadi virājate, tadā parvata-candra-yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ parvatavat niścalakīrtimān, dātā, vidyāvān, dhīraśca bhavati.

PASHA.name: Pāśa yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ pañca-rāśiṣu. Baddha-svabhāvaḥ, kuṭumbāsaktiḥ.
PASHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye pāśa yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ pañca-rāśiṣu tiṣṭhanto jātakaṃ baddha-svabhāvaṃ, kuṭumbāsaktaṃ, karma-bandhinaṃ, ati-vyasta-manasaṃ ca kurvanti. Pāśa-samānāṃ sambandha-vyāpāraḥ.

PATNI_DOSHA.name: Patnī doṣaḥ — saptameśa/śukra-daurbalyam. Dāmpatya-kaṣṭa-yogyatā.
PATNI_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 adhyāye patnī doṣaḥ — saptameśo vā śukraḥ (kalatra-kārakaḥ) duṣṭa-sthāna-sthitaḥ krūra-saṃyogo vā san dāmpatya-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ, sāthinī-svāsthya-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ, vivāha-vighna-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Māṅgalika-doṣa-samānaṃ kintu lagna-svāmino-nirapekṣaṃ.
PATNI_DOSHA.general: Dāmpatya kaṣṭa, sāthinī-svāsthya kaṣṭa, vivāha-vighna yogyatā.

PITRA_BHAGYA_SUN_9.name: Pitṛ-bhāgya yoga — sūrya navame — paitṛka bhāgyānugraham.
PITRA_BHAGYA_SUN_9.prose: Pitṛ-bhāgya-yogaḥ sūryo navama-sthāne svocca-sva-mūla-rāśiṣu yadi syāt, tadā paitṛka bhāgyodayo bhavati.

PITRA_DOSHA.name: Pitṛ doṣaḥ — sūryaḥ rāhu-ketu-śanibhirdūṣitaḥ. Pitṛ-śāpa-karma-yogyatā.
PITRA_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 81 adhyāye pitṛ doṣaḥ — sūryo rāhu-ketu-śanibhiryuto dṛṣṭo vā pitṛ-śāpa-karma, pitṛ-kula-kaṣṭa, pūrva-janma-pitṛ-ṛṇaṃ dadāti. Śrāddha-tarpaṇa-karma vā gayā-yātrena nivāraṇīyam.

PRAVRAJYA_JUPITER_VYRTAKA.name: Guru-nāyaka caturgraha-saṅkhyā — vyartaka-pravrajyā — vaidika-brahmavādī sannyāsaḥ.
PRAVRAJYA_JUPITER_VYRTAKA.prose: Vyartaka-pravrajyā-yogaḥ guru-nāyaka caturgraha-saṅkhyā-yogaḥ. Brahmavādī-vaidika-sampradāyī sannyāsī bhavati. Śāstra-adhyayana-tapaḥ-nirato.

PRAVRAJYA_MARS_SHAKYA.name: Maṅgala-nāyaka caturgraha-saṅkhyā — śākya-pravrajyā — rakta-vastra bauddha śākya sampradāya.
PRAVRAJYA_MARS_SHAKYA.prose: Śākya-pravrajyā-yogaḥ maṅgala-nāyaka caturgraha-saṅkhyā-yogaḥ. Buddhasya kulasya śākya-nāmnā sañjñāyate. Rakta-vastradhārī saṅgho. Mārśala-śistīyo mārgaḥ.

PRAVRAJYA_MERCURY_BHIKSHU.name: Budha-nāyaka caturgraha-saṅkhyā — bhikṣu-pravrajyā — dārśanika-vāda-vivāda sampradāya.
PRAVRAJYA_MERCURY_BHIKSHU.prose: Bhikṣu-pravrajyā-yogaḥ budha-nāyaka caturgraha-saṅkhyā-yogaḥ. Tarka-dārśanika-vāda-nirato bhikṣurbhavati. Śāstra-sabhā-gāmī, bahu-darśana-kuśalo.

PRAVRAJYA_MOON_VRIDHHA.name: Candra-nāyaka caturgraha-saṅkhyā — śrāvaka-pravrajyā — bauddha menḍikenṭa paramparā.
PRAVRAJYA_MOON_VRIDHHA.prose: Vṛddha-śrāvaka-pravrajyā-yogaḥ bṛhatpārāśara-horā-śāstrasya 79-adhyāye kathitaḥ. Candraḥ sarvādhika-śaktimān graha-samūhe yadi syāt, tadā jātakaḥ bauddha-sampradāya-śrāvaka-varge pravṛtto bhavati.

PRAVRAJYA_SATURN_NIRGRANTHA.name: Śani-nāyaka caturgraha-saṅkhyā — nirgrantha-pravrajyā — jaina digambara paramparā.

PRAVRAJYA_SUN_TAPASVI.name: Sūrya-nāyaka caturgraha-saṅkhyā — tapasvī pravrajyā yoga — agnihotra-vana-vāsī.
PRAVRAJYA_SUN_TAPASVI.prose: Tapasvī-pravrajyā-yogaḥ bṛhatpārāśara-horā-śāstrasya 79-adhyāye kathitaḥ. Catvāraḥ adhiko grahāḥ ekasmin rāśau sthitāḥ san yadi syuḥ, sūryaḥ sarvādhika-śaktimān ca, tadā jātakaḥ vana-vāsa-tapasvī bhavati. Agnihotra-homa-yajñeṣu nirataḥ, saura-sampradāyīyaḥ.

PRAVRAJYA_TRIDANDI.name: Tridaṇḍī sannyāsa yoga — candra-kendra śani-daśama — vaiṣṇava-tridaṇḍī sampradāyaḥ.
PRAVRAJYA_TRIDANDI.prose: Tridaṇḍī-sannyāsa-yogaḥ phaladīpikā-śāstrasya 6-43-adhyāye kathitaḥ. Candraḥ kendre (1,4,7,10) śaniḥ ca daśame yadi syāt, tadā vaiṣṇava-tridaṇḍī-sannyāsī bhavati. Tridaṇḍaḥ kāyika-vācika-mānasika-saṃyamasya triprakāratvaṃ pratītayati.

PRAVRAJYA_VENUS_CHARAKA.name: Śukra-nāyaka caturgraha-saṅkhyā — caraka-pravrajyā — vaidya-yātru sampradāya.
PRAVRAJYA_VENUS_CHARAKA.prose: Caraka-pravrajyā-yogaḥ śukra-nāyaka caturgraha-saṅkhyā-yogaḥ. Yātrālu āyurveda-vaidyaḥ carakaśca bhavati. Auṣadha-saṅgraho, roga-nidāno, auṣadhīya-sampradāyī.

PURNAYU_8_LORD_IN_8.name: Pūrṇāyu yogaḥ — aṣṭameśo svagṛhe — niroga-dīrghāyuḥ.
PURNAYU_8_LORD_IN_8.prose: Pūrṇāyu-yogo aṣṭameśaḥ aṣṭama-bhāve svagṛhe sthito bhavet, tadā svagṛha-rakṣaṇa-prabhāvena jātakaḥ nirogaśarīraḥ san dīrghāyuḥ prāpnoti.

PURNAYU_BENEFICS_KENDRA_TRIKONA.name: Pūrṇāyu yogaḥ — kendra-trikoṇe śubhagrahāḥ — parama-dīrghāyutvam.
PURNAYU_BENEFICS_KENDRA_TRIKONA.prose: Pūrṇāyu-yogaḥ sarva-śubha-grahāḥ (budha-guru-śukra-candrāḥ) kendra-trikoṇa-bhāveṣu yadi sthitā bhaveyuḥ, tadā parama-dīrghāyurbhavati.

PURNAYU_LAGNA_JUPITER_KENDRA.name: Pūrṇāyu yogaḥ — lagne kendre vā devagurau — dīrghāyuṣṭvam.
PURNAYU_LAGNA_JUPITER_KENDRA.prose: Pūrṇāyu-yogo gururlagna-kendra-bhāveṣu (1, 4, 7, 10) bala-sahito bhūtvā tiṣṭhet, tadā dvisaptatyuttaraśatavarṣaparyantaṃ dīrghāyurbhavati.

PURNA_MANGAL.name: Pūrṇa māṅgalika — maṅgalaḥ sarva-doṣa-sthāneṣu balavān. Gurutara-dāmpatya-kaṣṭa.
PURNA_MANGAL.prose: Mānasāgaryāṃ pañcame adhyāye pūrṇa māṅgalika — maṅgalaḥ lagna-2-4-7-8-12 sthāneṣu balavantaṃ svarāśi-ucca-śubha-dṛṣṭi-rahitaḥ san pūrṇa-doṣa-yogyaḥ. Dāmpatya-viyogaṃ, guru-kalahaṃ, sāthinī-svāsthya-gahana-kaṣṭaṃ dadāti. Pūrṇa-śānti-karma-kujaśānti-kumbha-vivāhādi-nivāraṇīyam.

PUSHKALA.name: Puṣkala yoga — candra-lagneśau kendre — samagra-samṛddhi-yogaḥ.
PUSHKALA.prose: Puṣkala-yogo candraśca lagneśaśca kendra-bhāveṣu yadi sthitau syātām, tadā samagra-samṛddhi-sthairya-svāsthya-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

PUSHPA_MALA.name: Puṣpa-mālāyogaḥ — śubhagrahāḥ kramaśaḥ bhāvamālāsu grathitāḥ. Mālāsamānamujjvalayaśaḥ.
PUSHPA_MALA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye varṇitam — yadā sarve śubhagrahāḥ kramaśaḥ lagnāt dvitīye tṛtīye caturthe vā ekasmin krame puṣpamālā iva santiṣṭhanti, tadā puṣpa-mālāyogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya jīvanaṃ sugandhitaṃ, sarvabhāvasukhayuktaṃ, avyavacchinnakīrtimayaṃ ca bhavati. Jātakaḥ atisaumyavyaktitvasampannaḥ bhavati.

PUSHYA.name: Puṣya yogaḥ — guruḥ mūla-trikoṇe candra-dṛṣṭaḥ. Puṣṭa-kuṭumbaḥ.
PUSHYA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye puṣya-yogaḥ — guruḥ sva-mūla-trikoṇe candreṇa dṛṣṭaḥ san puṣṭa-kuṭumbaṃ, dhana-saṅgrahaṃ, dharmātmaka-gṛhasthaṃ, sarva-māṅgalya-saṃyogaṃ dadāti. Puṣya-nakṣatra-samānāṃ śubha-tejaḥ.

PUTRA_BHANGA_JUPITER_NODE_5.name: Putra-bhaṅga yoga — guruḥ rāhu/ketunā yutaḥ pañcame — putra-kāraka-dūṣitaḥ.
PUTRA_BHANGA_JUPITER_NODE_5.prose: Putra-bhaṅga-yogaḥ guruḥ rāhu/ketunā yuktaḥ pañcame yadi syāt, tadā putra-kārakasya grahaṇa-dūṣaṇaṃ — santāna-kāraka-bādhādikaṃ phalayati.

PUTRA_DOSHA.name: Putra doṣaḥ — pañcameśa-daurbalyaṃ vā pañcama-bhāva-pīḍā. Santati-kaṣṭa-yogyatā.
PUTRA_DOSHA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 adhyāye putra doṣaḥ — pañcameśo duṣṭa-sthāna-sthitaḥ vā pañcama-bhāvo pāpa-grahai-dūṣitaḥ san santati-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ, garbhapāta-yogyatāṃ, santati-svāsthya-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Pañcama-bhāvasya putra-kāraka-sthāna-kāraṇena.
PUTRA_DOSHA.general: Santati-kaṣṭa yogyatā, garbhapāta yogyatā, santati-svāsthya kaṣṭa.

PUTRA_SUKHA_BENEFIC_5.name: Putra-sukha yoga — śubho pañcame — santāna-kalyāṇam.
PUTRA_SUKHA_BENEFIC_5.prose: Putra-sukha-yogaḥ śubha-grahāḥ (budho-guruḥ-śukraḥ-candraḥ) pañcame yadi syāt, tadā santāna-kalyāṇaṃ buddhi-tīvratāṃ ca pradāti.

RAHU_IN_10.name: Rāhurdaśame akalpita-karma-rājayogaḥ. Videśa-vyāpāreṇa-yaśam, adhikāraḥ, ucca-pada-prāptiḥ.
RAHU_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 28 adhyāye rāhurdaśamasthaḥ akalpita-karma-rājayogakārakaḥ — videśa-vyāpāreṇa yaśaṃ, akalpita-adhikāraṃ, sahasā ucca-pada-prāptiṃ, anūṭha-karma-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — rāhoḥ karma-sthānaṃ ati-śubham.

RAHU_IN_11.name: Rāhurekādaśe akalpita-lābha-yogaḥ. Videśa-srotena-dhanam, akalpita-iṣṭa-siddhiḥ.
RAHU_IN_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 28 adhyāye rāhurekādaśasthaḥ akalpita-lābha-yogakārakaḥ — videśa-srotena-dhana-lābhaṃ, akalpita-iṣṭa-siddhiṃ, mitra-kuṭumba-vardhanaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — rāhoḥ lābhasthānaṃ ati-śubham.

RAHU_IN_3.name: Rāhustṛtīye ati-parākrama-yogaḥ. Sāhasena-yaśam, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaḥ, videśa-gamanam.
RAHU_IN_3.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 28 adhyāye rāhustṛtīyasthaḥ ati-parākrama-yogakārakaḥ — asādhāraṇa-sāhasaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaṃ, videśa-gamanaṃ, akalpita-yaśaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — rāhusyopacaya-sthāne (3/6/10/11) sarvottama-phalam.

RAHU_IN_6.name: Rāhuḥ ṣaṣṭhe śatru-nāśa-yogaḥ. Rājakīya-śatrujayaḥ, ṛṇa-nāśaḥ, śaktimān.
RAHU_IN_6.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 28 adhyāye rāhuḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ śatru-nāśa-viparīta-rājayogakārakaḥ — rāhurduṣṭa-sthāne tiṣṭhan rāja-śatrujayaṃ, ṛṇa-nāśaṃ, akalpita-śaktiṃ, adhikāra-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — rāhoḥ ṣaṣṭha-sthānaṃ sarvottama-śubhadam.

RAJA_10_5.name: Rājayogaḥ (10-5) — daśameśa-pañcameśayoḥ parasparaṃ rāśi-parivartana-janyaḥ.
RAJA_10_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre varṇitam — daśameśo pañcame, pañcameśaśca daśame yadā santiṣṭhate, tadā karma-pūrvapuṇya-saṃyogāt śāsana-sattā-adhikāra-kīrtayaḥ samajāyante. Ayamuccatama-rājayogaḥ. Jātakaḥ mantrī vā prakhyātaśāsakaḥ bhavati.

RAJA_10_9.name: Dharma-karmādhipati-rājayogaḥ (10-9) — navameśa-daśameśayoḥ parasparaṃ rāśi-parivartana-janyaḥ.
RAJA_10_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye varṇitam — navameśo daśame, daśameśaśca navame santiṣṭhati cet, sa eva parama-dharma-karmādhipati-rājayogaḥ samajāyate. Ayamuccatama-cakravartyupama-yogaḥ. Anena jātakaḥ parama-dhārmikaḥ, mahā-kīrtimān, prajāpālakaḥ, rāṣṭrapramukhaḥ vā bhavati.

RAJA_10_IN_9.name: Rājayogaḥ — daśameśo navame — karmaṇaḥ dharme samarpaṇam.
RAJA_10_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye varṇitam — daśameśo navama-bhāve santiṣṭhate cet, sa karmaṇo dharmārthaṃ samarpaṇena parama-kīrtiṃ phalayati. Jātakaḥ paropakārī, pitṛbhaktaḥ, dharmakāryāṇāṃ sañcālakaḥ bhavati.

RAJA_1_5.name: Rājayogaḥ (1-5) — lagneśa-pañcameśayoḥ parasparaṃ sthāna-parivartana-janyaḥ.
RAJA_1_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye (rājayoga-adhyāye) varṇitam — yadā tanubhāvasvāmī lagneśaḥ pañcamabhāvaṃ (trikoṇaṃ) alaṅkaroti, pañcameśaśca tanubhāvaṃ (kendraṃ) prati gacchati, tadā tayoḥ parivartanena ayamapūrvo rājayogaḥ samajāyate. Atra ātmakāraka-pūrvapuṇyakārakayoḥ śubhaikyaṃ bhavati. Anena jātakaḥ tīkṣṇabuddhiḥ, prakhyātakīrtiḥ, satsantānavān, pūrvajanmārjita-sukṛtaphalasampannaśca jāyate. Buddhivyaktitvayoḥ parasparasaṃvardhanena jātakaḥ śāstrajñaḥ prakhyātanetā ca bhavati.

RAJA_1_9.name: Rājayogaḥ (1-9) — lagneśa-navameśayoḥ parasparaṃ rāśi-parivartana-janyaḥ.
RAJA_1_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye (rājayoga-adhyāye) varṇitam — lagneśo navame, navameśaśca lagne yadā santiṣṭhate, tadā ātma-bhāgya-dharma-saṃyogāt parama-rājayogaḥ samajāyate. Atra dharma-kīrti-dīrghāyuṣāṃ yogaḥ prādurbhavati. Jātakaḥ īśvarīya-kṛpāpātraḥ, pitṛbhaktaḥ, dhārmikaḥ, samājasya pūjyanetā ca bhavati.

RAJA_4_5.name: Rājayogaḥ (4-5) — caturtheśa-pañcameśayoḥ parasparaṃ rāśi-parivartana-janyaḥ.
RAJA_4_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre varṇitam — caturtheśo pañcame, pañcameśaśca caturthe tiṣṭhati cet, sukha-buddhi-vidyā-yogāt gṛha-samṛddhiḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ uttamaśikṣitaḥ, mātṛbhaktaḥ, sukhasampannaḥ, śāstravit ca bhavati.

RAJA_4_9.name: Rājayogaḥ (4-9) — caturtheśa-navameśayoḥ parasparaṃ rāśi-parivartana-janyaḥ.
RAJA_4_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre varṇitam — caturtheśo navame, navameśaśca caturthe tiṣṭhati cet, sukha-dharma-bhāgya-saṃyogāt parama-sampattiḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ bhāgyaśālī, bhū-sampannaḥ, deva-guru-bhaktaśca jāyate.

RAJA_5_IN_1.name: Rājayogaḥ — pañcameśo lagne — pūrvapuṇya-tanubhāva-saṃyogaḥ.
RAJA_5_IN_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre caturviṃśe adhyāye varṇitam — pañcameśo lagne santiṣṭhate cet, sa pūrvapuṇya-saṃyogāt tīkṣṇabuddhiṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, satsantāna-sukhaṃ ca phalayati. Jātakaḥ tīkṣṇamatiḥ, mantravidyāviśāradaḥ, yaśasvī ca bhavati.

RAJA_7_5.name: Rājayogaḥ (7-5) — saptameśa-pañcameśayoḥ parasparaṃ rāśi-parivartana-janyaḥ.
RAJA_7_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre varṇitam — saptameśo pañcame, pañcameśaśca saptame yadi tiṣṭhati, tadā dāmpatya-buddhi-pūrvapuṇya-saṃyogāt rūpavat-guṇavat-bhāryā/pati-sukhaṃ samajāyate. Jātakaḥ kalā-kauśala-pravīṇaḥ jāyate.

RAJA_7_9.name: Rājayogaḥ (7-9) — saptameśa-navameśayoḥ parasparaṃ rāśi-parivartana-janyaḥ.
RAJA_7_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre varṇitam — saptameśo navame, navameśaśca saptame yadi tiṣṭhati, tadā dāmpatya-bhāgya-dharma-saṃyogāt vivāha-paścāt bhāgyodayaḥ samajāyate. Jātakaḥ mahā-bhāgyaśālī bhavati.

RAJA_9_IN_1.name: Rājayogaḥ — navameśo lagne — bhāgya-tanubhāva-saṃyogaḥ.
RAJA_9_IN_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre caturviṃśe adhyāye varṇitam — navameśo lagne santiṣṭhate cet, sa parama-bhāgya-dharma-saṃyogāt dīrghāyuṣaṃ, prakhyātakīrtiṃ, īśvarīyakṛpāṃ ca phalayati. Jātakaḥ dhārmikaḥ, sarvapriyaḥ, bhūpatitulyaprabhāvavān bhavati.

RAJA_9_IN_10.name: Rājayogaḥ — navameśo daśame — bhāgya-karmaṇoḥ pratyakṣa-sambandhaḥ.
RAJA_9_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye varṇitam — navameśo daśama-bhāve santiṣṭhate cet, sa bhāgya-karmaṇoḥ śubhādhikārāt parama-rāja-kīrtiṃ phalayati. Jātakaḥ svadharmācaraṇī, kīrtimān, rājyādhikārī bhavati.

RAJA_JUPITER_AND_L1.name: Rājayogaḥ — balavān devaguruḥ kendre, 1-bhāvasvāmī ca kendra-trikoṇe saṃsaṃsthitaḥ.
RAJA_JUPITER_AND_L1.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye varṇitamasti — yadā balavān devaguruḥ kendre saṃsaṃsthitaḥ bhūtvā kendra-trikoṇagataṃ 1-bhāvasvāminaṃ pūrṇadṛṣṭyā rakṣati, tadā gurudṛṣṭiprabhāveṇa tasya 1-bhāvasya phalaṃ aṣṭaguṇaṃ vardhate. Ayaṃ Jupiter-strong + Lagna-lord-strong iti nāmā viśiṣṭarājayogaḥ kalpyate.

RAJA_KARAKA_JUPITER_SATURN.name: Rājakāraka-yogaḥ — JUPITER-SATURN grahayoḥ ekarāśau yutiḥ, Wisdom-Discipline iti viśiṣṭaguṇapradā.
RAJA_KARAKA_JUPITER_SATURN.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye rājakārakayogo varṇitaḥ — viśiṣṭagrahayugalayoḥ yutyā bhāvādhipatisambandhaṃ vināpi jātakasya jīvane adhikārapadaprāptiḥ jāyate. Atra JUPITER-SATURN grahayoḥ yutisambandhaḥ Wisdom-Discipline iti viśiṣṭaguṇaṃ prabhutvaṃ ca sampādayati.
