RAJA_KARMA_10_LORD_LAGNA.name: Rāja-karma yogaḥ — lagne daśameśe — ātma-karmaṇoḥ abheda-sambandhaḥ.
RAJA_KARMA_10_LORD_LAGNA.prose: Rāja-karma-yogaḥ bṛhatpārāśara-horā-śāstrasya aṣṭādaśādhyāye kathitaḥ. Daśameśo lagna-bhāve yadi tiṣṭhet, tadā jātakasya svarūpaṃ karmaṇā saha ekīkṛtaṃ bhavati, saḥ svaprayatnena yaśasvī bhavati.

RAJA_KT_10_1.name: Daśameśo lagne kendra-trikoṇa-rājayogaḥ. Karma-kārakaḥ tanusthānāt sarva-karma-yaśam.
RAJA_KT_10_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekacatvāriṃśe adhyāye daśameśo lagnasthaḥ kendra-kendra-rājayogaḥ — karma-kārakaḥ (10) tanusthānamāśritya vyaktitvameva karma-yaśaṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, sva-prayāsena prasiddhiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 6 — śreṣṭha-karma-rājayogaḥ.

RAJA_KT_4_9.name: Caturtheśo navame mahā-rājayogaḥ. Mātṛ-dharma-saṃyogaḥ, paitṛka-gṛha-vardhanam.
RAJA_KT_4_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekacatvāriṃśe adhyāye caturtheśo navamasthaḥ sukha-trikoṇa-mahā-rājayogaḥ — sukha-kārakaḥ (4) bhāgya-sthāne (9) phalitaḥ mātṛ-dharma-saṃyogaṃ, paitṛka-gṛha-vardhanaṃ, dhārmika-gṛhastha-vṛttiṃ, guru-kṛpāṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 6 — śreṣṭha-rājayogānāṃ madhye.

RAJA_KT_5_10.name: Pañcameśo daśame trikoṇa-kendra-rājayogaḥ. Pūrva-puṇyena-karma-yaśam, buddhi-karma-saṃyogaḥ.
RAJA_KT_5_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekacatvāriṃśe adhyāye pañcameśo daśamasthaḥ trikoṇa-kendra-rājayogaḥ — pūrva-puṇya-kārakaḥ karma-sthāne phalitaḥ buddhi-kauśalena karma-yaśaṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, vidyā-vyāpāreṇa ucca-padaṃ ca dadāti.

RAJA_KT_5_4.name: Pañcameśaścaturthe trikoṇa-kendra-rājayogaḥ. Pūrva-puṇyena-gṛha-sukham, mātṛ-santati-saṃyogaḥ.
RAJA_KT_5_4.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekacatvāriṃśe adhyāye pañcameśaścaturthasthaḥ trikoṇa-kendra-rājayogaḥ — pūrva-puṇya-kārakaḥ (5) sukha-sthāne (4) phalitaḥ mātṛ-sukhena-santati-saṃyogaṃ, gṛha-śāntiṃ, dhārmika-gṛhasthaṃ ca dadāti.
RAJA_KT_5_4.general: Trikoṇa-kendra-rājayogaḥ, mātṛ-sukhena santati-saṃyogaḥ, gṛha-śāntiḥ, dhārmika-gṛhasthaḥ, hṛdaya-prasannatā.

RAJA_KT_5_7.name: Pañcameśaḥ saptame trikoṇa-kendra-rājayogaḥ. Putra-kalatra-saṃyogaḥ, sāthī-kāraṇena-yaśam.
RAJA_KT_5_7.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekacatvāriṃśe adhyāye pañcameśaḥ saptamasthaḥ trikoṇa-kendra-rājayogaḥ — pūrva-puṇyaṃ kalatra-sthāne phalitaṃ putra-kalatra-saṃyogaṃ, sāthī-kāraṇena yaśaṃ, sad-vyāpāraṃ, yātrā-lābhaṃ ca dadāti.

RAJA_KT_7_9.name: Saptameśo navame kalatra-bhāgya-yogaḥ. Sāthī-kāraṇena-bhāgyodayaḥ, dharma-yātrā.
RAJA_KT_7_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekacatvāriṃśe adhyāye saptameśo navamasthaḥ kalatra-trikoṇa-rājayogaḥ — kalatra-kārakaḥ (7) bhāgya-sthāne (9) phalitaḥ sāthī-kāraṇena bhāgyodayaṃ, dhārmika-sāthinaṃ, videśa-dharma-yātrāṃ, guru-kṛpāṃ ca dadāti.

RAJA_KT_9_4.name: Bhāgyeśaścaturthe mahā-rājayogaḥ. Bhāgyena-mātṛ-gṛha-vardhanam, dhārmika-gṛhasthaḥ.
RAJA_KT_9_4.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekacatvāriṃśe adhyāye bhāgyeśaścaturthasthaḥ trikoṇa-kendra-mahā-rājayogaḥ — bhāgya-kārakaḥ (9) sukha-sthāne (4) phalitaḥ bhāgyena-mātṛ-gṛha-vardhanaṃ, dharmeṇa-kuṭumba-saṃrakṣaṇaṃ, guru-kṛpāṃ ca dadāti.

RAJA_KT_9_7.name: Bhāgyeśaḥ saptame mahā-rājayogaḥ. Bhāgyena-dāmpatya-vardhanam, dharma-yātrā.
RAJA_KT_9_7.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ekacatvāriṃśe adhyāye bhāgyeśaḥ saptamasthaḥ trikoṇa-kendra-mahā-rājayogaḥ — bhāgya-kārakaḥ kalatra-sthāne phalitaḥ bhāgyena-dāmpatya-vardhanaṃ, dhārmika-sāthinaṃ, videśa-dharma-yātrāṃ, guru-kṛpāṃ ca dadāti.

RAJA_LAKSHANA.name: Rāja-lakṣaṇa yogaḥ — sarva-rāja-kārakāḥ balavantaḥ. Rāja-tulya-vyaktitvam.
RAJA_LAKSHANA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye rāja-lakṣaṇa-yogaḥ — sūrya-guru-śukrāḥ sarve kendra-trikoṇayoḥ balavantaḥ santaḥ rāja-tulya-vyaktitvaṃ, aṣṭa-rāja-lakṣaṇāni, siṃha-samānāṃ pratāpaṃ, rāja-kula-kīrtiṃ dadati. Sarvottama-rājayogānāṃ anyatamaḥ.

RAJA_LORD_CONJ_1_10.name: Rājayogaḥ — 1-10 bhāvasvāminoḥ ekarāśau yutiḥ. Dvibhāvasambaddhaṃ śubhaphalam.
RAJA_LORD_CONJ_1_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye (rājayoga-adhyāye) varṇitamasti — dvau bhāveśau ekasmin rāśau yutau bhūtvā rājayogaṃ janayataḥ. Atra 1-10 svāminoḥ yutyā ubhayabhāvasambaddhaṃ phalaṃ saṅgṛhītaṃ bhavati, yacca Lagna-lord conjunct 10th-lord (Karma-Lagnadhipati) iti viśiṣṭanāmakena vyaktamasti. Ekaiva apratihatā śubhadhārā dvibhāvaphalaṃ prasādhayati. Jātakaḥ rājakīyasammānaṃ, adhikārasiddhiṃ ca prāpnoti.

RAJA_LORD_CONJ_1_5.name: Rājayogaḥ — 1-5 bhāvasvāminoḥ ekarāśau yutiḥ. Dvibhāvasambaddhaṃ śubhaphalam.

Ekaiva apratihatā śubhadhārā dvibhāvaphalaṃ prasādhayati. Jātakaḥ rājakīyasammānaṃ, adhikārasiddhiṃ ca prāpnoti.

RAJA_LORD_CONJ_4_10.name: Rājayogaḥ — 4-10 bhāvasvāminoḥ ekarāśau yutiḥ. Dvibhāvasambaddhaṃ śubhaphalam.
RAJA_LORD_CONJ_4_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye (rājayoga-adhyāye) varṇitamasti — dvau bhāveśau ekasmin rāśau yutau bhūtvā rājayogaṃ janayataḥ. Atra 4-10 svāminoḥ yutyā ubhayabhāvasambaddhaṃ phalaṃ saṅgṛhītaṃ bhavati, yacca 4th-lord conjunct 10th-lord (Sukha-Karma) iti viśiṣṭanāmakena vyaktamasti. Ekaiva apratihatā śubhadhārā dvibhāvaphalaṃ prasādhayati. Jātakaḥ rājakīyasammānaṃ, adhikārasiddhiṃ ca prāpnoti.

RAJA_LORD_CONJ_4_5.name: Rājayogaḥ — 4-5 bhāvasvāminoḥ ekarāśau yutiḥ. Dvibhāvasambaddhaṃ śubhaphalam.
RAJA_LORD_CONJ_4_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye (rājayoga-adhyāye) varṇitamasti — dvau bhāveśau ekasmin rāśau yutau bhūtvā rājayogaṃ janayataḥ. Atra 4-5 svāminoḥ yutyā ubhayabhāvasambaddhaṃ phalaṃ saṅgṛhītaṃ bhavati, yacca 4th-lord conjunct 5th-lord (Sukha-Putra) iti viśiṣṭanāmakena vyaktamasti. Ekaiva apratihatā śubhadhārā dvibhāvaphalaṃ prasādhayati. Jātakaḥ rājakīyasammānaṃ, adhikārasiddhiṃ ca prāpnoti.

RAJA_LORD_CONJ_5_10.name: Rājayogaḥ — 5-10 bhāvasvāminoḥ ekarāśau yutiḥ. Dvibhāvasambaddhaṃ śubhaphalam.
RAJA_LORD_CONJ_5_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye (rājayoga-adhyāye) varṇitamasti — dvau bhāveśau ekasmin rāśau yutau bhūtvā rājayogaṃ janayataḥ. Atra 5-10 svāminoḥ yutyā ubhayabhāvasambaddhaṃ phalaṃ saṅgṛhītaṃ bhavati, yacca 5th-lord conjunct 10th-lord (Trikona-Kendra) iti viśiṣṭanāmakena vyaktamasti. Ekaiva apratihatā śubhadhārā dvibhāvaphalaṃ prasādhayati. Jātakaḥ rājakīyasammānaṃ, adhikārasiddhiṃ ca prāpnoti.

RAJA_LORD_CONJ_5_9.name: Rājayogaḥ — 5-9 bhāvasvāminoḥ ekarāśau yutiḥ. Dvibhāvasambaddhaṃ śubhaphalam.
RAJA_LORD_CONJ_5_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye (rājayoga-adhyāye) varṇitamasti — dvau bhāveśau ekasmin rāśau yutau bhūtvā rājayogaṃ janayataḥ. Atra 5-9 svāminoḥ yutyā ubhayabhāvasambaddhaṃ phalaṃ saṅgṛhītaṃ bhavati, yacca Dharma-Karmadhipati conjunction (5L-9L) iti viśiṣṭanāmakena vyaktamasti. Ekaiva apratihatā śubhadhārā dvibhāvaphalaṃ prasādhayati. Jātakaḥ rājakīyasammānaṃ, adhikārasiddhiṃ ca prāpnoti.

RAJA_LORD_CONJ_7_10.name: Rājayogaḥ — 7-10 bhāvasvāminoḥ ekarāśau yutiḥ. Dvibhāvasambaddhaṃ śubhaphalam.
RAJA_LORD_CONJ_7_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye (rājayoga-adhyāye) varṇitamasti — dvau bhāveśau ekasmin rāśau yutau bhūtvā rājayogaṃ janayataḥ. Atra 7-10 svāminoḥ yutyā ubhayabhāvasambaddhaṃ phalaṃ saṅgṛhītaṃ bhavati, yacca 7th-lord conjunct 10th-lord (Kalatra-Karma) iti viśiṣṭanāmakena vyaktamasti. Ekaiva apratihatā śubhadhārā dvibhāvaphalaṃ prasādhayati. Jātakaḥ rājakīyasammānaṃ, adhikārasiddhiṃ ca prāpnoti.

RAJA_LORD_CONJ_9_10.name: Rājayogaḥ — 9-10 bhāvasvāminoḥ ekarāśau yutiḥ. Dvibhāvasambaddhaṃ śubhaphalam.
RAJA_LORD_CONJ_9_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye (rājayoga-adhyāye) varṇitamasti — dvau bhāveśau ekasmin rāśau yutau bhūtvā rājayogaṃ janayataḥ. Atra 9-10 svāminoḥ yutyā ubhayabhāvasambaddhaṃ phalaṃ saṅgṛhītaṃ bhavati, yacca Dharma-Karmadhipati conjunction (9L-10L) iti viśiṣṭanāmakena vyaktamasti. Ekaiva apratihatā śubhadhārā dvibhāvaphalaṃ prasādhayati. Jātakaḥ rājakīyasammānaṃ, adhikārasiddhiṃ ca prāpnoti.

RAJJU.name: Rajju yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ cara-rāśiṣu. Yātrā-priyaḥ, asthira-cittaḥ.
RAJJU.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye rajju yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ caturṣu cara-rāśiṣu (meṣa-karka-tulā-makara) tiṣṭhanto jātakaṃ yātrā-priyaṃ, asthira-cittaṃ, videśa-gāminaṃ, parivartana-śīlaṃ ca kurvanti. Calat-svabhāvaḥ.

RAJJU_DOSHA.name: Rajju doṣaḥ — vara-vadhū-samāna-rajjvām. Nāśa-sthānānuguṇaṃ viśeṣa-kaṣṭa.
RAJJU_DOSHA.prose: Muhūrta-cintāmaṇau ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye rajju doṣa — vara-vadhū-nakṣatrau eka-rajjvām (nakṣatra-śīrṣa-kaṇṭha-nābhi-kaṭi-pāda-vargayoḥ samānau) tattva-nāśana-sthānānuguṇaṃ viśeṣa-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Śīrṣa-rajjau — pati-nāśaḥ, kaṇṭha-rajjau — santati-nāśaḥ, iti-vat.

RAVI_BHASHKARA_SUN_MERCURY_10.name: Ravi-bhāskara yogaḥ — daśame balī sūrya-budhau — rāja-śāsakīya-sarvoccatā.
RAVI_BHASHKARA_SUN_MERCURY_10.prose: Ravi-bhāskara-yogaḥ sūrya-budhayoḥ daśamabhāve svoccarāśisthitau jāyate, anena jātakaḥ śāsakīya-praśāsakīya-kāryādhikāraṃ prāpnoti.

RIN_DOSHA_PITRI.name: Pitṛ-ṛṇa doṣaḥ — lāla-kitāba-śāstrokta-paitṛka-ṛṇa. Paitṛka-śāpa-karma.
RIN_DOSHA_PITRI.prose: Lāla-kitāba-śāstre pitṛ-ṛṇa doṣaḥ — sūrya-guru-daurbalye pañcama-navama-sthāneṣu pāpa-saṃyoge ca paitṛka-ṛṇa-karmaṇaṃ, paitṛka-śāpa-karmaṇaṃ, santati-karma-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Nadī-jala-dāna, pīpala-pūjana, pitṛ-tarpaṇa-karmabhiḥ nivāraṇīyam.
RIN_DOSHA_PITRI.general: Paitṛka-ṛṇa karma, paitṛka-śāpa, santati-karma kaṣṭa yogyatā.

RIN_DOSHA_STRI.name: Strī-ṛṇa doṣaḥ — lāla-kitāba-śāstrokta-strī-ṛṇa. Mātṛ-kanyā-śāpa.
RIN_DOSHA_STRI.prose: Lāla-kitāba-śāstre strī-ṛṇa doṣaḥ — candra-śukra-daurbalye 2-4-7-sthāneṣu pāpa-saṃyoge ca mātṛ-kanyā-strī-karmaṇi pūrva-janma-ṛṇa, strī-śāpa-karma, strī-sambandha-nyūnatā-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Kanyā-dāna, strī-dhana-dāna, gaurī-vratena nivāraṇīyam.

RIN_DOSHA_SWAJAN.name: Svajana-ṛṇa doṣaḥ — lāla-kitāba-śāstrokta-svajana-ṛṇa. Kuṭumba-śāpa.
RIN_DOSHA_SWAJAN.prose: Lāla-kitāba-śāstre svajana-ṛṇa doṣaḥ — maṅgala-rāhu-daurbalye 3-11-sthāneṣu pāpa-saṃyoge ca svajana-kuṭumba-karmaṇi pūrva-janma-ṛṇa, sahodara-śāpa-karma, mitra-kuṭumba-viyoga-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Kuṭumba-sevā-karma, gau-sevā, anna-dānena nivāraṇīyam.
RIN_DOSHA_SWAJAN.general: Svajana-kuṭumba śāpa, sahodara-śāpa, mitra-kuṭumba viyoga yogyatā.

RUCHAKA.name: Lagnāt candrādvā kendrabhāvagate meṣavṛścikamakarasthe dharaṇīsute rucakayogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ paramasāhasī, sainyabalapraṇetā, suvikhyātakīrtiḥ, śatruhantā ca bhavati.
RUCHAKA.prose: Atha pañcamahāpuruṣayogeṣu prathamo rucakayogaḥ. 'Svoccasvarkṣagataiḥ śanaiścaramukhaiḥ kendre sthitāḥ pañcadhā' iti vacanānusāraṃ kuṇḍalyāṃ lagnasthānāt candralagnādvā kendrabhavaneṣu (1, 4, 7, 10) maṅgale meṣa-vṛścika-makararāśisthe sati rucakayogo jāyate. Asya phalaṃ parāśarahorāśāstre samyaguktam — 'dīrghāsyo bahusāhasī bahuguṇaḥ śūraḥ pratāpī dhanī... Senāpatiḥ śatruparājayakṛcca.' Bhaumasya naisargikaśauryaṃ tathā ca kendrabhāvasya sāmrājyaśaktiḥ militvā jātakaṃ sāhasikakāryeṣu śalyacikitsāyāṃ krīḍāyāṃ vā senāpatitve ca agragāminaṃ karoti.
RUCHAKA.body: Sugaṭhitaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ ca śarīraṃ, tejasvi vadanam
RUCHAKA.wealth: Śauryeṇa svaparākrameṇa ca arjitaṃ vipulaṃ dhanam

RUCHAKA_BHANGA.name: Kendrabhāvagate svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe'pi bhaume astaṅgate vakriṇi vā sati rucakabhaṅgayogo jāyate. Anena rucakayogasya śubhaphaleṣu hrāso bhavati.
RUCHAKA_BHANGA.prose: Yadā bhaumaḥ kendrasthāneṣu svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇarāśistho'pi san sūryeṇa saha yutatvāt astaṅgato bhavati, athavā vakrī-gatyā yukto bhavati, tadā rucakabhaṅgayogo jāyate. Śāstrīyadṛṣṭyā ayamupadravaḥ asti. Yadyapi mūlayogasya prabhāvaḥ kuṇḍalyāṃ vidyate, tathāpi maṅgalasya vakrītvena astaṅgatatvena vā tasya kārakatve doṣo jāyate. Anena jātakasya sāhase saṃśayaḥ, śaurye utāracaḍhāvaḥ, śalyakarmaṇi krīḍāsu vā bādhāḥ samajāyante. Bhaumaśāntipūjā-gāyatrīmantrajapādibhiḥ asya doṣasya nivāraṇaṃ bhavati.

RUCHAKA_EXALTED.name: Kendrabhāvagate makararāśisthe (paramoccasthe) dharaṇīsute uccarucakasañjño mahāyogo bhavati. Ayamuccatamakoṭeḥ paramavīrayogaḥ.
RUCHAKA_EXALTED.prose: Atha rucakayogasya paramaśreṣṭharūpamuccarucakayogaḥ. Yadā bhaumaḥ svaparamoccarāśau makare (28 aṃśe) sthitaḥ san lagnataścandrataśca kendre tiṣṭhati, tadā phaladīpikānusāraṃ 'uccastho pūrṇaphaladaḥ' iti niyamena pūrṇaṃ phalaṃ phalayati. Ayaṃ yogo jātakaṃ paramatejasvinaṃ, śatrumardanakāriṇaṃ, durdharṣasāhasayuktaṃ ca karoti. Sainyapraśāsane, śalyakriyāśāstre, krīḍājagati ca sarvoccapadaprāptaye eṣa eṣa sarvaśreṣṭhaḥ śāstrīyayogo vidyate.

RUCHAKA_FROM_MOON.name: Candralagnāt kendre svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe bhaume candrarucakayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya manasi asādhāraṇaṃ śauryaṃ dhairyaṃ ca utpadyate.
RUCHAKA_FROM_MOON.prose: Yadā jātakasya kuṇḍalyāṃ candralagnāt kendrabhāveṣu (1, 4, 7, 10) maṅgalaḥ svocce svarkṣe vā sthito bhavati, tadā candrarucakayogo jāyate (sārāvalī adhyāya 38). Candraḥ manasaḥ kārakaḥ, bhaumastu śauryasya; tayoḥ sambandhāt jātakasya manasi adbhūtaṃ sāhasaṃ, bhītihīnatā, tathā ca sainyadṛṣṭikoṇaḥ jāyate. Yadā ayaṃ yogaḥ lagna-candra-dvayoḥ kendre bhavati, tadā jātakaḥ samrāṭṭulyo mahāpratāpī ca bhavati.

RUCHAKA_TRIKONA.name: Rucaka yoga (trikoṇa-vat) — maṅgalaḥ trikoṇe ucca-sva-rāśi-sthaḥ.
RUCHAKA_TRIKONA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ aṣṭatriṃśe adhyāye rucaka-trikoṇa-yogaḥ — maṅgalaḥ trikoṇa-sthāne (1/5/9) ucca-svarāśi-sthitaḥ mahā-puruṣa-tulyāṃ śauryaṃ, sāhasaṃ, kṣātra-tejasaṃ, senā-nāyakatvaṃ dadāti. Kendrāt kañcit nyūna-balaṃ kintu trikoṇa-śubha-saṃrakṣaṇam.

SAHAJA_3_LORD_KENDRA.name: Sahaja yoga — tṛtīyeśa kendre — dṛḍha-parākramam.
SAHAJA_3_LORD_KENDRA.prose: Sahaja-yogaḥ tṛtīyeśo lagna-caturtha-saptama-daśameṣu yadi syāt, tadā sāhasaṃ bhrātṛ-sukhaṃ ca pradāti.

SAHAJA_3_LORD_OWN_EXALT.name: Sahaja yoga — tṛtīyeśa sva/ucca — digbala-parākramam.
SAHAJA_3_LORD_OWN_EXALT.prose: Tṛtīyeśo sva-ucca-mūlatrikoṇa-rāśiṣu yadi syāt, tadā sahaja-yogo digbala-saṃyukto bhavati.

SAHAJA_3_LORD_TRIKONA.name: Sahaja yoga — tṛtīyeśa trikoṇe — dharmānukūla-pahalaḥ.
SAHAJA_3_LORD_TRIKONA.prose: Tṛtīyeśo trikoṇe (1,5,9) yadi syāt, tadā dharma-niṣṭha-parākramaṃ bhavati.

SAHAJA_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_3_11.name: Sahaja-lābha parivartana — tṛtīyeśa-ekādaśeśa parivartana — pahala-lābha-saṃyojanam.
SAHAJA_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_3_11.prose: Sahaja-lābha-parivartana-yogaḥ tṛtīyeśo ekādaśeśasya rāśau, ekādaśeśo tṛtīyeśasya rāśau yadi sthitau, tadā pahala-lābha-saṃyojanaṃ bhavati.

SAKATA.name: Śakaṭa yogaḥ — grahāḥ lagna-saptamayoḥ. Cakra-gati-samānaṃ utthāna-patanam.
SAKATA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye śakaṭa yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ lagna-saptama-kendrayoḥ eva upasthitāḥ. Śakaṭa-cakra-gati-samānāṃ jīvanaṃ — dīrghakālika-utthāna-patana-śṛṅkhalā, ārthika-aniścitatā, śrama-sahanīyatā-parīkṣā.
SAKATA.general: Dīrghakālika utthāna-patana, ārthika-aniścitatā, śrama-sahanīyatā-parīkṣā, gāḍī-sambandhī karma.

SAKTI.name: Śakti yogaḥ — grahāḥ 7-8-9-10 bhāveṣu krameṇa. Śastra-samāna-śakti-yogaḥ.
SAKTI.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye śakti yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ 7-8-9-10 bhāveṣu krameṇa. Śastra-śakti-samānāṃ vīrya-karma, dharma-karma-saṃyogaṃ, gupta-śakti-niratiṃ dadāti. Dāmpatya-dharma-karma-śṛṅkhalā.

SAMUDRA.name: Samudra yogaḥ — grahāḥ sama-bhāveṣu (2-4-6-8-10-12). Samudra-samānaṃ gāmbhīryam, ananta-dhanam.
SAMUDRA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye samudra yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ sama-bhāveṣu (2-4-6-8-10-12) tiṣṭhanti. Samudra-samānāṃ gāmbhīryaṃ, ananta-dhana-saṅgrahaṃ, sarva-ratna-samarthyaṃ, gahana-vyaktitvaṃ dadāti.

SANKRANTI_DOSHA.name: Saṅkrānti doṣaḥ — sūrya-rāśi-saṅkramaṇa-divase janmaḥ. Saṅkramaṇa-kāla-kaṣṭa.
SANKRANTI_DOSHA.prose: Muhūrta-gaṇapatau saṅkrānti doṣaḥ — sūryasya rāśi-saṅkramaṇa-divase (viśeṣataḥ ±6-horā-kāle) janmekaḥ saṅkramaṇa-kāla-kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ, sarva-saṃskāra-śānti-karma-āvaśyakatāṃ, dhārmika-dāna-nivāraṇaṃ dadāti. Dvādaśa-saṅkrāntiṣu makara-karka-tulā-meṣa-caturṣu viśeṣa-śubha-nyūnatā.
SANKRANTI_DOSHA.general: Saṅkramaṇa-kāla kaṣṭa yogyatā, saṃskāra-śānti āvaśyakatā, dhārmika-dāna nivāraṇa.

SANTANA_5_LORD_9.name: Santāna yoga — pañcameśa navame — santāna-dharma-saṃyogaḥ.
SANTANA_5_LORD_9.prose: Santāna-yogaḥ pañcameśo navame yadi syāt, tadā putrāḥ dharma-niṣṭhāḥ guruvad-vartanaśīlā bhavanti.

SANTANA_5_LORD_KENDRA.name: Santāna yoga — pañcameśa kendre — putra-sukhaṃ sudṛḍham.
SANTANA_5_LORD_KENDRA.prose: Santāna-yogaḥ pañcameśo lagna-caturtha-saptama-daśameṣu yadi syāt, tadā putra-sukhaṃ buddhi-tīvratā ca pradāti.

SANTANA_5_LORD_LAGNA.name: Santāna yoga — pañcameśa lagne — ātma-putra-saṃyogaḥ.
SANTANA_5_LORD_LAGNA.prose: Santāna-yogaḥ pañcameśo lagne yadi syāt, tadā putrāḥ ātma-svarūpaṃ pratiphalayanti, buddhiḥ ca prakharā bhavati.

SANTANA_5_LORD_OWN_EXALT.name: Santāna yoga — pañcameśa sva/ucce — pūrṇa-putra-sukha-phalam.
SANTANA_5_LORD_OWN_EXALT.prose: Santāna-yogaḥ pañcameśaḥ sva-ucca-mūlatrikoṇe yadi syāt, tadā pūrṇa-putra-sukha-buddhi-purvapuṇya-phalaṃ pradāti.

SANTANA_5_LORD_TRIKONA.name: Santāna yoga — pañcameśa trikoṇe — dharma-saṃyukta-putra-sukham.
SANTANA_5_LORD_TRIKONA.prose: Santāna-yogaḥ pañcameśo lagna-pañcama-navameṣu yadi syāt, tadā dharma-purvapuṇya-saṃyuktaṃ putra-phalaṃ pradāti.

SANTANA_BANDHAN_NODES_5_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Santāna bandhana yoga — rāhu/ketuḥ pañcame + pañcameśo duṣṭāne — santāna-bādhā.
SANTANA_BANDHAN_NODES_5_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Santāna-bandhana-yogaḥ rāhu/ketuḥ pañcame ca pañcameśo ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-vyayeṣu yadi syāt, tadā santāna-vilamba-viyoga-bādhādikaṃ phalayati.

SANTANA_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_5_9.name: Santāna-bhāgya parivartana yoga — pañcama-navameśayoḥ parivartanam — sarvocca-putra-bhāgya.
SANTANA_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_5_9.prose: Santāna-bhāgya-parivartana-yogaḥ pañcameśo navama-bhāve, navameśaḥ pañcama-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā purvapuṇyajanya-santāna-bhāgya-parama-yogaṃ pradāti.

SAPTA_AYUR_SATURN_KENDRA.name: Sapta-āyu yogaḥ — kendre balī śaniḥ — saptativarṣāyuḥ.
SAPTA_AYUR_SATURN_KENDRA.prose: Sapta-āyu-yogaḥ śaniḥ kendra-bhāveṣu (1, 4, 7, 10) svoccarāśiṣu balī bhūtvā tiṣṭhet, tadā saptativarṣāṇāṃ śata-dīrghāyurbhavati.

SARALA.name: Sarala viparīta rāja yoga — aṣṭameśa duṣṭāna — dīrghāyuṃ rahasya-śatru-jayaṃ ca pradāti.
SARALA.prose:
Sarala-yogaḥ viparīta-rāja-yogānāṃ dvitīyo. Aṣṭameśo ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśa-sthāneṣu sthitaḥ san yadi syāt, tasya aśubhatvaṃ viparyayeṇa śubhatvaṃ bhavati, yena dīrghāyuṃ rahasya-śatru-jayaṃ pradāti. (Phaladīpikā 6-37)

etadyogasya phalaṃ alpāyuṣa-rogādi-nivāraṇaṃ rahasya-vidyā-prakāśanaṃ ca bhavati.

SARASWATI.name: Sarasvatī yoga — guru-śukra-budhāḥ kendra-trikoṇe — parama-vidyā-yogaḥ.
SARASWATI.prose: Sarasvatī-yogo guruśca śukraśca budhaśca kendra-trikoṇa-bhāveṣu yadi sthitāḥ syuḥ, tadā devī-sarasvatyā anugraheṇa parama-vidyā-samṛddhiṃ phalayati.

SARASWATI_BENEFIC_KENDRA.name: Sarasvatī yogaḥ — guru-śukra-budheṣu śubhasthāneṣu sthiteṣu — paramavidyā.
SARASWATI_BENEFIC_KENDRA.prose: Budha-guru-śukrāḥ trayaḥ grahāḥ yadi kendra-trikoṇa-bhāveṣu virājante, tadā sarasvatī-yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ devīsarasvatyāḥ sākṣāt kṛpāpātraṃ bhūtvā mahāvidvān, kaviḥ, śāstrajñaḥ, sakalakalākuśalaśca bhavati.

SARPA.name: Sarpa yogaḥ — caturtha-saptama-daśameṣu pāpāḥ. Duṣṭa-svabhāvaḥ, bahu-kaṣṭam.
SARPA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye sarpa yogaḥ — caturtha-saptama-daśama-sthāneṣu eva pāpa-grahāḥ tiṣṭhanti. Sarpa-samānāṃ duṣṭa-vyaktitvaṃ, bahu-kaṣṭa-jīvanaṃ, gṛha-kalahaṃ, karma-saṅgharṣaṃ ca dadāti. Mālā-yogasya pratikūlaḥ.

SARPA_ARISHTA.name: Sarpāriṣṭayogaḥ — rāhuḥ aṣṭamabhāve — viṣabhayaṃ sarpadaṃśabhayaṃ ca.
SARPA_ARISHTA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 10 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā rāhuḥ aṣṭamabhāve (mṛtyubhāve) tiṣṭhati, tadā sarpāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Rāhuḥ sarpakārakaḥ, aṣṭamabhāvaśca mṛtyukārakaḥ; anayoḥ saṃyogāt sarpadaṃśaḥ, khādyaviṣāktatā, apratyāsitā durghaṭanā vā śārīrikakaṣṭaṃ janayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — rāhuśāntiḥ, nāgapūjā, śrāvaṇe sarpadānaṃ ca śreyaskaram.

SAT_IN_10.name: Śanirdaśame śaśa-samāna-karma-rājayogaḥ. Dīrgha-karma-yaśam, rāja-sammānam, sevā-nāyakatvam.
SAT_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śanirdaśamasthaḥ karma-viśeṣa-rājayogakārakaḥ — śaniḥ karma-sthānātmakena digbalī dīrgha-karma-yaśaṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, sevā-nāyakatvaṃ, sthira-ucca-padaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 25 — digbalī śaniḥ karma-yaśaṃ vardhayati.

SAT_IN_11.name: Śaniḥ ekādaśe lābha-sthairya-yogaḥ. Dīrghakālika-dhana-sañcayaḥ, sevā-varga-kīrtiḥ.
SAT_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śaniḥ ekādaśasthaḥ lābha-sthairya-yogakārakaḥ — dīrghakālika-dhana-sañcayaṃ, sevā-varga-kīrtiṃ, sthira-iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 25 — śaneḥ sarvottama-sthānam ekādaśam.

SAT_IN_3.name: Śanistṛtīye dhairya-parākrama-yogaḥ. Dīrgha-pariśrameṇa-yaśam, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-dīrghāyuḥ.
SAT_IN_3.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śanistṛtīyasthaḥ dhairya-parākrama-yogakārakaḥ — dīrgha-pariśrameṇa-yaśaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-dīrghāyuṃ, sthira-udyamaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 25 — śaniḥ upacaya-sthāneṣu ati-śubhadaḥ.

SAT_IN_6.name: Śaniḥ ṣaṣṭhe śatru-roga-jaya-yogaḥ. Dīrgha-saṅgharṣeṇa-vijayaḥ, sevā-kīrtiḥ.
SAT_IN_6.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śaniḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ śatru-roga-jaya-viparīta-rājayogakārakaḥ — dīrgha-saṅgharṣeṇa śatru-jayaṃ, roga-nivṛttiṃ, ṛṇa-kṣayaṃ, sevā-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 25 — śaneḥ upacaya-sthānāt śreṣṭha-phalam.

SAT_KETU_CONJ.name: Śani-ketu yutiḥ — mokṣa-vairāgya-yogaḥ. Ādhyātmika-vairāgya, gahana-cintana.
SAT_KETU_CONJ.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye śani-ketu-yutiḥ miśra-yogaḥ — dvi-vairāgya-kāraka-saṃyogena ādhyātmika-vairāgyaṃ, gahana-cintanaṃ, gupta-śāstra-niratiṃ, mokṣa-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Bāhya-karma-kaṣṭaṃ kintu āntarika-vardhanam.

SAT_RAHU_CONJ.name: Śani-rāhu yutiḥ — śrāpa-yogaḥ. Dīrgha-kaṣṭa, gupta-śatru, parityakta-dharmam.
SAT_RAHU_CONJ.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye śani-rāhu-yutiḥ ati-duṣṭa-yogaḥ (śrāpa-yogaḥ) — dvi-krūra-saṃyogena dīrgha-kālika-kaṣṭaṃ, gupta-śatru-vṛddhiṃ, parityakta-dharma-vṛttiṃ, cira-saṅgharṣa-karma-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Pūrva-janma-śāpena vyākhyā.

SAUBHAGYA_VENUS_KENDRA_9LORD_KENDRA.name: Saubhāgya yoga — śukra-navameśa kendre — saundarya-vaibhava-bhāgyam.
SAUBHAGYA_VENUS_KENDRA_9LORD_KENDRA.prose: Saubhāgya-yogaḥ sārāvalyāḥ 34-adhyāye kathitaḥ. Śukraḥ kendre navameśaśca kendre yadi syātau, tadā saubhāgya-yogo bhavati.

SHAKATA.name: Śakaṭa yoga — candro guroḥ ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-vyaye — bhāgya-cakra-yogaḥ.
SHAKATA.prose: Śakaṭa-yogo candro guroḥ ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśa-bhāveṣu yadi syāt, tadā bhāgya-cakravad-utpatana-patana-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

SHANI_DOSHA.name: Śani doṣaḥ — śaniḥ lagna-kendreṣu-durbalo vā pāpa-dṛṣṭaḥ. Cira-kaṣṭa-yogaḥ.
SHANI_DOSHA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye śani doṣaḥ — śaniḥ lagna-kendreṣu durbala-sthāneṣu vā krūra-graha-dṛṣṭaḥ san cira-kālika-karma-kaṣṭaṃ, sāḍhe-sātī-tulya-dīrgha-saṅgharṣaṃ, śrama-sahanaśīlatā-parīkṣāṃ dadāti. Śanivāra-vrata-nīlama-dhāraṇena nivāraṇīyam.

SHANI_MANGAL.name: Śani-maṅgala yoga — śani-maṅgalayoḥ yutiḥ — virodhī-śakti-saṃyogaḥ.
SHANI_MANGAL.prose: Śani-maṅgala-yogo śaniśca maṅgalaśca kasmiṃścid bhāve yadi sammilitau syātām, tadā śīta-uṣṇayoḥ virodhena ghāta-saṅgharṣa-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

SHANKHA.name: Śaṅkha yoga — pañcama-ṣaṣṭheśau kendre — kīrti-dīrghāyu-yogaḥ.
SHANKHA.prose: Śaṅkha-yogo pañcameśo ṣaṣṭheśaśca kendra-bhāveṣu yadi sthitau syātām, tadā kīrti-dīrghāyu-dharma-sevā-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

SHASHA.name: Lagnāt candramaso vā kendre svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe śanaiścare śaśasañjño yogo jāyate. Anena jātakaḥ dīrghāyuḥ, sthirabuddhiḥ, pratāpī, janasamūhanāyakaśca bhavati.
SHASHA.prose: Atha pañcamahāpuruṣayogeṣu pañcamaḥ śaśayogaḥ. Mandagāmini śanau svoccasvarkṣagate kendre学śaśayogaḥ samajāyate. Asya phalaṃ parāśarahorāśāstre samyag varṇitam — 'kṛśaśarīraḥ suvikhyātakīrtiḥ... Vahusevakayutaḥ śūraḥ.' Śanaiścarasya naisargikaṃ dhairyaṃ kāryakauśalaṃ tathā ca kendrasya adhikāraśaktiḥ militvā jātakaṃ dīrghāyuyuktaṃ, prakhara-rājanetāraṃ, nyāyavid, bhū-khanijādi-udyogapatiṃ tathā ca jananāyakaṃ vidadhāti.
SHASHA.mind: Gambhīraṃ vicāraśīlam, avicaladhairyayuktaṃ, niyamabaddhaṃ ca manaḥ
SHASHA.wealth: Mandagatibhiḥ labdhaṃ kintu susthiraṃ vipulaṃ dhanam, bhū-sampattiḥ

SHASHA_BHANGA.name: Kendrabhāvagate svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe'pi śanaiścare vakriṇi sati śaśabhaṅgayogo jāyate. Anena śaśayogasya śubhaphaleṣu hrāso bhavati.
SHASHA_BHANGA.prose: Yadā śanaiścaraḥ kendrasthāneṣu svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇarāśistho'pi san vakrī-gatyā yukto bhavati, tadā śaśabhaṅgayogo jāyate. Śaniḥ sūryasya sudūre bhramati, ataḥ astaṅgatvaṃ vahuta viralam, vakrītvameva mukhyaḥ doṣaḥ. Śaniḥ prativarṣaṃ prāyaśaḥ māsacatuṣṭayaṃ vakrī bhavati, ataḥ ayamapi sāmānyaḥ doṣaḥ. Anena jātakasya anuśāsane dhairye ca bādhāḥ jāyante, jīvane adhikāraḥ vahuvilambena āgacchati, tathā ca svāsthye samaya-samayamā śithilatā utpadyate. Śanigāyatrīmantrajapena, hanumāna-upāsanena ca asya doṣasya śamanaṃ kartuṃ śakyate.

SHASHA_EXALTED.name: Kendrabhāvagate tulārāśisthe (paramoccasthe) śanau uccaśaśasañjño mahāyogo bhavati. Ayamuccatamakoṭeḥ paramādhikārayogaḥ.
SHASHA_EXALTED.prose: Atha śaśayogasya paramaśreṣṭharūpamuccaśaśayogaḥ. Yadā śanaiścaraḥ svaparamoccarāśau tulāyāṃ (20 aṃśe) sthitaḥ san kendre vartate, tadā phaladīpikānusāraṃ pūrṇaṃ phalaṃ dadāti. Śaniḥ nyāyasya, karmaṇaḥ, dīrghāyuṣaḥ ca kārakaḥ, tulārāśistu tasya paramoccasthānaṃ vyāpāra-nyāya-sāmañjasyapradātā ca. Tayoḥ saṃyogāt jātakaḥ pratāpī, dīrghāyuḥ, paramaanuśāsitaḥ, koṭiśaḥ janānāṃ nāyakaḥ praśāsakaśca bhavati. Bhūmyāḥ, khanijānāṃ, rājakāryāṇāṃ ca kṣetre jātakaḥ sarvoccaṃ padaṃ labhate.

SHASHA_FROM_MOON.name: Candralagnāt kendre svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇasthe śanaiścare candraśaśayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya manasi avicaladhairyaṃ kaṭhoraanuśāsanaṃ ca utpadyate.
SHASHA_FROM_MOON.prose: Yadā jātakasya kuṇḍalyāṃ candralagnāt kendrabhāveṣu śaniḥ svocce svarkṣe vā sthito bhavati, tadā candraśaśayogo jāyate. Candraḥ manasaḥ kārakaḥ, śanistu dhairyasya samayasya ca; tayoḥ saṃyogāt jātakasya manasi asādhāraṇaṃ dhairyaṃ, kaṭhoraanuśāsanaṃ, raṇanītikagambhīratā, tathā ca dīrghadṛṣṭiḥ utpadyate. Jātakaḥ mānasikasaṅkaṭeṣu avicalaḥ tiṣṭhati. Yadi lagna-candra-dvayoḥ kendre śaniḥ sthitaḥ syāt, tadā jātakaḥ mahān rājanetā, jananāyakaḥ, cirasthāyīpraśāsakaśca bhavati.

SHASTRA_ARISHTA.name: Śastrāriṣṭayogaḥ — maṅgalaśanyoḥ caturthabhāve yutiḥ — śastraghāto yānadurghaṭanā ca.
SHASTRA_ARISHTA.prose: Phaladīpikāyām 10 adhyāye varṇitam. Yadā maṅgalaḥ śaniśca yugapat caturthabhāve (gṛha-yāna-sukhabhāve) tiṣṭhataḥ, tadā śastrāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Maṅgalaḥ śastraghātakaḥ, śaniḥ daṇḍakārakaḥ; anayoḥ caturthe sthitiḥ jātakasya śastrāghātam, yānadurghaṭanāṃ vā gṛhakleśaṃ janayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — maṅgalaśanyoḥ śāntiḥ, subrahmaṇyopāsanā, yānasāvadhānī ca.

SHATAYU_JUPITER_LAGNA.name: Śatāyu yogaḥ — lagne sva/ucce devagurau — śatavarṣāyuḥ.
SHATAYU_JUPITER_LAGNA.prose: Śatāyu-yogo gururlagna-bhāve sva-ucca-rāśau (dhanu-mīna-karkaṭeṣu) yadi tiṣṭhet, tadā paramakṛpāyogāt śatavarṣādhikaṃ dīrghāyurbhavati.

SHOOLA.name: Śūla yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ tri-rāśyorvyavasthitāḥ. Ugra-svabhāvaḥ, senā-nāyakaḥ.
SHOOLA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye śūla yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ tri-rāśyoḥ sthitāḥ jātakaṃ ugra-svabhāvaṃ, senā-nāyakaṃ, sāhasika-karma-nirataṃ, krūra-vyavahāriṇaṃ ca karoti. Śūla-samānāṃ tīkṣṇatāṃ dadāti.

SHRINGATAKA.name: Śṛṅgāṭaka yogaḥ — grahāḥ lagna-pañcama-navameṣu. Nāyaka-samānaṃ trikoṇa-rājayogam.
SHRINGATAKA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye śṛṅgāṭaka yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ lagna-pañcama-navama-trikoṇeṣu eva. Nāyaka-samānāṃ trikoṇa-rājayogaṃ — pūrva-puṇya-pūrṇa-bhāgya-saṃyuktaṃ kīrtiṃ, senā-nāyakatvaṃ, dharma-rāja-samarthyaṃ dadāti.

SHUBHA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.name: Śubha-kartarī (candraḥ) — candrasya ubhayataḥ śubhagrahāṇāṃ sthitiḥ — manasaṃrakṣaṇam.
SHUBHA_KARTARI_CHANDRA.prose: Candrāt dvitīya-dvādaśa-bhāvayoḥ śubhagrahāḥ yadi tiṣṭheyuḥ, tadā candra-śubhakartarī-yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ sukhī, nirupadravaḥ, psychic-mental-peace-yuktaḥ, sarvajanapriyaśca bhavati.

SREENATHA.name: Śrīnāthayogaḥ — navameśa-daśameśa-saptameśānaṃ śubhakendrasaṃyogaḥ. Lakṣmīnāyakasamānā sampattiḥ.
SREENATHA.prose: Jātakapārijāte pañcame adhyāye śrīnāthayogaḥ — yadā navameśaḥ, daśameśaḥ, saptameśaśca ete trayaḥ parasparaṃ śubhasambandhena kendre santiṣṭhanti, tadā śrīnāthayogaḥ. Ayaṃ lakṣmīpateḥ śrīnāthasya (viṣṇoḥ) kṛpāprasādaḥ. Anena jātakaḥ parama-dhanī, sadgṛhasthaḥ, prakhyātakīrtiḥ, dhārmikarājapūjitaśca bhavati.

SRIKANTHA.name: Śrīkaṇṭha yogaḥ — sūrya-candra-lagne sama-rāśiṣu. Śiva-tulya-vyaktitvam.
SRIKANTHA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye śrīkaṇṭha-yogaḥ — sūrya-candra-lagna-navāṃśa-svāminaḥ sama-rāśiṣu śubha-sthāne tiṣṭhantaḥ śiva-tulya-vyaktitvaṃ, dhārmika-yogi-vṛttiṃ, mantra-siddhiṃ, ati-tapaḥ-śaktiṃ dadati. Śrīkaṇṭha (śiva)-samānāṃ yogi-rāja-tejaḥ.

SRINATH.name: Śrīnātha yogaḥ (nāma) — saptameśo daśamasthaḥ budha-dṛṣṭaḥ. Lakṣmī-nāyaka-tulyam.
SRINATH.prose: Jātaka-pārijāte pañcame adhyāye śrīnātha-nāma-yogaḥ — saptameśo daśamasthāne'sti, budhena ca dṛṣṭaḥ. Lakṣmī-nāyaka (viṣṇu)-tulyāṃ sampattiṃ, dhārmika-rāja-yaśaṃ, sad-gṛhastha-kīrtiṃ dadāti. Na tu rāja-yo śrīnātha-yogaḥ.

STHIRA_AYUR_FIXED_LAGNA.name: Sthira-āyu yogaḥ — sthira-lagne balavān śaniḥ — sthira-dīrghāyutvam.
STHIRA_AYUR_FIXED_LAGNA.prose: Sthira-āyu-yogaḥ sthira-rāśau (vṛṣa-siṃha-vṛścika-kumbheṣu) lagna-sthite sati śanirbalavān bhūtvā tiṣṭhet, tadā jātakasya sthiraṃ dīrghāyuḥ prāpnoti.

STREE_DEERGH_ABSENCE.name: Strī-dīrgha-abhāvaḥ — viśeṣa-kūṭābhāva-yogyaḥ. Dāmpatya-sthairya-nyūnatā.
STREE_DEERGH_ABSENCE.prose: Muhūrta-cintāmaṇau aṣṭame adhyāye strī-dīrgha kūṭa uktaḥ — vadhū-nakṣatrāt vara-nakṣatraṃ dūre (9 nakṣatrādhikam) cet dīrghāyuṣya-saṃyogaḥ. Abhāve — dāmpatya-sthairya-nyūnatā, sāthinī-dīrghāyuṣya-kaṣṭa-yogyatā darśayati.

SUBHA_KARTARI_10.name: Śubha-kartarī (10) — daśama-bhāvaḥ śubhaiḥ kṛntataḥ. Karma-śubha-yogaḥ.
SUBHA_KARTARI_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye śubha-kartarī (10)-yogaḥ — daśama-bhāvasya ubhaya-pārśve (9-11 bhāveṣu) śubha-grahāḥ. Śubhaiḥ-kartarī-kṛntitaṃ karma-sthānaṃ sthira-karma-yaśaṃ, dharma-karma-saṃyogaṃ, mitra-vyāpāra-lābhaṃ dadāti.

SUBHA_KARTARI_7.name: Śubha-kartarī (7) — saptama-bhāvaḥ śubhaiḥ kṛntataḥ. Dāmpatya-śubha-yogaḥ.
SUBHA_KARTARI_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye śubha-kartarī (7)-yogaḥ — saptama-bhāvasya ubhaya-pārśve (6-8 bhāveṣu) śubha-grahāḥ tiṣṭhanti. Śubhaiḥ-kartarī-kṛntitaṃ saptama-bhāvaṃ uttama-dāmpatya-saṃrakṣaṇaṃ, sthira-sāthinaṃ, śubha-vyāpāra-saṃyogaṃ dadāti.

SUBHA_KARTARI_LAGNA.name: Śubha-kartarī lagna yoga — lagnaṃ śubhābhyāṃ veṣṭitam — ātma-saṃrakṣaṇam.
SUBHA_KARTARI_LAGNA.prose: Śubha-kartarī-lagna-yogo lagnāt dvitīya-dvādaśayoḥ śubha-grahāḥ yadi sthitā bhaveyuḥ, tadā ātma-śarīra-saṃrakṣaṇa-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

SUBHA_KARTARI_SUN.name: Śubha-kartarī yoga (sūrya) — sūryaḥ śubha-kartaryāṃ — ātma-kāraka-saṃrakṣaṇam.
SUBHA_KARTARI_SUN.prose: Śubha-kartarī-yogo sūryo śubha-grahābhyāṃ dvitīya-dvādaśayoḥ veṣṭito yadi syāt, tadā ātma-kāraka-saṃrakṣaṇa-sthira-adhikāra-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

SUKARMA_BENEFIC_10.name: Sukarma yogaḥ — daśame śubhagrahe — sucaritra-dhārmika-karmapravṛttiḥ.
SUKARMA_BENEFIC_10.prose: Sukarma-yogaḥ phaladīpikā-śāstrasya 6-39-adhyāye kathitaḥ. Śubho (guru-śukra-budha-candra) daśama-sthāne yadi syāt, tadā sukarmā bhavati.

SUMUKHA.name: Sumukhayogaḥ — dvitīyeśa-lābheśayoḥ ekatra yutiḥ. Madhurabhāṣaṇaṃ, nirantaradhanāgamaśca.
SUMUKHA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye varṇitam — yadā dvitīyeśaḥ lābheśena saha ekatra santiṣṭhate, tadā sumukhayogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ madhurabhāṣī, nirantara-dhanavān, kuṭumba-mitra-priyaḥ, sarvajanavallabhaśca bhavati. Nāmānusāraṃ jātakasya mukhamaṇḍalaṃ tejomayaṃ supriyaṃ ca dṛśyate.

SUNAPHA.name: Sunaphā yogaḥ — candrāt dvitīye grahāṇāṃ sthitiḥ (sūryādi-varjam) — svadhanayogaḥ.
SUNAPHA.prose: Sūryaṃ rāhuṃ ketuṃ ca varjayitvā ko'pi grahaḥ candrāt dvitīyasthāne cet, tadā sunaphāyogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ svabhujārjitavibhavena yuktaḥ, nītivān, udyamī, yaśasvī ca bhavati.

SUNAPHA_JUPITER.name: Sunaphā (guruḥ) — candrāt dvitīye devagurau — dharma-jñāna-sampadā.
SUNAPHA_JUPITER.prose: Bṛhaspatiścandrāt dvitīya-bhāve yadi vaset, tadā sunaphā-guru-yogo phalayati. Anena jātakaḥ susaṃskṛtaḥ, bahuśrutaḥ, nyāyālaye vā śikṣākṣetre labdhapratiṣṭhaḥ, dhārmikavibhavena yuktaśca bhavati.

SUNAPHA_MARS.name: Sunaphā (maṅgalaḥ) — candrāt dvitīye kuje — parākramajanyavibhavaḥ.
SUNAPHA_MARS.prose: Maṅgalaścandrāt dvitīya-bhāve yadi tiṣṭhet, tadā sunaphā-kuja-yogo bhavati. Anena jātakaḥ sāhasikaḥ, śalyakriyā-senā-abhiyāntrika-kāryeṣu kuśalaḥ, svaparākrameṇa dhanavān ca jāyate.

SUNAPHA_MERCURY.name: Sunaphā (budhaḥ) — candrāt dvitīye budhe — medhā-vāṇijya-vaibhavam.
SUNAPHA_MERCURY.prose: Budhaścandrāt dvitīya-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā sunaphā-budha-yogo jāyate. Anena jātakaḥ paramabuddhimān, vākpaṭuḥ, gaṇita-śāstra-lekhana-vāṇijya-kalāsu nipuṇaḥ, dhanavān ca bhavati.

SUNAPHA_SATURN.name: Sunaphā (śaniḥ) — candrāt dvitīye śanaiścare — dhairya-śrama-sthiradhanam.
SUNAPHA_SATURN.prose: Śanaiścaraścandrāt dvitīya-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā sunaphā-śani-yogo jāyate. Anena jātakaḥ dhīraḥ, karmābhyāsī, bhū-sampatti-khanijādi-vyāpāre labdhapraveśaḥ, śanaiḥ śanaiḥ sthiradhanavān ca bhavati.

SUNAPHA_STRICT.name: Sunaphā yoga (kaṭhora) — śubha-grahaścandrād dvitīye, dvādaśe śūnyam — śuddha-sva-dhana-yogaḥ.
SUNAPHA_STRICT.prose: Sunaphā-yogaḥ (kaṭhora-tiryak) candrāt dvitīye śubha-graho yadi syāt, dvādaśe ca (sūrya-rāhu-ketu-varjayitvā) ko'pi graho na syāt, tadā śuddha-sva-dhana-samṛddhiṃ phalayati.

SUNAPHA_VENUS.name: Sunaphā (śukraḥ) — candrāt dvitīye śukre — kalā-vaibhava-kāvyasaukhyam.
SUNAPHA_VENUS.prose: Śukraścandrāt dvitīya-bhāve yadi virājate, tadā sunaphā-śukra-yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ sundarākṛtiḥ, vilāsī, kāvya-kalā-saṅgītapriyaḥ, bhogaiśvaryasampannaśca bhavati.

SUN_EXALTED_KENDRA.name: Ucca-sūryaḥ kendre mahā-rājayogaḥ. Ucca-rāja-padam, viśva-vyāpi-yaśam, sarva-sammānam.
SUN_EXALTED_KENDRA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ aṣṭatriṃśe adhyāye ucca-sūryo kendrasthaḥ mahā-rājayogakārakaḥ — meṣa-rāśau ucca-sthānāt kendrāt ca dvaita-balaṃ prāpya ucca-rāja-padaṃ, viśva-vyāpi-yaśaṃ, sarva-sammānaṃ, sthira-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — ucca-ravi-kendra-yogaḥ mahā-puruṣa-yoga-samānaḥ.

SUN_IN_1.name: Sūryo lagne pittaprakṛtiḥ, tejasvī, svābhimānī, ugraḥ, rāja-sammānitaḥ.
SUN_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryo lagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ tejasvinaṃ, svābhimāninaṃ, pitta-prakṛtiṃ, ugra-svabhāvaṃ, rāja-sammānitaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — ātma-kārakaḥ tanu-sthāne ātma-tejaḥ vardhayati kintu pitṛ-sukhaṃ kiñcit nyūnayati.

SUN_IN_10.name: Sūryo daśame digbalī rājayogakārakaḥ. Ucca-rāja-padaṃ, adhikāraṃ, yaśaṃ dadāti.
SUN_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryo daśamasthaḥ digbalī karma-rājayogakārakaḥ — ucca-rāja-padaṃ, adhikāraṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, sthira-yaśaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raveḥ karma-sthānaṃ sarvottamaṃ uktam. Amalā-yoga-kārakaśca.
SUN_IN_10.general: Digbalī karma-rājayogaḥ, ucca-rāja-padam, adhikāraḥ, rāja-sammānam, sthira-yaśam, amalā-kīrtiḥ.

SUN_IN_11.name: Sūryo lābhasthāne rāja-lābha-yogaḥ. Rāja-sammānena-dhana-vṛddhiḥ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaḥ.
SUN_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryo lābhasthāne rāja-lābha-yogakārakaḥ — rāja-sammānena dhana-vṛddhiṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaṃ, adhikāra-kīrtiṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — sūryo upacaya-lābhasthānāt sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

SUN_IN_5.name: Sūryaḥ pañcame — ātma-prajñā-yogaḥ. Atyanta-tejasvī-santati, rāja-kīrtiḥ.
SUN_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryaḥ pañcamasthaḥ ātma-prajñā-rājayogakārakaḥ — pūrva-puṇye ātma-kāraka-saṃyogāt atyanta-tejasvī-santatiṃ, rāja-kīrtiṃ, mantra-siddhiṃ, adhikāra-sthānaṃ dadāti.

SUN_IN_9.name: Sūryo navame pitṛ-bhāgya-yogaḥ. Pitṛ-sukhī, dhārmikaḥ, rāja-kīrtimān.
SUN_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryo navamasthaḥ pitṛ-bhāgya-yogakārakaḥ — pitṛ-sukhaṃ, dharma-niṣṭhāṃ, rāja-kīrtiṃ, guru-kṛpāṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raverbhāgya-sthānāt pitṛ-kāraka-trikoṇa-yogaḥ.

SUN_JUP_CONJ.name: Sūrya-guru yutiḥ — rāja-dharma-saṃyogaḥ. Ucca-śikṣā, dhārmika-rāja-yaśam.
SUN_JUP_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye sūrya-guru-yutiḥ rāja-dharma-saṃyoga-rājayogaḥ — ātma-kārakena jñāna-kārakena ca yutiḥ ucca-śikṣāṃ, dhārmika-rāja-yaśaṃ, dharma-karma-samarthyaṃ, adhyāpaka-vā-nyāyādhīśa-samarthyaṃ dadāti. Phaladīpikā 6 — rāja-kāraka-yogaḥ.

SUN_KETU_CONJ.name: Sūrya-ketu yutiḥ — ātma-mokṣa-yogaḥ. Āntarika-teja-vardhanam, ahaṃ-nāśaḥ.
SUN_KETU_CONJ.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye sūrya-ketu-yutiḥ miśra-yogaḥ — bāhya-rāja-śakti-nyūnaṃ kintu ātma-mokṣa-vṛttiṃ, sūkṣma-dṛṣṭiṃ, ādhyātmika-rāja-yogyatāṃ, ahaṃ-nāśa-śikṣaṇaṃ dadāti. Ketoḥ grahaṇa-doṣeṇa pitṛ-kaṣṭam.

SUN_MARS_CONJ.name: Sūrya-maṅgala yutiḥ — ugra-tejaḥ, sāhasaḥ, krodha-vṛttiḥ.
SUN_MARS_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye sūrya-maṅgala-yutiḥ — ugra-tejasaṃ, sāhasikaṃ, krodha-vṛttiṃ, senā-nāyakatvaṃ, śastra-kauśalaṃ dadāti. Dvi-pitta-tejoḥ saṃyogaḥ ati-tīkṣṇaṃ svabhāvaṃ.

SUN_MER_VEN_CONJ.name: Sūrya-budha-śukra yutiḥ — kalā-buddhi-rāja-triveṇī. Sarva-kauśalam, rāja-kalā-kīrtiḥ.
SUN_MER_VEN_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye sūrya-budha-śukra-tri-yutiḥ kalā-buddhi-rāja-triveṇī-yogaḥ — ātma-buddhi-kalā-kārakāṇāṃ sama-rāśau saṃyogena sarva-kauśalaṃ, rāja-kalā-kīrtiṃ, buddhimatī-strī-saṃyoga-yogyatāṃ, ucca-varga-sammānaṃ dadāti.

SUN_MOON_CONJ.name: Sūrya-candra yutiḥ — amāvāsya-janmaḥ. Ātma-manasoḥ saṅgharṣaḥ, mātṛ-kaṣṭam.
SUN_MOON_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye sūrya-candra-yutiḥ uktā — amāvāsya-janmasya lakṣaṇam. Ātmā-manasoḥ saṅgharṣaḥ, mātṛ-kaṣṭaṃ, antaḥ-śakti-virodhaḥ, candra-teja-nyūnatā ca. Candraḥ sūrya-tejasā astaṅgato bhavati iti nyūna-phalam. Phaladīpikā — mātṛ-svāsthya-parīkṣaṇam.

SUN_SAT_CONJ.name: Sūrya-śani yutiḥ — pitṛ-karma-virodhaḥ. Pitṛ-kaṣṭam, karma-saṅgharṣaḥ.
SUN_SAT_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye sūrya-śani-yutiḥ ati-duṣṭa-yogaḥ — ātma-kārakena karma-kārakena ca paraspara-virodhena pitṛ-kaṣṭaṃ, karma-saṅgharṣaṃ, adhikāra-vivādaṃ, sva-karma-nyūna-tejaṃ dadāti. Śani-sūryayoḥ śatru-tvam.

SUN_VEN_CONJ.name: Sūrya-śukra yutiḥ — kalā-rāja-saṃyogaḥ. Rāja-śobhā, kalā-kīrtiḥ.
SUN_VEN_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye sūrya-śukra-yutiḥ kalā-rāja-saṃyogaḥ — ātma-kārakena bhoga-kārakena ca yutyā rāja-śobhā, kalā-kīrtiḥ, strī-sammānam, ucca-varga-sambandhaḥ ca. Śukro'staṅgata-doṣeṇa kiñcit-dāmpatya-kaṣṭam.

SURYA_UCHCHA_10.name: Ucca-sūrya daśame — sūryo meṣe daśame — parama-karma-yogaḥ.
SURYA_UCHCHA_10.prose: Sūrya-ucca-daśama-yogaḥ sūryo meṣa-rāśau daśama-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā digbala-ucca-saṃyogāt parama-adhikāra-rāja-kṛpā-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

TAJIK_INKILAB_LAGNA_LORD_DUSTHANA.name: Iṅkilāba (lagneśa duṣṭāne) — vyutkrama-varṣam.
TAJIK_INKILAB_LAGNA_LORD_DUSTHANA.prose: Iṅkilāba-yogo lagneśo duṣṭāna-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre yojanā-vyutkramaṃ apratyāsita-parivartanaṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_IQBALA_BENEFIC_LAGNA.name: Ikabāla (śubho lagne) — ātma-śubha-saṃrakṣaṇam.
TAJIK_IQBALA_BENEFIC_LAGNA.prose: Ikabāla-yogo śubha-graho lagne yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre ātma-śubha-saṃrakṣaṇa-kīrtiṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_IQBALA_JUPITER_KENDRA.name: Ikabāla (guru kendre) — parama-ikabāla-tiryak.
TAJIK_IQBALA_JUPITER_KENDRA.prose: Ikabāla-yogo gururkendra-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre mahat-bhāgya-udaya-darśana-samarthanaṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_IQBALA_LAGNA_LORD_KENDRA.name: Ikabāla (lagneśa kendre) — udaya-yogaḥ.
TAJIK_IQBALA_LAGNA_LORD_KENDRA.prose: Ikabāla-yogo lagneśo kendra-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre udaya-kīrti-kārya-siddhiṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MARS_SATURN.name: Itthaśāla (maṅgala-śani) — karma-dhairya-saṃyogaḥ.
TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MARS_SATURN.prose: Itthaśāla-yogo maṅgala-śanyoḥ sama-rāśau yutiḥ yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre tīvra-dhairya-saṃyogāt miśra-karma-phalaṃ pradāti.

TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MERCURY_VENUS.name: Itthaśāla (budha-śukra) — medhā-kalā-saṃyogaḥ.
TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MERCURY_VENUS.prose: Itthaśāla-yogo budha-śukrayoḥ sama-rāśau yutiḥ yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre medhā-kalā-kauśala-dāmpatya-saubhāgyaṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MOON_JUPITER.name: Itthaśāla (candra-guru) — mana-darśana-saṃyogaḥ.
TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_MOON_JUPITER.prose: Itthaśāla-yogo candra-guruyoḥ sama-rāśau yutiḥ yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre mana-darśana-samṛddhi-guru-kṛpāṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_SUN_JUPITER.name: Itthaśāla (sūrya-guru) — ātma-darśana-saṃyogaḥ.
TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_SUN_JUPITER.prose: Itthaśāla-yogaḥ sūrya-guruyoḥ sama-rāśau yutiḥ vā 15° upayogī-dṛṣṭyā yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre ātma-dharma-saṃyogāt rāja-kīrti-darśana-vardhanaṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_VENUS_JUPITER.name: Itthaśāla (śukra-guru) — dvi-guru-saṃyogaḥ.
TAJIK_ITTHASHALA_VENUS_JUPITER.prose: Itthaśāla-yogo śukra-guruyoḥ sama-rāśau yutiḥ yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre mahat-śubha-saṃyogena dhana-vidyā-sampannatāṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_KHALLASARA_BENEFIC_KENDRA_TRIKONA.name: Khallasāra (śubho kendra-trikoṇe) — śuddha-dṛṣṭi-yogaḥ.
TAJIK_KHALLASARA_BENEFIC_KENDRA_TRIKONA.prose: Khallasāra-yogo śubha-graho kendra-trikoṇa-bhāve yadi sthitaḥ syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre śuddha-dṛṣṭi-śubha-phalaṃ pradāti.

TAJIK_MANAHA_MALEFIC_LAGNA_NO_BENEFIC.name: Manahā (pāpa-graho lagne śubha-dṛṣṭi-hīnaḥ) — ātma-dabāva-varṣam.
TAJIK_MANAHA_MALEFIC_LAGNA_NO_BENEFIC.prose: Manahā-yogaḥ pāpa-graho lagne śubha-graha-dṛṣṭi-varjito yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre ātma-dabāva-daurbalya-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_MUTHA_MARS_SATURN_KENDRA.name: Muthā (maṅgala-śanī kendre) — karma-vighna-varṣam.
TAJIK_MUTHA_MARS_SATURN_KENDRA.prose: Muthā-yogo maṅgalaḥ śaniśca kendra-bhāve yadi sammilitau syātām, tadā vārṣika-cakre karma-vighna-gharṣaṇa-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_PHALADEEPIKA_JUPITER_LAGNA_FROM_MO.name: Phaladīpikā — guruścandrāt lagne — mana-darśana-saṃyoga-varṣam.
TAJIK_PHALADEEPIKA_JUPITER_LAGNA_FROM_MO.prose: Phaladīpikā-tājika-yogo guruścandrāt lagna-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre mana-darśana-saṃyoga-guru-kṛpā-varṣaṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_PHALADEEPIKA_LAGNA_BENEFIC_KENDRA.name: Phaladīpikā — śubho lagne kendre — anugraha-varṣam.
TAJIK_PHALADEEPIKA_LAGNA_BENEFIC_KENDRA.prose: Phaladīpikā-tājika-yogaḥ śubha-graho lagne anya-śubha-kendra-samarthanena yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre ātma-śubha-saṃrakṣaṇa-varṣaṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_RADDA_MALEFIC_KENDRA_NO_BENEFIC.name: Radda (pāpa kendre, śubha-varjitam) — dṛṣṭi-nyūnatā-varṣam.
TAJIK_RADDA_MALEFIC_KENDRA_NO_BENEFIC.prose: Radda-yogo pāpa-graho kendra-bhāve śubha-graha-varjito yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre pratirodha-gharṣaṇa-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_RUD_DHAR_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_1_10.name: Ruddhara (lagna-daśameśayoḥ parivartanam) — ātma-karma-saṃyoga-varṣam.
TAJIK_RUD_DHAR_LORDS_PARIVARTANA_1_10.prose: Ruddhara-yogo lagneśo daśameśena parivartanaṃ yadi syāt, tadā vārṣika-cakre ātma-karma-avibhedāt kīrti-kārya-siddhiṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_YAMAYYA_2_BENEFICS_KENDRA.name: Yāmayya (dvi-śubhau kendre) — dvi-śubha-saṃrakṣaṇam.
TAJIK_YAMAYYA_2_BENEFICS_KENDRA.prose: Yāmayya-yogo dvau śubha-grahau kendra-bhāveṣu yadi sthitau syātām, tadā vārṣika-cakre dvi-śubha-saṃrakṣaṇa-samṛddhiṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_YAMAYYA_DUAL_BENEFIC_LAGNA.name: Yāmayya (dvi-śubhau lagne) — parama-śubha-varṣam.
TAJIK_YAMAYYA_DUAL_BENEFIC_LAGNA.prose: Yāmayya-yogo dvau śubha-grahau lagne yadi sammilitau syātām, tadā vārṣika-cakre ātma-śubha-kāraka-samarthana-parama-śubha-varṣaṃ phalayati.

TAJIK_YAMAYYA_LUMINARIES_TRIKONA.name: Yāmayya (sūrya-candrau trikoṇe) — ātma-mana-saṃrakṣaṇam.
TAJIK_YAMAYYA_LUMINARIES_TRIKONA.prose: Yāmayya-yogaḥ sūrya-candrau trikoṇa-bhāveṣu yadi sthitau syātām, tadā vārṣika-cakre ātma-mana-dharma-saṃyoga-kīrtiṃ phalayati.

TITHI_DOSHA.name: Tithi doṣaḥ — riktā-tithi-janmaḥ (4-9-14). Śubha-karma-nyūnatā.
TITHI_DOSHA.prose: Muhūrta-cintāmaṇau tithi doṣaḥ — riktā-tithiṣu (4-navamī-14-caturdaśī) janmekaḥ śubha-karma-nyūnatāṃ, saṃskāra-śānti-āvaśyakatāṃ, māṅgalya-karma-vighnaṃ dadāti. Riktā-tithayaḥ muhūrta-śāstre viśeṣa-duṣṭāḥ uktāḥ.
TITHI_DOSHA.general: Śubha-karma nyūnatā, saṃskāra-śānti āvaśyakatā, māṅgalya-karma vighna.

TRIPURA_SUNDARI.name: Tripurasundarī yogaḥ — śukraḥ kendre ucca-sva-śubha-dṛṣṭaḥ. Divya-saundarya-yogaḥ.
TRIPURA_SUNDARI.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye tripurasundarī-yogaḥ — śukraḥ kendra-sthāne ucca-sva-rāśi-śubha-graha-dṛṣṭaḥ san tripurasundarī-tulyāṃ divya-saundaryaṃ, parama-kalā-kīrtiṃ, rāja-strī-sambandhaṃ, ati-bhoga-samṛddhiṃ dadāti. Śreṣṭha-saundarya-yogaḥ.

TRI_BHUVANA.name: Tribhuvanayogaḥ — sarve saumyagrahāḥ kendratrikoṇagatāḥ. Lokatraye khyātiḥ.
TRI_BHUVANA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye varṇitam — yadā sarve naisargikaśubhagrahāḥ (guru-śukra-budha-pūrṇacandrāḥ) kendra-trikoṇeṣu santiṣṭhanti, tadā tribhuvanayogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ lokatraye (sarvatra) prakhyātakīrtiḥ, atulyaprabhāvayuktaḥ, sarvasampatsamṛddhaśca bhavati. Ayamadvitīyo mahārājayogaḥ.
TRI_BHUVANA.general: Lokatraye yaśaḥ, paramakīrtiḥ, sarvatomukhī samṛddhiḥ, apratihatā sattā.

UBHAYACHARI.name: Ubhayacārī yoga — sūryāt dvi-dvādaśayoḥ śubhau — sarvato-samarthanam.
UBHAYACHARI.prose: Ubhayacārī-yogaḥ sūryāt dvitīya-dvādaśayoḥ śubha-grahau yadi sthitau syātām, tadā sarvato-samṛddhi-gaurava-śatru-nāśa-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

UBHAYACHARI_BROAD.name: Ubhayacārī (vistṛtaḥ) — sūryasya ubhayataḥ grahāṇāṃ sthitiḥ — sarvatobhadrapradaḥ.
UBHAYACHARI_BROAD.prose: Sūryāt dvitīya-dvādaśa-bhāvayoḥ (candra-rāhu-ketu-varjam) grahāḥ yadi syuḥ, tadā ubhayacārī-yogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ sarvataḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ, dhīraḥ, janapriyaḥ, kāntiyuktaśca bhavati.

UBHAYACHARI_SUN_RAJA.name: Ubhayacarī sūrya-rājayogaḥ — sūryasya ubhayataḥ saumyagrahāḥ, sūryaśca balavān. Pūrṇarājavaibhavam.
UBHAYACHARI_SUN_RAJA.prose: Bṛhajjātake trayodaśe adhyāye varṇitam — yadā sūryāt dvitīye dvādaśe ca ubhayataḥ saumyagrahāḥ tiṣṭhanti, sūryaśca svayaṃ balī bhūtvā kendre santiṣṭhate, tadā ubhayacarī sūrya-rājayogo jāyate. Ayaṃ veśī-vāsī yogayoḥ mahāsaṃyogaḥ. Anena jātakaḥ bhūpatiḥ, sarvāṅgasundaraḥ, mahāyaśasvī, sarvamānyaśāsakaśca bhavati.

VAGISH_MERCURY_2_5_9_OWN_EXALT.name: Vāgīśa yoga — budho 2/5/9 sva/ucce — vāk-darśana-dharma-saṃyogaḥ.
VAGISH_MERCURY_2_5_9_OWN_EXALT.prose: Vāgīśa-yogaḥ budho dvi-pañcama-navama-bhāveṣu sva-ucca-mūlatrikoṇe yadi syāt, tadā vāk-kauśalaṃ darśana-śāstraṃ dharma-vidyāṃ ca pradāti.

VAIDHRITI_DOSHA.name: Vaidhṛti doṣaḥ — vaidhṛti-yoga-janmaḥ. Śubha-karma-saṃśaya-yogyatā.
VAIDHRITI_DOSHA.prose: Muhūrta-cintāmaṇau vaidhṛti doṣaḥ — vaidhṛti-nāmaka-yoga-kāle janmekaḥ śubha-karma-saṃśaya-yogyatāṃ, saṃskāra-śānti-āvaśyakatāṃ, māṅgalya-karma-vighnaṃ dadāti. 27-Yogānāṃ saptaviṃśe (antima) sthāne ati-duṣṭaḥ. Vyatīpāta-samānaṃ nivāraṇīyam.
VAIDHRITI_DOSHA.general: Śubha-karma saṃśaya, saṃskāra-śānti āvaśyakatā, māṅgalya-karma vighna.

VAPI.name: Vāpī yogaḥ — grahāḥ kendra-paṇapharayoḥ samavṛttāḥ. Bāvaḍī-samāna-sañcaya.
VAPI.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye vāpī yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ kendra-paṇapharayoḥ sama-vṛttāḥ. Vāpī (bāvaḍī)-samānāṃ dhana-sañcayaṃ, sthira-vardhanaṃ, avyaya-vyavasthāṃ dadāti. Samudrādalpatara-gāmbhīryaḥ.

VASI_SUN_RAJA.name: Vāsī sūrya-rājayogaḥ — sūryāt dvādaśe saumyagrahāḥ, sūryaśca balavān. Āntarikarājakīrtiḥ.
VASI_SUN_RAJA.prose: Bṛhajjātake trayodaśe adhyāye varṇitam — yadā sūryāt dvādaśabhāve saumyagrahāḥ tiṣṭhanti, sūryaśca balavān syāt, tadā vāsī sūrya-rājayogaḥ. Anena jātakaḥ āntarika-adhikārayuktaḥ, mantraṇākuśalaḥ, parokṣa-rājakīrtisampannaśca bhavati. Ayaṃ sūkṣma-prabhāvapradaḥ.

VASUKI.name: Vāsuki yogaḥ — rāhuḥ śubha-saṃyoge kendratrikoṇe. Nāga-tulya-śaktiḥ.
VASUKI.prose: Jātaka-pārijāte pañcame adhyāye vāsuki-yogaḥ — rāhuḥ śubha-graha-saṃyoge kendra-trikoṇayoḥ śubha-sthāne tiṣṭhan nāga-rāja-vāsuki-tulyāṃ gupta-śaktiṃ, akalpita-dhana-lābhaṃ, videśa-vāsa-vā-yātrā-kīrtiṃ, anūṭha-karma-samarthyaṃ dadāti.

VASUMATI.name: Vasumatī yoga — śubha-grahāḥ candrādupacaye — samṛddhi-yogaḥ.
VASUMATI.prose: Vasumatī-yogaḥ śubha-grahāḥ candrād upacaya-bhāveṣu (3, 6, 10, 11) sarvatra-sthitā yadi bhaveyuḥ, tadā-vasu-matī (dhana-vatī) nāmnā sampadā-samṛddhiṃ phalayati.

VASUMATI_RAJA.name: Vasumatī-rājayogaḥ — upacayasthāneṣu balīyāṃsaḥ śubhagrahāḥ. Vasumatīsamānā dhanasamṛddhiḥ.
VASUMATI_RAJA.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye vasumatī-rājayogaḥ — yadā kuṇḍalyāḥ upacayasthāneṣu (3, 6, 10, 11) sarve saumyagrahāḥ (budha-guru-śukrāḥ) balaśālinaḥ santaḥ tiṣṭhanti, tadā vasumatī-rājayogo jāyate. "Vasumatī" iti ratnākarā vasundharā pṛthvī. Anena jātakaḥ pṛthvītulya-apāra-dhanasampannaḥ, sthiralakṣmīkaḥ, rājā vā bhavati.
VASUMATI_RAJA.general: Vasundharāsamānā pracurasampattiḥ, upacaya-dhanavṛddhiḥ, sthirarājakīyaṃ yaśaḥ, sukhasamṛddhiḥ.

VEDHA_DOSHA.name: Vedha doṣaḥ — vara-vadhū-nakṣatrayorvedha-sambandhaḥ. Dāmpatya-svāsthya-vyādhi-yogyatā.
VEDHA_DOSHA.prose: Muhūrta-cintāmaṇau ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye vedha doṣaḥ — vara-vadhū-nakṣatrayorvedha-sambandhe (nakṣatra-virodha-sūcī-gata) pārasparika-vyādhi-saṃyoga, dāmpatya-kaṣṭa-vardhanaṃ, svāsthya-nyūnatāṃ dadāti. Nivāraṇaṃ — viśiṣṭa-nakṣatra-śānti-karma.

VEENA.name: Vīṇā yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ sapta-rāśiṣu. Kalākāraḥ, saṅgīta-nirataḥ.
VEENA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye vīṇā yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ bhinna-bhinna-sapta-rāśiṣu sthitāḥ jātakaṃ kalākāraṃ, saṅgīta-nirataṃ, madhura-svara-saṅgāyakaṃ, sama-tejasaṃ ca kurvanti. Vīṇā-tantu-samānāṃ sama-vyāpti.

VEERA.name: Vīra yogaḥ — maṅgalaḥ kendre ucce candra-guru-dṛṣṭaḥ. Mahāvīra-tulyam.
VEERA.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ catustriṃśe adhyāye vīra-yogaḥ — maṅgalaḥ kendre ucca-sva-rāśi-sthaḥ candra-gurudvārā dṛṣṭaḥ san mahāvīra-tulyāṃ śauryaṃ, ati-sāhasaṃ, aṣṭa-dig-vijaya-yogyatāṃ, senā-senāpati-kīrtiṃ dadāti. Vīra-rāja-tulyaḥ.

VEN_IN_1.name: Śukro lagne sundara-kāntiḥ, kalāpriyaḥ, bhoga-samṛddhaḥ, sukha-vān.
VEN_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukro lagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ sundara-kāntiṃ, kalāpriyaṃ, bhoga-samṛddhaṃ, sukhinaṃ, strī-sammānitaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukraḥ kāraka-tanu-saṃyogāt kalātmaka-vyaktitvaṃ dadāti.

VEN_IN_10.name: Śukro daśame — kalā-karma-rājayogaḥ. Kalātmaka-karma-yaśam, sundara-varṇa-karma.
VEN_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukro daśamasthaḥ kalā-karma-rājayogakārakaḥ — kalātmaka-karma-yaśaṃ, sundara-varṇa-karmaṃ, strī-samūha-samarthanaṃ, manorañjaka-rāja-kīrtiṃ dadāti.

VEN_IN_11.name: Śukra ekādaśe lābha-kalā-yogaḥ. Nirantara-lābhaḥ, strī-mitradvārā-dhanam.
VEN_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukra ekādaśasthaḥ lābha-kalā-yogakārakaḥ — nirantara-dhana-lābhaṃ, strī-mitra-dvārā-dhana-vardhanaṃ, kalātmaka-vyāpāreṇa-yaśaṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukro lābhasthāne sarvārtha-lābhakārakaḥ.

VEN_IN_2.name: Śukro dvitīye — kalā-dhana-yogaḥ. Bahu-dhana-saṅgrahaḥ, madhura-svara-vyavahāraḥ.
VEN_IN_2.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukro dvitīyasthaḥ kalā-dhana-yogakārakaḥ — bahu-dhana-saṅgrahaṃ, madhura-svara-vyavahāraṃ, strī-kāraṇena-dhana-vardhanaṃ, kalā-niratiṃ dadāti.

VEN_IN_4.name: Śukraścaturthe gṛha-vāhana-bhoga-yogaḥ. Mātṛ-sukhī, sundara-gṛhasthaḥ.
VEN_IN_4.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukraścaturthasthaḥ gṛha-vāhana-bhoga-samṛddhiṃ, sundara-gṛhastha-vṛttiṃ, mātṛ-sukhaṃ, strī-sahayogena-dhana-vardhanaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukraḥ sukha-sthāne bhoga-kendra-rājayogakārakaḥ.

VEN_IN_5.name: Śukraḥ pañcame kāvya-kalā-santati-yogaḥ. Buddhimān, kalākāraḥ, santati-sukhī.
VEN_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukraḥ pañcamasthaḥ kāvya-kalā-santati-yogakārakaḥ — buddhimattā, kalātmaka-vṛttiḥ, santati-sukhaṃ, sundara-strī-sambandhaṃ, rāja-kīrti-vardhanaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — kāraka-trikoṇa-rājayogaḥ.

VEN_IN_7.name: Śukraḥ saptame kāraka-kāraka-yogaḥ. Sundara-jāyādvārā-vṛddhiḥ, dāmpatya-sukhī.
VEN_IN_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukraḥ saptamasthaḥ kāraka-kāraka-yogakārakaḥ — śukraḥ kalatra-kārakaḥ kalatra-sthāne tiṣṭhan sundara-jāyāṃ, dāmpatya-sukhaṃ, strī-sahayogena-vardhanaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śreṣṭha-kalatra-yogaḥ.

VEN_IN_9.name: Śukro navame bhāgya-kalā-yogaḥ. Dhārmika-kalākāraḥ, strī-kāraṇena-bhāgyodayaḥ.
VEN_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukro navamasthaḥ bhāgya-kalā-yogakārakaḥ — dhārmika-kalākāritvaṃ, strī-kāraṇena-bhāgyodayaṃ, sundara-dharma-yātrāṃ, guru-kṛpā-sahitaṃ bhāgyaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — kāraka-trikoṇa-rājayogaḥ.

VEN_RAHU_CONJ.name: Śukra-rāhu yutiḥ — videśīya-kalā-yogaḥ. Bahu-strī-sambandha, anūṭha-kalā-niratiḥ.
VEN_RAHU_CONJ.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre saptame adhyāye śukra-rāhu-yutiḥ miśra-yogaḥ — videśīya-kalā-niratiṃ, akalpita-strī-sambandhaṃ, ati-bhoga-vṛttiṃ, anūṭha-kalā-kīrtiṃ dadāti. Rāhoḥ-doṣeṇa dāmpatya-parīkṣaṇaṃ kvacit.

VEN_SAT_CONJ.name: Śukra-śani yutiḥ — sthira-dāmpatya-saṃyogaḥ. Cira-kālīna-sambandha, sthira-kalā.
VEN_SAT_CONJ.prose: Sārāvalyāṃ pañcadaśe adhyāye śukra-śani-yutiḥ sthira-dāmpatya-saṃyogaḥ — sakhya-grahayoḥ yutyā cira-kālīna-dāmpatya-sambandhaṃ, sthira-kalā-kīrtiṃ, uttara-vayaska-vardha-dhana-yogaṃ, gahana-kalā-niratiṃ dadāti. Phaladīpikā — dīrgha-dāmpatya-yogaḥ.

VESI.name: Veśī yoga — sūryāt dvitīye śubhaḥ — ātma-samarthanam.
VESI.prose: Veśī-yogaḥ sūryāt dvitīye śubha-graho (candra-varjayitvā) yadi syāt, dvādaśe ca ko'pi na syāt, tadā netṛtva-vāṇī-adhikāra-dṛṣṭyā kleśaṃ harati.

VESI_BROAD.name: Veśī yogaḥ (vistṛtaḥ) — sūryāt dvitīye grahāṇāṃ sthitiḥ — ātmabalavardhanam.
VESI_BROAD.prose: Candraṃ rāhuṃ ketuṃ ca varjayitvā sūryāt dvitīya-bhāve ko'pi grahaḥ cet, tadā veśīyogaḥ samajāyate. Anena jātakaḥ ojasvī, kāryakuśalaḥ, vākpaṭuḥ, samājapratiṣṭhitaśca jāyate.

VESI_JUPITER.name: Veśī (guru) — sūryāt dvitīye guruḥ — parama-veśī-tiryak.
VESI_JUPITER.prose: Veśī-yogo guruḥ sūryāt dvitīye yadi syāt, tadā veśī-yogānāṃ sarvocca-tiryak dharma-rājya-kīrtiṃ pradāti.

VESI_MARS.name: Veśī (maṅgala) — sūryāt dvitīye bhaumaḥ — sāhasika-netṛtvam.
VESI_MARS.prose: Veśī-yogo maṅgalaḥ sūryāt dvitīye yadi syāt dvādaśe ca (candra-varjayitvā) ko'pi na syāt, tadā sāhasika-netṛtvaṃ pradāti.

VESI_MERCURY.name: Veśī (budha) — sūryāt dvitīye budhaḥ — medhā-vākpaṭutvam.
VESI_MERCURY.prose: Veśī-yogo budhaḥ sūryāt dvitīye yadi syāt, tadā medhā-vākpaṭutva-rājya-nāyakatvaṃ pradāti.

VESI_SATURN.name: Veśī (śani) — sūryāt dvitīye śaniḥ — anuśāsita-dīrgha-adhikāraḥ.
VESI_SATURN.prose: Veśī-yogo śaniḥ sūryāt dvitīye yadi syāt, tadā anuśāsita-dīrgha-adhikāra-sevā-netṛtvaṃ pradāti.

VESI_SUN_RAJA.name: Veśī sūrya-rājayogaḥ — sūryāt dvitīye saumyagrahāḥ, sūryaśca balavān. Rājasammānaḥ.
VESI_SUN_RAJA.prose: Bṛhajjātake trayodaśe adhyāye varṇitam — yadā sūryāt dvitīyabhāve saumyagrahāḥ (budha-guru-śukrāḥ) tiṣṭhanti, sūryaśca balavān bhūtvā kendre santiṣṭhate, tadā veśī sūrya-rājayogo jāyate. Anena jātakaḥ rājapūjitaḥ, uccapadādhikārī, sarvatra labdhapratiṣṭhaśca bhavati. Ayaṃ sūryasya tejasā adhikāraṃ vardhayati.

VESI_VENUS.name: Veśī (śukra) — sūryāt dvitīye śukraḥ — kalātmaka-rājya-kauśalam.
VESI_VENUS.prose: Veśī-yogo śukraḥ sūryāt dvitīye yadi syāt, tadā kalātmaka-rājya-kauśala-dāmpatya-saubhāgyaṃ pradāti.

VIDYA_4_5_LORDS_PARIVARTANA.name: Vidyā-putra-parivartana yoga — caturtha-pañcameśayoḥ parivartanam — śikṣā-purvapuṇya-saṃyogaḥ.
VIDYA_4_5_LORDS_PARIVARTANA.prose: Vidyā-putra-parivartana-yogaḥ caturtheśaḥ pañcama-bhāve, pañcameśaḥ caturtha-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā śikṣā-purvapuṇyayoḥ yugapat-vardhanaṃ pradāti.

VIDYA_4_LORD_KENDRA.name: Vidyā yoga — caturtheśa kendre — sudṛḍha-śikṣā.
VIDYA_4_LORD_KENDRA.prose: Vidyā-yogaḥ caturtheśo lagna-caturtha-saptama-daśameṣu yadi syāt, tadā śikṣā-sukha-mātṛ-kalyāṇaṃ pradāti.

VIDYA_4_LORD_OWN_EXALT.name: Vidyā yoga — caturtheśa sva/ucce — pūrṇa-śikṣā-phalam.
VIDYA_4_LORD_OWN_EXALT.prose: Vidyā-yogaḥ caturtheśaḥ sva-ucca-mūlatrikoṇe yadi syāt, tadā pūrṇa-vidyā-sukha-mātṛ-yānādi-phalaṃ pradāti.

VIDYA_4_LORD_TRIKONA.name: Vidyā yoga — caturtheśa trikoṇe — dharma-saṃyukta-śikṣā.
VIDYA_4_LORD_TRIKONA.prose: Vidyā-yogaḥ caturtheśo lagna-pañcama-navameṣu yadi syāt, tadā dharma-purvapuṇya-saṃyuktaṃ vidyā-phalaṃ pradāti.

VIDYUT.name: Vidyut yogaḥ — lābheśaḥ kendre ucce śukra-dṛṣṭaḥ. Ākasmika-dhana-lābhaḥ.
VIDYUT.prose: Phaladīpikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe adhyāye vidyut-yogaḥ — ekādaśeśo kendre ucca-sva-rāśi-sthaḥ śukreṇa dṛṣṭaḥ san vidyut-samāna-tejasā akasmāt-dhana-lābhaṃ, akalpita-yaśaṃ, camaka-samāna-vyaktitvaṃ dadāti.

VIHAGA.name: Vihaga yogaḥ — grahāḥ caturtha-daśamayoḥ. Pakṣi-samānaṃ yātrā-śīlam, bahu-sandeśaḥ.
VIHAGA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye vihaga yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ caturtha-daśama-kendradvaye. Vihaga (pakṣi)-samānāṃ jīvanaṃ — yātrā-śīlaṃ, bahu-sandeśa-vahanaṃ, avyavasthita-vāsaṃ, urdhva-gāmi-vṛttiṃ ca prāpayati.

VIKRAMA_3_BENEFIC_AND_3LORD_KENDRA.name: Vikrama yoga — śubho tṛtīye evaṃ tṛtīyeśa kendre — saṃyukta-sāhasam.
VIKRAMA_3_BENEFIC_AND_3LORD_KENDRA.prose: Vikrama-yogaḥ śubho tṛtīye yadi syāt, tṛtīyeśaśca kendre, tadā saṃyukta-sāhasaṃ bhrātṛ-sukhaṃ ca bhavati.

VIMALA.name: Vimala viparīta rāja yoga — dvādaśeśa duṣṭāna — saṃyamaṃ videśa-vāsaṃ ca pradāti.
VIMALA.prose: Vimala-yogaḥ viparīta-rāja-yogānāṃ tṛtīyo. Dvādaśeśo ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśa-sthāneṣu sthitaḥ san yadi syāt, tasya aśubhatvaṃ viparyayeṇa śubhatvaṃ bhavati, yena vyaya-saṃyamaṃ videśa-vāsaṃ ādhyātmikaṃ ca pradāti. (Phaladīpikā 6-38)

VIPAREETA_RAJA_PARIVARTANA.name: Viparīta rāja parivartana yoga — dvaita-duṣṭāneśa-parivartana — dviguṇa-śubhaṃ pradāti.
VIPAREETA_RAJA_PARIVARTANA.prose: Viparīta-rāja-parivartana-yogaḥ bṛhatpārāśara-horā-śāstrasya 34-adhyāye kathitaḥ. Ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśa-sthānānāṃ kaucicdvau svāminau anyonya-sthānaṃ prāpnuttau cet, tadā pārivartana-vaśāt dviguṇaṃ viparīta-śubhaṃ pradāti.

VIPAREETA_RAJA_PURE.name: Śuddha viparīta rāja yoga — duṣṭāneśa svaduṣṭāne sva/ucca — pariśuddhaṃ dvaitenvarśanam.
VIPAREETA_RAJA_PURE.prose: Śuddha-viparīta-rāja-yogaḥ sārāvalyāḥ 34-adhyāye kathitaḥ. Duṣṭāna-svāmī sva-duṣṭāna-sthāne sthitaḥ cet api svocca-sva-mūlatrikoṇa-rāśiṣu yadi syāt, tadā pariśuddha-viparīta-rājayogo bhavati.

VIPAREETA_RAJA_TRIPLE.name: Tripala viparīta rāja yoga — sarva-trika-duṣṭāneśa duṣṭāne — parama-śubhaṃ pradāti.
VIPAREETA_RAJA_TRIPLE.prose: Tripala-viparīta-rāja-yogaḥ bṛhatpārāśara-horā-śāstrasya 34-adhyāye kathitaḥ. Ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśa-sthānānāṃ sarve trayo svāmino sarve ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśa-sthāneṣu sthitāḥ santi cet, tadā triguṇa-viparīta-śubhaṃ pradāti.

VIPARITA_12_IN_8.name: Dvādaśeśo aṣṭame viparīta-rājayogaḥ. Vyaya-maraṇa-saṃyogena dīrghāyuḥ, gupta-dhanam.
VIPARITA_12_IN_8.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye dvādaśeśo aṣṭamasthaḥ viparīta-rājayogakārakaḥ — vyaya-maraṇayoḥ paraspara-nāśena dīrghāyuṃ, gupta-dhana-lābhaṃ, mṛtyu-bhaya-nāśaṃ ca dadāti.

VIPARITA_6_IN_12.name: Ṣaṣṭheśo dvādaśe viparīta-rājayogaḥ. Śatru-vyaya-saṃyogāt śubha-phalam.
VIPARITA_6_IN_12.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye (śloka 17-19) viparīta-rājayogaḥ uktaḥ — duṣṭeśo duṣṭa-sthāne sthitaḥ śubha-phalaṃ dadāti iti viparīta-nyāyaḥ. Ṣaṣṭheśo dvādaśasthaḥ śatru-vyaya-paraspara-nāśena vyaya-niyantraṇaṃ, śatru-jayaṃ, ṛṇa-kṣayaṃ ca dadāti.

VIPARITA_8_IN_6.name: Aṣṭameśaḥ ṣaṣṭhe viparīta-rājayogaḥ. Maraṇa-śatru-nāśena dīrghāyu-śatrujayam.
VIPARITA_8_IN_6.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre catustriṃśe adhyāye aṣṭameśaḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ viparīta-rājayogakārakaḥ — maraṇa-śatruyoḥ paraspara-nāśena dīrghāyuṃ, śatru-jayaṃ, roga-nivṛttiṃ ca dadāti.

VIPARITA_RAJA_12_6.name: Viparīta rājayoga (12-6) — dvādaśeśo ṣaṣṭhe — vimala-tiryak.
VIPARITA_RAJA_12_6.prose: Viparīta-rājayogo (12-6) dvādaśeśo ṣaṣṭha-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā śāstrīya vimala-yogasya vyaya-niyantraṇa-dhana-vyavasthāpana-phalaṃ pradāti.

VIPARITA_RAJA_6_8.name: Viparīta rājayoga (6-8) — ṣaṣṭheśo aṣṭame — harṣa-tiryak.
VIPARITA_RAJA_6_8.prose: Viparīta-rājayogo (6-8) ṣaṣṭheśo aṣṭama-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā śāstrīya harṣa-yogasya phalaṃ pradāti.

VIPARITA_RAJA_8_12.name: Viparīta rājayoga (8-12) — aṣṭameśo dvādaśe — sarala-tiryak.
VIPARITA_RAJA_8_12.prose: Viparīta-rājayogo (8-12) aṣṭameśo dvādaśa-bhāve yadi syāt, tadā śāstrīya sarala-yogasya dīrghāyu-gūḍha-dṛṣṭi-śatru-nāśa-phalaṃ pradāti.

VISH.name: Viṣayogaḥ — candraśanyoḥ yutiḥ —  mānasikaviṣāktatā avasādādiḥ.
VISH.prose: Yadā manaḥkārakaścandraḥ duḥkhakārakeṇa śaninā saha kasmiṃścidapi bhāve yuto bhavati, tadā viṣayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya manasi nairāśyam, mānasikaviṣāktatā, khādyaviṣāktatā, mandasaṅkramaṇaṃ ca phalayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — candraśanyoḥ śāntiḥ, somavāraśanivārayoḥ vratam, mahāśivarātryupāsanā ca paramauṣadham.

VISHA_KANYA_DOSHA.name: Viṣakanyā doṣaḥ — vāra-tithi-nakṣatra-saṃyogaḥ (pārāśara). Dāmpatya-sukha-vighna-yogyatā.
VISHA_KANYA_DOSHA.prose: Pārāśara-mate viṣakanyā doṣaḥ — ravi-dvitīyā-aśleṣā, śani-saptamī-kṛttikā, maṅgala-dvādaśī-śatabhiṣā-saṃyoge jātāyāḥ. Dāmpatya-kalaha, vaivāhika-saṅkaṭa, dāmpatya-svāsthya-vighna-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Saptame śubha-grahe saptameśe vā svocca-sthite nivāraṇam.

VOSI.name: Vośī yoga — sūryāt dvādaśe śubhaḥ — pariṣkṛta-kauśalam.
VOSI.prose: Vośī-yogaḥ sūryāt dvādaśe śubha-graho yadi syāt, dvitīye ca ko'pi na syāt, tadā pariṣkṛta-vidyā-dāna-śīlatāṃ pradāti.

VOSI_BROAD.name: Vośī yogaḥ (vistṛtaḥ) — sūryāt dvādaśe grahāṇāṃ sthitiḥ — pariṣkāraḥ.
VOSI_BROAD.prose: Candraṃ rāhuṃ ketuṃ ca varjayitvā sūryāt dvādaśa-bhāve ko'pi grahaḥ yadi syāt, tadā vośīyogaḥ phalayati. Anena jātakaḥ susaṃskṛtaḥ, kāryadakṣaḥ, vyavahārakuśalaḥ, śāntaprakṛtiśca bhavati.

VOSI_JUPITER.name: Vośī (guru) — sūryāt 12 mā guruḥ — parama-vośī-tiryak.
VOSI_JUPITER.prose: Vośī-yogo guruḥ sūryāt dvādaśe yadi syāt, tadā vośī-yogānāṃ sarvocca-tiryak dharma-dātāḥ-gahanatāṃ pradāti.

VOSI_MARS.name: Vośī (maṅgala) — sūryāt 12 mā bhaumaḥ — pariṣkṛta-śauryam.
VOSI_MARS.prose: Vośī-yogo maṅgalaḥ sūryāt dvādaśe yadi syāt, tadā pariṣkṛta-śaurya-śalya-kauśalaṃ pradāti.

VOSI_MERCURY.name: Vośī (budha) — sūryāt 12 mā budhaḥ — vidvattā-vāk-pariṣkāraḥ.
VOSI_MERCURY.prose: Vośī-yogo budhaḥ sūryāt dvādaśe yadi syāt, tadā pariṣkṛta-medhā-vāk-vidvattāṃ pradāti.

VOSI_SATURN.name: Vośī (śani) — sūryāt 12 mā śaniḥ — tapasvī-vairāgya-svabhāvaḥ.
VOSI_SATURN.prose: Vośī-yogo śaniḥ sūryāt dvādaśe yadi syāt, tadā tapasvī-vairāgya-gāmbhīryaṃ pradāti.

VOSI_VENUS.name: Vośī (śukra) — sūryāt 12 mā śukraḥ — sūkṣma-kalātmakatvam.
VOSI_VENUS.prose: Vośī-yogo śukraḥ sūryāt dvādaśe yadi syāt, tadā sūkṣma-saundarya-dāmpatya-śiṣṭatāṃ pradāti.

VYATIPATA_DOSHA.name: Vyatīpāta doṣaḥ — vyatīpāta-yoga-janmaḥ. Māṅgalya-karma-vighna-yogyatā.
VYATIPATA_DOSHA.prose: Muhūrta-cintāmaṇau vyatīpāta doṣaḥ — vyatīpāta-nāmaka-yoga-kāle janmekaḥ māṅgalya-karma-vighna-yogyatāṃ, apa-śubha-karma-yogyatāṃ, saṃskāra-śānti-āvaśyakatāṃ dadāti. 27-Yogānāṃ viṃśe-sthāne ati-duṣṭaḥ. Vyatīpāta-śānti-karma-snāna-dānābhyāṃ nivāraṇīyam.
VYATIPATA_DOSHA.general: Māṅgalya-karma vighna, apa-śubha-karma yogyatā, saṃskāra-śānti āvaśyakatā.

YAMAGHANTA_DOSHA.name: Yamaghaṇṭa doṣaḥ — viśiṣṭa-vāra-nakṣatra-saṃyoga-janmaḥ. Yama-kāraṇena-kaṣṭa-yogyatā.
YAMAGHANTA_DOSHA.prose: Nārada-saṃhitāyāṃ yamaghaṇṭa doṣaḥ — viśiṣṭa-vāra-nakṣatra-saṃyogeṣu janmekaḥ yama-kāraṇena kaṣṭa-yogyatāṃ, mṛtyu-tulya-saṅkramaṇa-kāla-yogyatāṃ, karma-saṅgharṣa-yogyatāṃ dadāti. Śāstre 28-vāra-nakṣatra-joḍī-tālikā vidyate. Yama-śānti-vratena nivāraṇīyam.
YAMAGHANTA_DOSHA.general: Yama-kāraṇa-kaṣṭa yogyatā, mṛtyu-tulya saṅkramaṇa yogyatā, karma-saṅgharṣa.

YOGARISHTA_MARS_8TH_FROM_MOON.name: Yogāriṣṭayogaḥ — maṅgalaścandrād aṣṭamabhāve —  mānasikakaṣṭaṃ raktavikāraśca.
YOGARISHTA_MARS_8TH_FROM_MOON.prose: Yadā maṅgalaḥ candrāt aṣṭamabhāve (mṛtyubhāve) tiṣṭhati, tadā yogāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Manaḥkārakasya candrasya aṣṭame krūramaṅgalasya sthitiḥ jātakasya mānasikasukhaṃ nāśayati, krodhaṃ vardhayati, raktavikāraṃ vā durghaṭanāvikāraṃ ca phalayati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — maṅgalaśāntiḥ, nityaṃ hanumadupāsanā ca hitāya.

YOGARISHTA_MARS_SATURN_KENDRA.name: Yogāriṣṭayogaḥ — maṅgalaśanyoḥ kendrasthāneṣu sthitiḥ — tīvrāghātaḥ tīvramānasikakleśaśca.
YOGARISHTA_MARS_SATURN_KENDRA.prose: Yadā maṅgalaḥ śaniśca yugapat kendrabhāveṣu (1, 4, 7, 10) yutau vā sthitau bhavataḥ, tadā yogāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Maṅgalaḥ tīvrāghātakārakaḥ, śaniḥ vakragatyā cirapīḍākārakaḥ; anayoḥ kendre saṃyogaḥ jātakasya jīvane akasmāt saṅkaṭaṃ dīrghakālikaṃ saṅgharṣaṃ ca dadāti. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — maṅgalaśanyoḥ śāntipūjā, nityaṃ hanumānacālīsāpāṭhaḥ ca śubhadaḥ.

YOGARISHTA_SATURN_LAGNA_DEBIL.name: Yogāriṣṭayogaḥ — nīcaśaniḥ lagnabhāve — dīrghakālikā tanupīḍā kāryavilambaśca.
YOGARISHTA_SATURN_LAGNA_DEBIL.prose: Yadā mandagāmī śaniḥ svanīcarāśau (meṣe) lagnabhāve tiṣṭhati, tadā yogāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Śaniḥ śarīrasya saṅkocakārakaḥ; tasya nīcasthityā jātakasya śārīrikaṃ balamutsāhaśca hīyate, kāryeṣu ca ciravilambo bhavati. Asthirogasyāpi sambhāvanā. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — śaniśāntiḥ, hanumadārādhanā, nīcabhaṅgayogānveṣaṇam ca śubhapradam.

YOGARISHTA_SUN_SATURN_RAHU.name: Yogāriṣṭayogaḥ — sūryaśanirāhūṇāṃ yutiḥ — ātmaśaktihāsiḥ pitṛpīḍā ca.
YOGARISHTA_SUN_SATURN_RAHU.prose: Yadā sūryaḥ, śaniḥ, rāhuśca ekatra saṃyuktāḥ bhavanti, tadā gambhīraḥ yogāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Ātmākārakaḥ sūryaḥ śanirāhubhyāṃ grastaḥ san jātakasya ātmagaurave, yaśasi, pitṛsukhe ca gambhīraṃ kaṣṭaṃ dadāti. Manorogasyāpi sambhāvanā bhavati. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — trigrahaśāntiḥ, sūryagāyatrījapaḥ, nārāyaṇabaliḥ ca kalyāṇakārī.

YOGARISHTA_TRIKA_LORDS_CONJUNCT.name: Yogāriṣṭayogaḥ — trikeśvarāṇāṃ parasparayutiḥ — dīrghavyādhiḥ vighnaparamparā ca.
YOGARISHTA_TRIKA_LORDS_CONJUNCT.prose: Yadā ṣaṣṭha-aṣṭama-dvādaśeśāḥ (trikapatayaḥ) ekatra kasmiṃścid bhāve saṃyuktāḥ bhavanti, tadā yogāriṣṭayogo jāyate. Anena jātakasya śarīre dīrgharogaḥ, vighnaparamparā, mānasikakleśaśca phalayati. Parantu viparītarājayogavaśāt akasmāt yaśaḥprāptirapi sambhavā. Śāstrīyaprāyaścittam — trikeśajapaḥ, rudrābhiṣekaḥ ca rakṣāṃ karoti.

YUGA.name: Yuga yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ dvi-rāśyoḥ sthitāḥ. Dvi-mārgī-svabhāvaḥ, alpa-dhanam.
YUGA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye yuga yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ kevala-dvi-rāśyorvyavasthitāḥ. Jātaka dvi-mārgī-svabhāvī, dvaita-karma-nirataḥ, alpa-dhanī, parityakta-dharmī ca bhavati. Phaladīpikā 7 — madhyamaṃ phalaṃ.

YUPA.name: Yūpa yogaḥ — grahāḥ lagnādi-caturṣu-bhāveṣu krameṇa. Yajña-yūpa-samānaṃ dharma-karma.
YUPA.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ṣaṭtriṃśe adhyāye yūpa yogaḥ — sapta-grahāḥ lagnādi-caturṣu-bhāveṣu (1-2-3-4) krameṇa upasthitāḥ. Yajña-yūpa-samānāṃ dharma-karma, śreṇī-baddha-vyavahāraṃ, sthira-gṛhastha-dharmaṃ dadāti.
